words.example_en: This flaw makes the vase less valuable.
words.example_zh: 因为这处缺陷，这个花瓶不那么值钱了。
words.notes: [记] flawless adj. 完美的，没有瑕疵的

words.meaning_zh: adj. 错误的  adv. 错误地
words.example_en: Instead of complaining about what’s wrong, be grateful for what’s right.
words.example_zh: 要对对的事心存感恩，而不是抱怨哪里出错了。
words.collocations: [搭] go wrong 出现问题；出差错

words.meaning_zh: n. 缺点；故障  v. 找出缺点
words.example_en: It is hard to fault the way he runs his own operation.
words.example_zh: 他经营自己的公司的方式无可指摘。
words.collocations: [搭] find fault with 挑错，挑剔，抱怨
words.notes: [记] faulty adj. 有错误的；有缺点的  false adj. 不正确的

words.meaning_zh: 犯错误；绊脚；跌跌撞撞地走
words.example_en: The sudden weakness in her legs made her stumble.
words.example_zh: 她突然两腿发软，踉跄了一下。
words.collocations: [搭] stumble over 在……绊了一下

words.meaning_zh: 意外事件，可能发生的事
words.example_en: We must always be prepared for every contingency.
words.example_zh: 我们必须始终做好各种应急准备。

words.meaning_zh: 情况；环境；条件；[~s] 境遇
words.example_en: Circumstances are the rulers of the weak, the instruments of the wise.
words.example_zh: 弱者困于环境，智者利用环境。
words.collocations: [搭] under/in no circumstances 决不
words.word_formation: circum/circ/cycl(o)都和“圆，环”有关，如：circumstance（站在周围 → 环境），circle（圆圈；周期），circulate（循环），cyclist（骑自行车的人），bicycle（有两个轮子 → 自行车），cyclone（旋风），recycle（回收利用）。

words.example_en: China plays an important role in promoting Asian culture.
words.example_zh: 中国在推动亚洲文化发展方面发挥着重要作用。
words.word_formation: 字根 cult 指“耕种（to till）”。人类最早的文化之一就是农耕文化——怎样播种，如何灌溉，何时收获，等等。
words.notes: [记] cultural adj. 文化的  multicultural adj. 文化多样的

words.example_en: Western civilisation was cradled in Ancient Greece.
words.example_zh: 古希腊滋养了西方文明。
words.notes: [记] civilise (= civilize) v. 使文明；开化

words.example_en: The Renaissance was an epoch of unparalleled cultural achievement.
words.example_zh: 文艺复兴时期是一个在文化上取得空前成就的时代。

words.meaning_zh: n. 史诗  adj. 宏大的
words.example_en: Their epic fight is the subject of a new film.
words.example_zh: 他们的伟大战斗是一部新电影的主题。

words.example_en: An obsolete ideology can hamper an economy.
words.example_zh: 过时的意识形态会束缚经济。

words.example_en: Asia has a long tradition of tea-drinking. China is no exception.
words.example_zh: 亚洲有着饮茶的悠久传统，中国也不例外。
words.collocations: [搭] by tradition 根据传统；依照传统
words.notes: [记] traditional adj. 传统的；惯例的

words.example_en: The handshake is a social convention.
words.example_zh: 握手是社交惯例。
words.notes: [记] conventional adj. 传统的；通常的

words.example_en: The custom prevails over the whole area.
words.example_zh: 该风俗盛行于整个地区。
words.notes: [记] customs n. 海关；关税

words.example_en: Feudalism was not abolished in England until 1660.
words.example_zh: 英国直到1660年才废除封建制度。
words.notes: [记] feudal adj. 封建的

words.example_en: They thought slavery was morally wrong.
words.example_zh: 他们认为奴隶制在道德上是错误的。
words.notes: [记] slave n. 奴隶

words.example_en: You can’t divorce science from ethical questions.
words.example_zh: 不能把科学与伦理问题割裂开。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 道德上的；有道德的  n. [~s] 道德
words.example_en: The old gentleman claimed himself to be a very moral man, who had never told a lie in his life.
words.example_zh: 这位老先生称自己是个很有道德的人，一生中从未说过谎。
words.collocations: [搭] moral principles 道德准则  moral standards 道德水准
words.notes: [记] immoral adj. 不道德的

words.example_en: The tribe’s development was more primitive than that of their neighbours.
words.example_zh: 这部落所处的发展阶段比邻近部落更原始。
words.word_formation: 源自拉丁语tribus，卢梭在《社会契约论》中曾提到了其词源：古罗马成立时，人民由阿尔班人（Albain）、沙宾人（Sabin）和异邦人三种人构成，故把这三种人称为三个tribus（tri［三］+ bus［存在］→ 三个存在）。字根tribut也源自tribus，指“付（to pay），分配（to assign）”，在古罗马三个“部落”间分配、支付的贡物就是tribute（礼物；贡品）。其他同源词还有contribute（捐献，捐赠），distribute（分发），attribute（把……归因于；属性），tributary（支流）。

words.meaning_zh: n. [A~] 澳大利亚土著人  adj. 本土原有的；土著的
words.example_en: Many Aboriginals do not like the idea of a day to celebrate the British landing.
words.example_zh: 许多澳大利亚土著并不喜欢庆祝英国人登陆的日子。
words.notes: [记] original adj. 原本的，最初的  origin n. 起源

words.example_en: The local inhabitants do not like noisy tourists in summer.
words.example_zh: 当地居民不喜欢夏季喧闹的游客。
words.word_formation: in（进入）+ habit（持有，握住 → 居住）+ ant（后缀）→ 居民。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 本土的  n. 本地人
words.example_en: He is a native of Beijing.
words.example_zh: 他是北京本地人。
words.collocations: [搭] native to 原产自……的  native tongue 母语

words.meaning_zh: adj. 当地的  n. 当地人
words.example_en: He provided local delicacies for his guests.
words.example_zh: 他用当地的美味佳肴来招待客人。
words.notes: [记] localise (= localize) v. 使局部化

words.example_en: The exotic atmosphere will fascinate you.
words.example_zh: 这里具有异国情调的氛围将会把你迷住。
words.notes: 注意和erotic（色情的）区分开。exotic来源于希腊语exō（外面的），而erotic则源自希腊语eros（爱），也指希腊神话中的爱神厄洛斯（Eros）。厄洛斯是一位长有双翼的美少年，相当于罗马神话中的丘比特（Cupid）。

words.example_en: Some foreigners assimilate easily into our way of life.
words.example_zh: 有些外国人很容易被我们的生活方式同化。

words.meaning_zh: n. 外侨；外星生物  adj. 外国的；陌生的
words.example_en: I ran into an old friend in the alien land.
words.example_zh: 我在异国他乡遇到故知。
words.collocations: [搭] an alien culture 异域文化
words.notes: [记] alienate v. 使疏远，使不友好；离间

words.example_en: The anthropologist contrasted two cultures in his lecture.
words.example_zh: 这位人类学家在讲座中将两种文化进行了对比。
words.notes: [记] anthropology n. 人类学

words.meaning_zh: n. 人道主义者  adj. 人道主义的，博爱的
words.example_en: Hepburn is known as a great humanitarian.
words.example_zh: 大家都知道赫本是一位了不起的人道主义者。

words.example_en: They take great pride in their cultural heritage.
words.example_zh: 他们为自己的文化遗产深感自豪。

words.meaning_zh: 继承（财产等）；经遗传获得
words.example_en: He inherited a house from his father.
words.example_zh: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.notes: [记] inheritance n. 继承；遗产

words.meaning_zh: n. 古董  adj. 古董的
words.example_en: He wears designer clothes and drives an antique car.
words.example_zh: 他穿着著名设计师设计的服装，开着一辆古董车。

words.example_en: Archaeology is the study of ancient civilisations.
words.example_zh: 考古学研究古代文明。
words.notes: [记] archaeological adj. 考古学的  archaeologist n. 考古学家

words.example_en: It took a long time to excavate the ancient city of Troy.
words.example_zh: 挖掘古老的特洛伊城花了很长时间。
words.notes: [记] excavation n. 挖掘，发掘

words.example_en: A visit to the museum is an unforgettable experience.
words.example_zh: 参观这家博物馆是一段令人难忘的经历。
words.word_formation: 来自Muse（缪斯女神），um表示地点，故字面意思即缪斯女神的圣殿，也就是向缪斯女神学习的地方。该词在古希腊时期指学校、图书馆、艺术学校，现在仅指博物馆。

words.example_en: Modern pottery is usually ornamental.
words.example_zh: 现代陶器通常被用作装饰品。
words.notes: [记] pot n. 壶，罐子

words.example_en: The jeweller will engrave the inside of the ring with her name.
words.example_zh: 珠宝匠将在戒指的内表面上刻上她的名字。

words.example_en: Using extremely different decorating schemes in adjoining rooms may result in lack of unity in style.
words.example_zh: 相邻的房间用悬殊太大的装饰方案会导致风格不够统一。
words.collocations: [搭] decorate A with B 用B装饰A
words.notes: [记] decoration n. 装饰；装饰品  decorative adj. 装饰性的

words.example_en: There are many religions in the world.
words.example_zh: 在世界上有许多种宗教。
words.notes: [记] religious adj. 宗教的

words.example_en: The scientists found that personal involvement in a ritual is necessary.
words.example_zh: 科学家发现，亲自参与仪式是必要的。

words.example_en: He felt very sorry for his breach of etiquette.
words.example_zh: 他为他的失礼行为深感抱歉。
words.word_formation: 法语借词，原指“标签，签条”。法国宫廷礼节曾极为繁琐，故宫廷在举办活动前要发给参加的宾客一张纸片签条，上面写着需要遵守的宫廷礼节和穿着要求等。英语中的ticket（票，入场券）一词与该词同源，读音近似。

words.example_en: His firmness in his beliefs supported him through difficulties.
words.example_zh: 他坚定的信仰支撑着他渡过困境。
words.notes: [记] believe v. 相信；认为

words.example_en: No words can express the secret agony of my soul.
words.example_zh: 没有任何语言能够表达我心灵的隐痛。
words.collocations: [搭] put one’s heart and soul into sth. 全心全意地投入到某事中

words.example_en: We need a spirit of enterprise if we are to overcome our difficulties.
words.example_zh: 如果要克服困难，我们就要有进取精神。
words.notes: [记] spiritual adj. 精神上的

words.example_en: This area was hallowed by sacred memories.
words.example_zh: 这个地区因一些神圣的回忆而受尊崇。

words.example_en: The Ganges is hallowed as a sacred, cleansing river.
words.example_zh: 恒河被奉为有净化作用的圣河。

words.example_en: A holy person is spiritually pure.
words.example_zh: 圣洁的人在精神上十分纯洁。

words.example_en: The election of a new Pope is coming.
words.example_zh: 新教皇的选举即将到来。

words.example_en: I’ve heard a whisper that the Bishop intends to leave.
words.example_zh: 我听到有谣传说主教打算离开。

words.example_en: The missionary was sent to India last year.
words.example_zh: 这名传教士去年被派到印度。
words.notes: [记] mission n. 使命

words.example_en: The priest persuaded him to give up his bad habit.
words.example_zh: 牧师劝他放弃坏习惯。

words.example_en: The Bible begins with the Genesis.
words.example_zh: 《圣经》的开篇是《创世纪》。

words.example_en: I’m just going to the church to see the priest.
words.example_zh: 我正要去教堂见牧师。

words.example_en: This cathedral was regarded as a miracle in architectural history.
words.example_zh: 这座大教堂被认为是建筑史上的奇迹。

words.example_en: The choir sang the Amens beautifully.
words.example_zh: 唱诗班吟唱的“阿门”非常优美。

words.example_en: The man was a monk from Mount Emei.
words.example_zh: 那人是来自峨眉山的僧人。

words.example_en: The temple has been considered an example of classic design.
words.example_zh: 这座庙被视为古典设计的范例。

words.example_en: The pagoda perches on top of the hill.
words.example_zh: 佛塔立在山顶之上。

words.example_en: The empire had for years been falling into decadence.
words.example_zh: 这个帝国多年来一直在走向腐朽堕落。

words.example_en: They made an objection to the imperial system with resolution.
words.example_zh: 他们坚决反对这种帝国制度。

words.example_en: Britain has always had a large navy, called the Royal Navy.
words.example_zh: 英国一直有支强大的海军，被称为“皇家海军”。
words.notes: [记] royalty n. 王室成员，皇族

words.example_en: The Tang Dynasty is a period remarkable for its liberality.
words.example_zh: 唐朝是一段以开明著称的时期。

words.meaning_zh: 年表，事件发生顺序表；年代学
words.example_en: It seems that the paper has confused the chronology of these events.
words.example_zh: 这篇论文好像把这些事件发生的顺序搞混了。
words.word_formation: 字根 chron 意为“时间（time）”，如：chronology（年代学；年表），chronic（长期的，慢性的）。希腊神话中宙斯（Zeus）的父亲叫克洛诺斯（Cronos），因和希腊语中表示“时间”的词 chronos 在拼写和读音上很相似，后来被描述为时间之神。克洛诺斯害怕自己的子女推翻自己，曾吞食了自己的后代，就像时间的无情。正如谚语所说的：时间吞噬一切。

words.example_en: The emperor unified the country by the sword.
words.example_zh: 那位皇帝用武力统一了全国。

words.example_en: The king is the most important person in a kingdom.
words.example_zh: 国王是一个王国中最重要的人物。
words.notes: [记] kingdom n. 王国

words.example_en: They were bowing as the king and queen walked in.
words.example_zh: 当国王和王后进来时，他们屈膝致敬。

words.example_en: The prince fell in love with a fair young maiden.
words.example_zh: 王子爱上了一位年轻美丽的少女。

words.example_en: The princess was ostracised for marrying a rich bourgeois man.
words.example_zh: 公主因与一位富有的资本家结婚而遭到排斥。

words.example_en: I enjoyed all the majesty of royal ceremonies.
words.example_zh: 我很欣赏皇家仪典的富丽堂皇。
words.notes: [记] majestic adj. 宏伟的，庄严的

words.example_en: Virtue is the only true nobility.
words.example_zh: 万事不如美德高。
words.notes: [记] noble adj. 贵族的；高贵的 n. 贵族成员

words.meaning_zh: [英] 贵族；[L~]阁下，大人；[the L~]上帝
words.example_en: The young lord with the red-gold hair bowed, “As you command, Lord Edward.”
words.example_zh: 金红头发的年轻贵族鞠躬道：“悉听尊命，爱德大人。”

words.meaning_zh: n. 骑士 v. 封（某人）为爵士
words.example_en: He was knighted for his war services.
words.example_zh: 他因战功而被封为爵士。
words.notes: 在国际象棋（chess）中，knight代表“马”，其他棋子包括“车（rook/castle）”“象（bishop）”“兵（pawn）”等。从chess和Chinese chess（中国象棋）看东西方差异：chess中的king可以到处走，而中国象棋里的“将/帅”不出“宫”（九宫，象棋术语）；chess里有queen，可横竖斜着满棋盘跑，威力无穷，彪悍泼辣——西方历史上的女王统治屡见不鲜（著名的如英国女王、丹麦女王等），而中国象棋根本没有“后”这个棋子，在一定程度上反映了中国古代的父权封建制度。

words.meaning_zh: n. 保卫者；监护人 adj. 守护的
words.example_en: He became the legal guardian of his brother’s daughter.
words.example_zh: 他成为他侄女的合法监护人。
words.notes: [记] guard v. 保卫 n. 守卫。在英国很有影响力的一份报纸是《卫报》（The Guardian），且该报会刊登较权威的英国大学排名。

words.example_en: The soldiers were filled with nostalgia.
words.example_zh: 士兵们心中充满了乡愁。

words.example_en: My American friend tells me, she is never as homesick as during this time of year, around Thanksgiving.
words.example_zh: 我的美国朋友跟我说，每年的这段时间，即感恩节前后，是她最想家的时候。
words.notes: [记] homesickness n. 思乡情绪

words.example_en: Celebrity, money and possessions are too often the touchstones for teenagers.
words.example_zh: 名誉、金钱和财产常常成为青少年们衡量事物的标准。

words.example_en: Being an engineer gives him a high social status.
words.example_zh: 做工程师给了他很高的社会地位。
words.collocations: [搭] social status 社会地位

words.meaning_zh: 背景；（个人出身、受教育）经历
words.example_en: He is a man with a special cultural background.
words.example_zh: 他是拥有特殊文化背景的人。

words.example_en: It was a truly memorable experience.
words.example_zh: 这真是一段难忘的经历。
words.notes: [记] experienced adj. 经验丰富的

words.example_en: He preceded his lecture with a humorous anecdote.
words.example_zh: 他以一则幽默的轶事开始他的演说。
words.word_formation: 字根 don/dot 表示“给（to give）”，如：an（否定）+ ec（向外）+ dote（给）→ 没有给外面的，没有传到外面的事情 → anecdote（轶事，奇闻）；blood donor（给血的人→献血者）；par（完全的）+ don（给）→ 完全给予，诚恳地给予→pardon（原谅，宽恕）。

words.example_en: His left knee was hurt in a traffic accident.
words.example_zh: 他的左膝在一次交通事故中受伤了。
words.collocations: [搭] by accident 偶然  an aviation accident 航空器失事，空难
words.notes: [记] accidental adj. 意外的，偶然的；附属的

words.meaning_zh: （尤指不寻常的、重要的或暴力的）事件；（两国间的）冲突
words.example_en: A serious incident along the border increased our fears of war.
words.example_zh: 边境上的一起严重冲突使我们更加担心战争的爆发。
words.notes: [记] incidental adj. 附带的，次要的

words.meaning_zh: 繁荣，兴旺发达；茁壮生长
words.example_en: First thrive and then wive.
words.example_zh: 先立业，后成家。

words.example_en: The empire was on the wane after its period of prosperity.
words.example_zh: 帝国在历经繁盛以后逐渐衰落。
words.collocations: [搭] a business prosperity 商业繁荣
words.notes: [记] prosper v. 成功，繁荣  prosperous adj. 繁荣的

words.example_en: This setback has drained away my keenness.
words.example_zh: 这次挫折使我的热情荡然无存。
words.collocations: [搭] a business setback 生意上的挫折

words.example_en: Hardship disposes man to meet adversity.
words.example_zh: 艰难困苦使人愿意去克服逆境。

words.example_en: His misunderstanding of language was the primary cause of his other problems.
words.example_zh: 他对语言的误解是引起其他问题的主要原因。
words.collocations: [搭] body language 身体语言，肢体语言

words.example_en: To them, the monarchy is the special symbol of nationhood.
words.example_zh: 在他们看来，君主制是独立国地位的特殊象征。
words.notes: [记] symbolise (= symbolize) v. 象征

words.meaning_zh: n. 符号；征兆，迹象；手势  v. 签（名）
words.example_en: He made a sign for me to follow him.
words.example_zh: 他打了个手势，让我跟着他。
words.collocations: [搭] sign up to do sth. 同意参与某事
words.notes: [记] assign v. 指派；分配

words.example_en: He put his arm round her in a protective gesture.
words.example_zh: 他用一只手臂围住她，做出保护的姿势。

words.example_en: The address was in Anna’s handwriting.
words.example_zh: 地址是安娜的笔迹。

words.example_en: Generally speaking, the pictograph is the first text.
words.example_zh: 一般而言，象形文字是最早的文字。

words.example_en: Put a wedge under the door so that it will stay open.
words.example_zh: 在门底下塞一块楔子，让门能保持开着。
words.notes: [记] wedgy adj. 楔形的

words.example_en: He made a knot in the rope.
words.example_zh: 他在绳子上打了个结。
words.collocations: [搭] cut the knot 快刀斩乱麻

words.example_en: He is engaged in the studies of linguistics.
words.example_zh: 他从事于语言学的研究。
words.notes: [记] linguistic adj. 语言的

words.example_en: There are two kinds of puns, phonetic pun and semantic pun.
words.example_zh: 双关语分为谐音双关和语义双关两类。

words.example_en: Let’s investigate the syntax of Chinese.
words.example_zh: 让我们研究一下汉语的句法。

words.example_en: He was known for his poor grammar and punctuation.
words.example_zh: 他不通语法和标点的用法，这是出了名的。
words.notes: [记] grammatical adj. 语法上的

words.example_en: Daniel Jones is generally referred to be the foremost authority on phonetics.
words.example_zh: 丹尼尔·琼斯通常被认为是语音学方面最具权威性的人。
words.notes: [记] phonetic adj. 语音的

words.example_en: Did I pronounce your name correctly?
words.example_zh: 我念对你的名字了吗？
words.notes: [记] pronunciation n. 发音  pronounced adj. 显著的；表达明确的

words.example_en: Some questions are spoken with a rising intonation.
words.example_zh: 一些疑问句是以升调说出来的。

words.example_en: She spoke in a low voice, always without inflection.
words.example_zh: 她的嗓音低，说话总是毫无抑扬变化。

words.example_en: The dialect is spoken principally in the southern areas.
words.example_zh: 这种方言主要在南部地区使用。
words.word_formation: dia（在……之间）+ lect（说）→人与人之间的对话交流 → 区域性的语言 → 方言。

words.example_en: He speaks with a strong southern accent.
words.example_zh: 他说话带有很浓的南方口音。
words.word_formation: ac（加强意义）+ cent（歌唱），源自从希腊语借译过来的拉丁语单词。希腊原词可能指古希腊诗篇中的音高安排，进而得来“某种特定的发音”或“用于强调某音节的东西”之义，引申得来“重音；口音；读音符号”的含义。

words.example_en: His every utterance will be scrutinised.
words.example_zh: 他说的每句话都会被仔细审查。

words.example_en: Students of English should have a lot of oral drills.
words.example_zh: 学英语的学生应多做口头练习。

words.example_en: Don’t be afraid of verbal abuse or criticism.
words.example_zh: 不要害怕口头上的辱骂或批评。
words.notes: [记] nonverbal adj. 不用语言的

words.example_en: The stress is on the last syllable.
words.example_zh: 重音在最后一个音节上。

words.example_en: In actual speech, a phoneme is realised phonetically as a certain phone.
words.example_zh: 在实际会话中，音位以某个音素的形式通过语音体现出来。

words.example_en: Each language has a different vowel system.
words.example_zh: 每种语言都有不同的元音系统。

words.example_en: These are common consonant clusters at the beginning of words.
words.example_zh: 这些是单词开头常见的辅音组合。

words.meaning_zh: 字母表，（一种语言的）全部字母
words.example_en: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.
words.example_zh: 在英语字母表中，Q 在 P 和 R 之间。
words.notes: [记] alphabetical adj. 按字母表顺序的

words.example_en: ACP is the logogram of English of the African, Caribbean and Pacific states.
words.example_zh: ACP 是非洲国家、加勒比海国家和太平洋国家的英文缩记符。

words.example_en: His vocabulary was sound and his grammar was excellent.
words.example_zh: 他的词汇丰富，语法也很精通。
words.word_formation: 来自 voc（声音），词源同 voice。

words.example_en: The dictionary is a vast treasure trove of information.
words.example_zh: 那本词典是巨大的信息宝库。
words.notes: [记] diction n. 吐字；措辞

words.example_en: “Never too old to learn” is an idiom.
words.example_zh: “活到老，学到老”是个习语。

words.example_en: The phrase was not meant to be taken seriously.
words.example_zh: 这说法是不必当真的。

words.example_en: A confidentiality clause was added to the contract.
words.example_zh: 合同内加了一条保密条款。

words.example_en: Her expression of gratitude was simple and touching.
words.example_zh: 她把感激之情表达得简单而动人。
words.notes: [记] express v. 表达

words.meaning_zh: n. 时态  adj. 紧张的
words.example_en: Dart, who had at first been very tense, at last relaxed.
words.example_zh: 达特起初非常紧张，最后放松下来。
words.notes: [记] tension n. 张力，拉力；紧张，不安 v. 拉紧

words.example_en: The word “intoxicated” comes from the same root as the word “detoxify”.
words.example_zh: 单词 intoxicated 和单词 detoxify 有同样的字根。

words.example_en: To make calls from Canada, use the prefix 01133 before the numbers given here.
words.example_zh: 如果从加拿大打电话过来，要在我们给的号码前加拨01133。

words.example_en: These ships were all numbered with the same suffix.
words.example_zh: 这些船都有编号，且尾标是一样的。

words.example_en: BBC is an abbreviation for British Broadcasting Corporation.
words.example_zh: BBC 是“英国广播公司”的缩写。
words.notes: [记] abbreviate v. 缩写，缩简

words.example_en: Don’t mix up this pair of synonyms.
words.example_zh: 不要混淆这对同义词。

words.example_en: “Happy” is an antonym of “sad”.
words.example_zh: “快乐”是“悲伤”的反义词。

words.example_en: The word “person” is a countable noun.
words.example_zh: person 这个词是个可数名词。

words.meaning_zh: n. 单数  adj. 单数的；非凡的
words.example_en: The young man has a singular ear for music.
words.example_zh: 这个年轻人对音乐有非凡的鉴赏力。
words.notes: [记] single adj. 单个的

words.meaning_zh: n. 复数  adj. 复数的；多元的
words.example_en: A plural marriage is forbidden by many countries.
words.example_zh: 一夫多妻或一妻多夫形式的婚姻被许多国家禁止。
words.collocations: [搭] a plural society 多元社会
words.notes: [记] pluralism n. 多元主义；多元化；兼职

words.example_en: He always put the stress on the pronoun.
words.example_zh: 他总是重读代词。

words.example_en: A sentence usually contains a subject and a verb.
words.example_zh: 一个句子通常包含主语和动词。

words.example_en: The function of an adjective is to describe or add to the meaning of a noun.
words.example_zh: 形容词的作用是描述某个名词或对其含义进行补充说明。

words.example_en: Adverb is to describe a verb or an action.
words.example_zh: 副词是用来描述一个动词或动作的。

words.example_en: You should cross out this preposition in the sentence.
words.example_zh: 你应该删去句子中的这个介词。
words.notes: [记] position n. 位置

words.example_en: The word is a temporal conjunction.
words.example_zh: 该词是表示时间的连词。
words.notes: [记] junction n. 汇合处；交叉路口

words.meaning_zh: 一致的；（观点或看法）连贯的
words.example_en: The policies which will be put into place are clear and consistent.
words.example_zh: 将要实施的这些政策内容清楚连贯。
words.collocations: [搭] be consistent with 与……一致
words.notes: [记] inconsistent adj. 不一致的  consist v. 由……组成

words.example_en: The business is a large, complicated organism.
words.example_zh: 该企业是一个大而复杂的有机组织。
words.notes: [记] complicate v. 使复杂化

words.example_en: As tools have become more and more complex, we need more complex controls to control them.
words.example_zh: 随着工具变得越来越复杂，我们需要更复杂的操控装置来控制它们。

words.example_en: It takes years of hard work to compile a good dictionary.
words.example_zh: 编纂一部好词典需要数年的艰苦工作。

words.example_en: These books are Chinese versions of Shakespeare.
words.example_zh: 这些书是莎士比亚作品的中文译本。

words.example_en: No matter how well a poem is translated, something of the spirit of the original work is lost.
words.example_zh: 无论一首诗被翻译得多好，原作中的一些神韵也会丢失。
words.collocations: [搭] translate from Chinese into English 从中文翻译成英文
words.notes: [记] translator n. 翻译者

words.example_en: The teacher asked his students to paraphrase the long sentence.
words.example_zh: 老师让学生改述这个长句。

words.meaning_zh: 口译；解释，说明；领会，理解
words.example_en: He interpreted the silence as contempt.
words.example_zh: 他把这沉默看作轻蔑的表示。
words.notes: [记] interpretation n. 口译；解释  interpreter n. 口译员

words.example_en: The sailor narrated his life story to me in the tavern.
words.example_zh: 那个水手在酒馆里向我讲述了他的人生经历。
words.notes: [记] narration n. 叙述，讲述

words.example_en: I use pictures and drawings to illuminate our subject.
words.example_zh: 我们用照片和图画来阐明主题。
words.word_formation: 前缀 il 表示“进入”，字根 lumin 表示“光”。本义是“照亮”，引申义是“阐释，说明”。

words.example_en: We can decipher the code intercepted by the broadcasting station.
words.example_zh: 我们能破译电台截获的密码。

words.example_en: The audience are struck by her simple, spellbinding eloquence.
words.example_zh: 观众们被她那简洁、迷人的雄辩打动了。
words.notes: [记] eloquent adj. 雄辩的，有才智的

words.example_en: We communicated mostly by e-mail.
words.example_zh: 我们主要通过电子邮件来交流。
words.collocations: [搭] communicate with 与……沟通
words.notes: [记] communication n. 通信；交流

words.example_en: After a lot of discussion among the directors, the matter was settled in the end.
words.example_zh: 经过董事们的大量讨论，问题最终得到解决。
words.word_formation: 字根 cuss 表示“摇（to shake）”，如：dis（分开）+ cuss（摇）→ 摇散 → 意见不一 → discuss（讨论）；per（完全的）+ cuss（摇）→ percuss（轻敲）；percussion（打击乐器）。
words.notes: [记] discuss v. 讨论

words.meaning_zh: n. 集体自由讨论，头脑风暴  v. 集思广益，进行头脑风暴
words.example_en: Managers get together and brainstorm a more permanent solution to the problem.
words.example_zh: 经理们聚在一起，群策群力，设法找到一个更长久的解决办法。

words.example_en: The government is debating about the education laws.
words.example_zh: 政府正在就教育法进行讨论。
words.collocations: [搭] debate about/on/upon sth. 就某事物进行讨论  have a debate with sb. 与某人进行辩论
words.notes: [记] debatable adj. 有争议的

words.meaning_zh: 评论，评注；批评；实况报道
words.example_en: The conclusion of the commentary really hit the bull’s-eye.
words.example_zh: 评论最后的结论真是一语破的。
words.notes: [记] comment n. 意见，评论 v. 发表意见，评论

words.example_en: We are not about to negotiate with terrorists.
words.example_zh: 我们是不会和恐怖分子谈判的。
words.collocations: [搭] negotiate about 就……进行协商
words.notes: [记] negotiation n. 协商，谈判

words.example_en: My contention is that the scheme will never work.
words.example_zh: 我的观点是这个方案行不通。
words.notes: [记] content n. 内容

words.meaning_zh: n. 媒介  adj. 中间的，中等的
words.example_en: Present’s speech was broadcast through the medium of television.
words.example_zh: 总统的演说通过电视媒介播送。
words.notes: [记] multimedia n. 多媒体  mediator n. 斡旋者  media n. 大众传播媒介，媒体（如电视、广播等）

words.meaning_zh: 新闻界，记者；报刊；出版社
words.example_en: The power of the press is very great.
words.example_zh: 新闻界的力量非常大。
words.word_formation: 字根 press 指“压”。单词 press 作动词时有“挤压”的含义，同源词又如：compress（大家一起压 → 压紧，压缩），depress（向下压 → 使沮丧；使萧条），express（挤压出来 → 表示；快递服务），impress（压进去 → 给……留下印象）。

words.example_en: No journalist was bold enough to challenge the Prime Minister.
words.example_zh: 没有一个记者大胆到敢挑战首相。
words.word_formation: 源自法语，法语中的 journal 表示“每天的：日记，日志；日报”，而“期刊，杂志”的含义是后来引申来的。所以 journalist 就是“把每天发生的事情都记录下来的人”，journalism 是这样的行业，即“新闻业”。

words.example_en: The critics said the new movie would not do well at the box office.
words.example_zh: 评论家说那部新电影的票房不会太好。
words.collocations: [搭] a movie critic 影评人  a theatre critic 剧评家
words.word_formation: 字根 crit 指“判断（to judge）”，如：crit（判断）+ erion（名词后缀）→判断的东西，判断的依据→criterion（标准）。
words.notes: [记] critical adj. 批评的；挑剔的  criticism n. 批评，指责  criticise (= criticize) v. 批评

words.example_en: I enjoy this sports commentator’s commentaries very much.
words.example_zh: 我非常喜欢这位体育运动实况解说员的解说。

words.example_en: He is an exponent of the opinions of Einstein.
words.example_zh: 他是爱因斯坦理论的拥护者。

words.example_en: The announcer started with the day’s top stories.
words.example_zh: 播音员一上来就播报了一天中的头条新闻。
words.notes: [记] announce v. 宣布；播报

words.example_en: That war correspondent proudly outgunned the army sharpshooters.
words.example_zh: 那位战地记者比军队神枪手的枪法还准，觉得很自豪。
words.collocations: [搭] a war correspondent 战地记者

words.example_en: The messenger brought your note today.
words.example_zh: 信使今天带来了给你的短笺。
words.notes: [记] message n. 信息 v. 给……发（电子）信息

words.meaning_zh: 编辑，校订者；（电台或电视台的）记者，编辑
words.example_en: She gave the editor a dishonest account of this event.
words.example_zh: 她给了记者一份有关该事件的不实叙述。
words.collocations: [搭] chief editor 主编，总编
words.notes: [记] edit v. 编辑，校订；剪辑

words.example_en: The two typists have already worked all day.
words.example_zh: 这两位打字员已经工作一整天了。
words.collocations: [搭] a shorthand typist 速记打字员
words.notes: [记] type v. 打字

words.example_en: Please read the handout carefully.
words.example_zh: 请仔细阅读这份讲义。

words.meaning_zh: n. 传单  v. 散发传单
words.example_en: We were paid to leaflet advertisements in the shopping mall.
words.example_zh: 有人雇我们在购物中心发放广告传单。

words.example_en: These reports clearly contain elements of propaganda.
words.example_zh: 这些报道明显含有一些宣传元素。

words.example_en: News of the pop star’s sudden death was not published for several days.
words.example_zh: 那位明星突然死亡的消息有好几天没有公布。
words.notes: [记] public n. 公众 adj. 公众的  publicity n. 关注，宣传  publication n. 出版物；出版，发行

words.example_en: The agency would collect and disseminate information.
words.example_zh: 通讯社会收集和传播信息。

words.example_en: They cannot foresee how things will turn out.
words.example_zh: 他们不可能预知事情的结果。
words.word_formation: 前缀 fore 表示“前面的”，如：foresee（预见），forearm（前臂），forebear（以前生[bear]的人→祖先），forefather（爸爸之前的爸爸→祖先）。

words.example_en: Sales are better than they have anticipated.
words.example_zh: 销售情况比他们预想的好。
words.notes: [记] participate v. 参与

words.example_en: The managers expect exceptional sales growth in the last quarter.
words.example_zh: 经理们预期在最后一个季度会出现极好的销售增长。
words.notes: [记] expectation n. 期待，期望

words.meaning_zh: 等候，期待；将降临到……身上
words.example_en: If you are lucky enough to vacation in the Alps, what delights will await you?
words.example_zh: 如果你有幸到阿尔卑斯山度假的话，有什么乐事会等着你呢？

words.example_en: Listening to music is the favourite pastime of many people all over the world.
words.example_zh: 听音乐是全世界许多人最喜爱的消遣。

words.example_en: This television programme is designed to educate and to entertain as well.
words.example_zh: 这台电视节目旨在又有教育作用，又能让大家快乐。
words.notes: [记] entertainment n. 娱乐，消遣；款待

words.example_en: She is in charge of recreation.
words.example_zh: 她负责娱乐活动。
words.collocations: [搭] a recreation ground 公共娱乐场

words.example_en: Harry makes up funny stories to amuse his little brother.
words.example_zh: 哈利编有趣的故事来逗他的弟弟。
words.collocations: [搭] amuse oneself 自娱自乐
words.word_formation: 可能与缪斯（Muse）有关，即司历史、音乐、文学等的九位女神之一。动词 muse 有“沉思”之义，而 amuse 最初是指“使沉思”“使目不转睛地盯着”。amusement park 是“游乐场”，猜猜下面这些词对应的英语表达：过山车，碰碰车，摩天轮，旋转木马。这些都是现在小学英语课本收录的词语：roller coaster，bumper car，big wheel / Ferris wheel，merry-go-round。

words.example_en: I’ve read about it in the gossip column.
words.example_zh: 我在八卦栏目曾看过有关这件事的报道。

words.example_en: The rumour soon swept the entire company.
words.example_zh: 谣言很快传遍了全公司。
words.notes: (= rumor) 注意拼写：rumour = rumor；humour = humor。联想记忆：rude humour（粗鲁的幽默）→ rumour（谣言）。与 gossip 的区别：gossip 指“流言，八卦消息”，如 celebrity gossip 就是“名人的八卦新闻”。

words.example_en: Could we reach a consensus on this issue? Let’s take a vote.
words.example_zh: 我们能在该问题上达成一致吗？让我们来投票表决吧。

words.example_en: This music festival will feature fireworks, live music, and barbecue.
words.example_zh: 这音乐节上将有烟花表演、现场音乐表演和烧烤野餐。

words.example_en: The feast was served by his mother and sisters.
words.example_zh: 这顿美餐是他母亲和他的姐妹们准备的。

words.meaning_zh: (= program) n. 节目；方案；（演出或活动的）程序  v. 为（系统）设定程序；计划
words.example_en: There was an interesting programme on TV yesterday.
words.example_zh: 昨天有个很有趣的电视节目。
words.notes: [记] programmer n. 程序设计员

words.example_en: The play is in rehearsal now.
words.example_zh: 这出戏正在排演中。

words.example_en: A jazz band will perform live at tomorrow’s party.
words.example_zh: 一个爵士乐队将在明天的聚会上进行现场表演。

words.example_en: He imitates other people to perfection.
words.example_zh: 他模仿别人模仿得惟妙惟肖。

words.example_en: He mimicked the teacher’s accent.
words.example_zh: 他模仿老师的口音。

words.example_en: We can use computers to simulate many situations.
words.example_zh: 我们可以用计算机模拟各种情况。
words.notes: [记] simulative adj. 模拟的；假装的

words.meaning_zh: 马戏团；圆形广场（常用于地名）
words.example_en: Last Christmas, the circus owner decided to take some presents to a children’s hospital.
words.example_zh: 去年圣诞节，马戏团老板决定给一家儿童医院送些礼物。
words.collocations: [搭] a circus clown 马戏团小丑

words.example_en: The magician thrilled his audience with his magic.
words.example_zh: 魔术师用他的魔术使观众们激动万分。

words.example_en: My brother was studying a course in drama at university.
words.example_zh: 我哥哥正在大学里学习戏剧课程。
words.notes: [记] dramatic adj. 戏剧性的

words.example_en: Various performers will present a concert to raise money for AIDS charities.
words.example_zh: 众多表演艺术家将会出席一场音乐会来为艾滋病慈善机构募捐。
words.collocations: [搭] in concert with 与……合作
words.notes: [记] musicale n. 社交音乐会  concertmaster n. 首席小提琴手  concertgoer n. 常去听音乐会者  concerto n. 协奏曲  conductor n.（管弦乐队、合唱团等的）指挥  melody n. 旋律  rhythm n. 节奏  lyrics n. 歌词  score n. 总谱

words.example_en: The Royal Stockholm Philharmonic Orchestra played Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony.
words.example_zh: 皇家斯德哥尔摩爱乐乐团演奏了贝多芬的《第九交响曲》。

words.example_en: This orchestra has been established under the patronage of the government.
words.example_zh: 这个管弦乐队是在政府的赞助下成立的。

words.example_en: I wanted to be a ballet dancer when I was a child.
words.example_zh: 当我还是个孩子时，我想成为芭蕾舞演员。
words.collocations: [搭] ice ballet 冰上芭蕾  water ballet 水上芭蕾  Swan Lake 即著名的芭蕾舞剧《天鹅湖》。

words.example_en: She joined the Royal Opera House the following year.
words.example_zh: 她于次年加入了皇家歌剧院。
words.collocations: [搭] Beijing/Peking opera 京剧

words.example_en: Dwayne Johnson talked about his experiences of starring in comedies.
words.example_zh: 道恩·强森谈论了自己主演喜剧片的经历。

words.example_en: She was too exhausted and distressed to talk about the tragedy.
words.example_zh: 她太累了，而且无比悲伤，没法谈论那场悲剧。

words.example_en: It is this cartoon that brought the animation industry back from the dead.
words.example_zh: 正是这部卡通片使动画产业起死回生。

words.example_en: A good film will be on this weekend.
words.example_zh: 这周末会有一部精彩的电影上映。

words.example_en: This movie was hyped up in the media before it was screened.
words.example_zh: 这部影片在上映前被媒体大肆吹捧了一番。

words.example_en: When Logan was showed in cinema, it was X-rated.
words.example_zh: 《金刚狼3》在电影院上映时被定为了X级。

words.example_en: He was not the kind of artist who could work collaboratively.
words.example_zh: 他不是那种能够与人合作的艺术家。
words.notes: [记] art n. 艺术  artistic adj. 艺术的；艺术家的

words.example_en: The original designs were made by highly skilled craftsmen.
words.example_zh: 原始的图案是由技艺高超的工匠绘制的。
words.notes: [记] craft n. 工艺 v. 精心制作

words.example_en: This painter is not first-class.
words.example_zh: 这位画家并非一流。

words.example_en: I played the role of the mean aunt in the play.
words.example_zh: 我在剧中扮演了刻薄的姨母这一角色。
words.collocations: [搭] play a role in 在……中起作用

words.example_en: The scene is perfect when you see the sun rising slowly in the east.
words.example_zh: 观看太阳从东方慢慢升起，这种景色太美了。

words.meaning_zh: 舞台；阶段；[the ~] 戏剧演出
words.example_en: Each stage of the battle was carried off flawlessly.
words.example_zh: 战斗的每个阶段都进展顺利。

words.example_en: The pictures in the gallery were well spaced out.
words.example_zh: 画廊中各幅画的间隔安排得很好。

words.example_en: They are coming to the exhibition as my guests.
words.example_zh: 他们作为我邀请的客人来参观展览。

words.meaning_zh: (= esthetic) adj. 审美的  n. 审美观
words.example_en: His aesthetic standards are quite different from mine.
words.example_zh: 他的审美标准与我的相当不同。

words.example_en: He used to collect stamps, but now he likes to collect coins.
words.example_zh: 他以前收集邮票，现在却喜欢收集硬币。
words.notes: [记] collection n. 收集；收藏品

words.meaning_zh: v. 选择，挑选  adj. 精选的
words.example_en: They were selected from many applicants.
words.example_zh: 他们是从许多申请人中选出来的。
words.notes: [记] selection n. 选择

words.example_en: My aunt opted for early retirement.
words.example_zh: 我姑姑选择了提早退休。
words.collocations: [搭] opt for sth. 选择某事物
words.notes: [记] option n. 选择；选择权

words.example_en: His photograph showed how the plant turned out.
words.example_zh: 他的照片展示了这株植物长成了什么样。
words.word_formation: gram/graph(y) 指“写（to write），画（to draw）”，如：grammar（书写的方法→语法）；bio（生命）+ graphy（写）→书写生命→biography（传记）；photo（光）+ graphy（写，画）→用光来描绘→photography（摄影，照相术）。
words.notes: [记] photographic adj. 摄影的，摄制的

words.example_en: Her portrait hangs in the lobby of the library.
words.example_zh: 她的肖像挂在图书馆的大厅里。

words.example_en: This painting is invaluable.
words.example_zh: 这幅画是非常珍贵的。

words.example_en: The smooth contour of the sculpture is wonderful.
words.example_zh: 这座雕塑流畅的轮廓线真是太美了。

words.example_en: Draw a line with a ruler.
words.example_zh: 用尺子画一条线。
words.notes: [记] drawing n. 图画，素描画；绘图（技巧）

words.meaning_zh: n. 素描，速写，草图  v. 画素描，画速写
words.example_en: I sketched the cat sleeping in the yard.
words.example_zh: 我给正在院子里睡觉的那只猫画了个速写。
words.collocations: [搭] sketch out 画出……的轮廓；简略地叙述

words.example_en: In this new biography, she is depicted as a lonely and unhappy woman.
words.example_zh: 在这本新的传记中，她被描写为孤独且不快乐的女人。
words.word_formation: 字根 pict 指“画（to paint）”，如：depict（画下来→描绘；描写），pictograph（用画画来写字→象形文字），picture（画；照片）。

words.example_en: Words cannot describe the beauty of the scene.
words.example_zh: 语言难以描述出这景色的优美。
words.notes: [记] description n. 描述

words.example_en: The statue was carved out of marble.
words.example_zh: 这尊雕塑是用大理石雕成的。
words.collocations: [搭] carve up 瓜分，划分

words.example_en: If an actor forgets his lines on stage, he has to improvise.
words.example_zh: 如果一个演员在舞台上忘了台词，他就不得不即兴发挥。
words.word_formation: im（否定）+ pro（预先）+ vise（看见）→ 预先没有看见→即兴创作；临时做。字根 vis(e) 指“看见（to see）”，如：provision（事先看到→供应；预备），previse（预见），supervise（从上往下看→监督；管理）。
words.notes: [记] improvisation n. 即兴创作

words.example_en: The drum is one of the oldest musical instruments.
words.example_zh: 鼓是最古老的乐器之一。
words.notes: [记] musician n. 音乐家，作曲家

words.example_en: Beethoven is regarded as one of the immortals of classical music.
words.example_zh: 贝多芬被认为是古典音乐界的不朽人物之一。

words.example_en: He is well versed in many styles of jazz.
words.example_zh: 他精通多种风格的爵士乐。

words.example_en: Glam rock developed in the early 1970s and David Bowie was one of the most influential glam rock artists.
words.example_zh: 华丽摇滚发展于20世纪70年代早期，大卫·鲍伊是最具影响力的华丽摇滚艺术家之一。

words.example_en: Hip-hop singers like to wear bling-bling in their music videos to look fancy.
words.example_zh: 在音乐录影带里，嘻哈歌手喜欢穿得珠光宝气，让自己看起来很炫。

words.example_en: The radio had fed him a stream of pop songs.
words.example_zh: 他从广播里听到了一连串流行歌曲。
words.word_formation: pop 表示“流行音乐”时源自 popular（流行的）。pop 还可表示“发砰声；爆裂；突然出现”，这些词义源自拟声。

words.meaning_zh: n. 抒情诗；[~s] 歌词  adj. 抒情的
words.example_en: I don’t understand the lyrics, which are in French, but the song sounds peaceful.
words.example_zh: 我听不懂法语歌词，但是这首歌听起来让人感觉很宁静。

words.example_en: The band will play on request.
words.example_zh: 该乐队会按点播要求演奏节目。

words.meaning_zh: n. 独奏，独唱  adj. 独奏的，独唱的；单独的
words.example_en: She has acquired a reputation as this country’s premier solo violinist.
words.example_zh: 她赢得了该国首席小提琴独奏家的名誉。

words.example_en: I like that song, because its melody is really pleasant.
words.example_zh: 我喜欢那首歌，因为它的旋律十分悦耳。

words.example_en: I can’t dance to music without a good rhythm.
words.example_zh: 没有好的节奏我就不能跟着音乐跳舞。
words.notes: [记] rhythmical adj. 有节奏的，有韵律的  目前较流行的音乐曲风 R & B 指的就是“rhythm and blues”，即“节奏布鲁斯”。

words.example_en: This violin has a very good tone.
words.example_zh: 这把小提琴的音色很好。

words.meaning_zh: n. 曲调；短乐曲  v. 调试
words.example_en: The violin seems to be out of tune.
words.example_zh: 小提琴的声音好像走调了。
words.notes: [记] tuner n. 调音者

words.meaning_zh: (= disk) n. 光碟；唱片；[英]（计算机）磁碟，磁盘
words.example_en: There is no disc that interest me.
words.example_zh: 这里没有一张碟片让我感兴趣。

words.example_en: He started to learn the piano when he was very young.
words.example_zh: 他很小的时候就开始学习钢琴了。

words.example_en: The violin is not quite in tune with the piano.
words.example_zh: 小提琴跟钢琴的调子不太和谐。

words.example_en: She plays the cello in an orchestra.
words.example_zh: 她在管弦乐队中演奏大提琴。

words.example_en: She strummed her guitar, singing her own song.
words.example_zh: 她弹着吉他，唱着自己写的歌。

words.example_en: He played a tune on his harmonica.
words.example_zh: 他用口琴吹奏了一支曲子。

words.example_en: His performance as a trumpet player was quite revolutionary.
words.example_zh: 他作为小号手的演奏独具一格。

words.example_en: The drum beats were steady and slow.
words.example_zh: 鼓声平稳而缓慢。

words.example_en: The long-drawn-out sound of a flute is coming from far to near.
words.example_zh: 悠长的笛声由远而近。

words.example_en: There is a rise in unemployment, so the competition for jobs is very fierce.
words.example_zh: 失业人数上升了，所以求职竞争十分激烈。
words.notes: [记] compete v. 竞争  competitor n. 竞争者，对手

words.example_en: He has 65 tournament wins to his name.
words.example_zh: 他获得过65次联赛冠军。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 奥林匹克运动会的  n. [the ~s] 奥林匹克运动会
words.example_en: The most important part of the Olympics is to participate rather than to win.
words.example_zh: 在奥林匹克运动会中，最重要的是参与，而不是取胜。

words.meaning_zh: n. 发起人；主办人；赞助人  v. 发起；主办；赞助
words.example_en: The company had sponsored the football match.
words.example_zh: 公司已为这场足球赛提供了赞助。
words.notes: [记] sponsorship n. 资助

words.example_en: A wealthy patron has promised to send him to study overseas.
words.example_zh: 一个富有的赞助人答应要送他出国留学。

words.example_en: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in primary school.
words.example_zh: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。
words.notes: [记] athletics n. 体育运动；田径运动

words.meaning_zh: n. 冠军，第一名  v. 拥护，支持
words.example_en: As the defending champion, she is expected to reach the final.
words.example_zh: 作为卫冕冠军，人们预计她会进入决赛。
words.word_formation: 字根 champ/camp 指“场地（field）”，所以 camp 作名词时指“营地”，作动词时指“宿营”，summer camp 是“夏令营”。campus 指“校园”，可记忆为：camp（营地）+ us（我们）→我们的营地→校园。campaign（战役；运动）原表示“在开阔的土地上的军事行动”，而 champion 源自“在战场上战斗的人；（古罗马）角斗士”。
words.notes: [记] championship n. 冠军地位；锦标赛

words.example_en: The match attracted over 40,000 spectators.
words.example_zh: 这场比赛吸引了4万多名观众。
words.notes: audience 表示“观众”时主要指戏剧、音乐会等室内活动的观众或听众，强调“听”，而 spectator 主要指体育比赛（常指室外体育活动）的观看者，强调“看”。

words.meaning_zh: n. 志愿者  v. 自愿做
words.example_en: Many people volunteer to work on the farms.
words.example_zh: 许多人自愿到农场劳动。
words.word_formation: 字根 volunt 指“意志，意愿（will）”，源自拉丁语 voluntas，表示“自由意志（free will）”。按自己意愿做事的人就是“志愿者”。

words.example_en: Wuthering Heights is one of the most famous novels in the world.
words.example_zh: 《呼啸山庄》是世界上最著名的小说之一。
words.collocations: [搭] be famous for 以……闻名
words.notes: [记] fame n. 名声

words.example_en: The writer is well-known for his prolific works.
words.example_zh: 该作家因其创作的大量作品而闻名。

words.meaning_zh: 充满活力的，精力充沛的
words.example_en: He is an energetic basketball player.
words.example_zh: 他是一名精力充沛的篮球运动员。
words.notes: [记] energy n. 精力，活力；能量

words.meaning_zh: 充满活力的；活跃的，积极的
words.example_en: Our attack was very vigorous and the enemy retreated back to the river bank.
words.example_zh: 我方的进攻很猛烈，敌人撤退到了河岸。
words.word_formation: 字根 vig 指“有生气的（lively）”。
words.notes: [记] vigour (= vigor) n. 精力，活力

words.example_en: The stadium has been fitted with seating for 100,000 spectators.
words.example_zh: 这个体育场配备了10万个观众座席。

words.meaning_zh: 体育活动；(= gymnasium) 健身房，体育馆
words.example_en: Both able-bodied and disabled people can use this gym.
words.example_zh: 健全人士和残障人士都可使用这家健身房。
words.word_formation: 源自希腊语 gymnasion（进行体育训练的地方），该词又源自 gymnazein（赤裸着身体进行训练）。古希腊运动员曾有在训练和比赛时赤身裸体的传统。所以从字面上讲：gymnast（体操运动员）是“做体操运动的人”；gymnastics（体操）是“裸体运动”；gym（gymnasium）当然就是“裸体运动的地方”啦。

words.example_en: Training is a prerequisite for competence.
words.example_zh: 接受训练是掌握技能的前提。

words.meaning_zh: n. 锻炼，运动；习题，练习  v. 锻炼
words.example_en: Swimming is probably the best form of exercise you can get.
words.example_zh: 游泳或许是你能进行的最佳锻炼方式。

words.example_en: Billiards is a good indoor game.
words.example_zh: 台球是不错的室内游戏。
words.notes: [记] indoors adv. 在室内

words.example_en: If you enjoy outdoor activities, this is the trip for you.
words.example_zh: 如果你喜欢户外运动，这个旅行很适合你。
words.notes: [记] outdoors adv. 在室外，在户外

words.example_en: She motioned for us to hide ourselves.
words.example_zh: 她示意我们躲藏起来。

words.example_en: The mobile phone business actually was the company’s bread and butter.
words.example_zh: 该公司的主业实际上是移动电话业务。

words.example_en: Her every movement is very graceful.
words.example_zh: 她的一举一动都很优美。
words.notes: [记] move v. 移动

words.example_en: Some people practise yoga to aid relaxation.
words.example_zh: 有些人通过练瑜伽来帮助放松。

words.meaning_zh: v. 伸开四肢坐着（或躺着）；延伸，蔓延  n.（城市）杂乱无序扩展的地区
words.example_en: He sprawled on the sofa.
words.example_zh: 他手脚摊开，躺在沙发上。

words.example_en: He stretched out his hand, reaching for a book.
words.example_zh: 他伸出手，去拿一本书。

words.meaning_zh: v. 拉紧；拉伤，扭伤  n. 张力，拉力；（精神上的）紧张
words.example_en: I strained my back when I lifted the box.
words.example_zh: 我抬箱子的时候拉伤了背。

words.example_en: Games like chess are intellectual pursuits.
words.example_zh: 棋类比赛是费脑力的娱乐活动。

words.example_en: Badminton can be played by two or four people.
words.example_zh: 羽毛球可由两个人或四个人来打。
words.collocations: [搭] a badminton tournament 羽毛球锦标赛
words.word_formation: 在英格兰有一个伯明顿（Badminton）庄园，据说现代羽毛球运动的英文名得名于此。但现代羽毛球运动的比赛规则最初于19世纪草拟于印度，后来正式在英国出版。羽毛球运动中的球拍叫 racket，而羽毛球叫 shuttlecock，该词还指踢毽的“毽子”。

words.example_en: Hundreds of private golf clubs took part in a recent study.
words.example_zh: 数百家私人高尔夫俱乐部参与了最近的研究。

words.example_en: He spent a whole afternoon playing billiards.
words.example_zh: 他打了整整一个下午的台球。
words.word_formation: pool 是大家比较常玩的一种台球，pool 还有一个常见词义是“游泳池”。那种台球比较大，要求先打红球再打彩球的是斯诺克（snooker）。snooker 一词有“阻挠”的含义，也指在打球时故意给对手制造障碍。billiards 可泛指 pool、snooker 等台球运动。

words.example_en: In soccer, only the goalkeeper can play the ball with his hands.
words.example_zh: 在足球运动中，只有守门员可以用手触球。

words.example_en: He is a professional tennis player.
words.example_zh: 他是一名职业网球运动员。

words.example_en: They are watching a live TV broadcast of the volleyball match.
words.example_zh: 他们正在观看那场排球赛的电视直播节目。

words.example_en: She played hockey for the national team.
words.example_zh: 她在国家队打曲棍球。

words.example_en: The cricket match was washed out by rain.
words.example_zh: 板球比赛因下雨而取消。

words.example_en: The home side rubbed in their superiority with a further goal.
words.example_zh: 主队再进一球，从而奠定了优势。

words.example_en: I want to buy a new cricket bat.
words.example_zh: 我想要买一个新板球板。

words.example_en: Can I borrow your tennis racket?
words.example_zh: 我能借用你的网球拍吗？

words.example_en: Don’t kick the ball into the road.
words.example_zh: 不要把球踢到马路上。
words.collocations: [搭] kick the bucket 一命呜呼，翘辫子，死

words.example_en: I was so hurried that I knocked into my teacher.
words.example_zh: 我非常匆忙，撞到了老师身上。
words.collocations: [搭] knock at the door 敲门

words.meaning_zh: v. 拨；（使）快速翻动  adj. 随便的，轻率的
words.example_en: Let’s flip a coin to see who goes first.
words.example_zh: 咱们来掷硬币，看看谁先去。

words.meaning_zh: v. 投，掷  n. 球场；（棒球中的）投球
words.example_en: She pitched the ball as far as she could.
words.example_zh: 她尽力把球投得远一些。
words.collocations: [搭] invade the pitch 闯进球场  throw a pitch 投球

words.example_en: Throw the stone in the air.
words.example_zh: 把石头抛向空中。

words.example_en: The canoe was tossed about among the eddies.
words.example_zh: 独木舟在涡流之中摇晃打转。
words.collocations: [搭] toss and turn 辗转反侧

words.meaning_zh: v. 滑动；逐渐降低  n. 滑行；下跌
words.example_en: House values may begin to slide.
words.example_zh: 房子的价值可能要开始逐渐降低了。

words.meaning_zh: v. 滑跤；滑落；溜  n. 滑倒
words.example_en: She slipped and fell down the stairs.
words.example_zh: 她滑倒了，从楼梯上摔了下来。
words.collocations: [搭] a slip of the tongue 口误，失言

words.meaning_zh: v. 滑动，掠过  n. 滑行
words.example_en: The beautiful swan glides gracefully on the pond.
words.example_zh: 美丽的天鹅在池中优雅地游动。

words.example_en: She tumbled on the slick, damp ground.
words.example_zh: 她在这又滑又湿的地上摔倒了。

words.meaning_zh: v. 滑雪  n. 滑雪板
words.example_en: The students often go skiing during winter vacations.
words.example_zh: 学生们在寒假期间经常去滑雪。

words.example_en: What fun it is to throw snowballs, and to skate on the ice!
words.example_zh: 打雪仗和滑冰是多么有趣！

words.example_en: He likes cycling very much and wants to buy a bicycle.
words.example_zh: 他非常喜欢骑自行车，并且想买一辆。
words.notes: [记] cyclist n. 骑自行车的人  bicycle n. 自行车

words.example_en: Diving is a part of this expedition.
words.example_zh: 潜水是这次探险活动的一部分。

words.example_en: The dead body drifted ashore on the beach.
words.example_zh: 尸体被冲到了沙滩上。
words.collocations: [搭] drift from one country to another 从一国流浪到另一国

words.example_en: He jumped when he heard the news.
words.example_zh: 他听到那消息时，跳了起来。
words.collocations: [搭] from the jump 从一开始

words.meaning_zh: v. 跳，跃  n. 跳跃
words.example_en: The thief leaped over the wall and ran away.
words.example_zh: 小偷越墙逃跑了。

words.meaning_zh: v. 纵身投入；猛跌；（使）投身  n. 跳水；猛跌
words.example_en: He plunged into the water to save the child.
words.example_zh: 他跳入水中救小孩。
words.collocations: [搭] plunge wholeheartedly 全心全意地投入
words.word_formation: 联想记忆：想象一个人跳入水中时发出的声音，是不是和 plunge 的发音很像？

words.example_en: The cat crouched ready to spring.
words.example_zh: 那只猫俯身准备起跳。

words.meaning_zh: 跳上（或下）；单脚跳行；齐足跳行
words.example_en: The robber hopped into his car and rushed off.
words.example_zh: 强盗迅速跳进汽车，匆匆离去。

words.example_en: The ball hit the wall and bounced off it.
words.example_zh: 球打在墙上又反弹开。

words.example_en: He drew back the tent flap and strode out into the blizzard.
words.example_zh: 他拉开帐篷的门帘，大步走进暴风雪中。

words.example_en: At dusk, we pitched camp in the middle of nowhere.
words.example_zh: 黄昏时，我们在茫茫荒野中扎营。

words.meaning_zh: n. 野餐；野餐食物  v. 野餐
words.example_en: Let’s eat our picnic by the waterfall.
words.example_zh: 咱们在瀑布旁吃野餐吧。
words.collocations: [搭] go for a picnic 去野餐

words.meaning_zh: n. 打猎；搜寻  v. 猎取；搜寻
words.example_en: Parent birds began to hunt for food for their young.
words.example_zh: 亲鸟开始为幼鸟寻找食物。
words.collocations: [搭] hunt for 寻找
words.notes: [记] hunter n. 猎人

words.meaning_zh: 赛跑，速度竞赛；人种，种族
words.example_en: The horse is racing against five others.
words.example_zh: 这匹马正在和其他五匹马比赛。

words.meaning_zh: 马拉松赛跑；马拉松式的活动
words.example_en: Gillard completed the marathon in less than three hours.
words.example_zh: 加勒德在不到三个小时的时间里就跑完了马拉松。

words.example_en: In the accident, a pedestrian and a cyclist were injured.
words.example_zh: 在这场事故中，一位行人和一位骑车人受了伤。
words.collocations: [搭] a pedestrian crossing 人行横道

words.meaning_zh: n. 步速，速度；步调，节奏  v. 来回踱步
words.example_en: Are wages keeping pace with inflation?
words.example_zh: 工资与通货膨胀保持同步吗？
words.collocations: [搭] set the pace 确立标准，领先

words.example_en: One thing you can do is trying to solve it step by step.
words.example_zh: 你能做的一件事就是试着逐步解决问题。
words.collocations: [搭] step by step 一步一步，逐步
words.notes: [记] footstep n. 脚步声；足迹

words.example_en: We went on an excursion to that town.
words.example_zh: 我们到那座城镇去旅行了。
words.word_formation: 该词的字面意思为：跑（cur）到外面（ex）去了。

words.meaning_zh: 乘船游览；以平稳的速度行驶
words.example_en: The car was cruising along at 60 kilometres an hour.
words.example_zh: 这辆汽车以每小时60公里的速度平稳行驶。
words.notes: [记] cruiser n. 巡洋舰；舱式游艇；巡逻警车

words.meaning_zh: v. 绊倒  n. 旅行；绊倒
words.example_en: The trip was expensive and uncomfortable.
words.example_zh: 这次旅行既昂贵又受罪。

words.meaning_zh: v. 休假  n. 休假；假期
words.example_en: I was too busy to spare time for a vacation.
words.example_zh: 我太忙，抽不出休假的时间。
words.notes: [记] vocation n. 职业

words.example_en: It may rain, in which case the hike will be canceled.
words.example_zh: 或许会下雨，如果是那样，徒步旅行将会被取消。
words.notes: [记] hiking n. 徒步旅行

words.example_en: The old bus jogged steadily down the road.
words.example_zh: 那辆旧公共汽车顺着马路平缓地行驶。
words.notes: [记] jogger n. 慢跑锻炼的人  jogging n. 慢跑

words.example_en: They are striding forward both in English and in mathematics.
words.example_zh: 他们的英语和数学都在大步取得进步。

words.example_en: It is fun to wander the world.
words.example_zh: 漫游世界是非常有意思的。

words.example_en: We lingered at the beach the whole summer.
words.example_zh: 我们整个夏天都在海滩上待着。

words.meaning_zh: v. 落后  n. 间隔，时间差
words.example_en: Let not a single classmate lag behind.
words.example_zh: 不要让一个同学掉队。
words.collocations: [搭] lag behind sb./sth. 落后于某人/某物

words.example_en: It is not easy to climb a steep mountain.
words.example_zh: 登上陡峭的山可不容易。
words.notes: [记] limb n. 肢；树枝

words.example_en: They pulled the boat toward the lighthouse.
words.example_zh: 他们把小船划向灯塔。

words.example_en: Use your mouse to drag the pictures into that folder.
words.example_zh: 用鼠标把图片拖到那个文件夹里。

words.example_en: He bent his walking direction toward me.
words.example_zh: 他转身向我走来。
words.collocations: [搭] bend over backwards to do sth. 竭尽全力去做某事

words.example_en: He can’t agree with her, but bowed to her greater experience and knowledge.
words.example_zh: 虽然他不同意她的意见，但不得不承认她的经验和知识更丰富。
words.collocations: [搭] take a bow 谢幕

words.example_en: I’ve got quite a lot of stuff to read.
words.example_zh: 我有许多东西要读。

words.example_en: She couldn’t wedge another item into the suitcase.
words.example_zh: 她无法再往箱子里多塞东西了。

words.example_en: We often call these goods merchandise.
words.example_zh: 我们常把这些货称为商品。

words.example_en: These souvenirs were gathered from all parts of the world.
words.example_zh: 这些纪念品是从世界各地收集来的。

words.meaning_zh: (= artifact) n. 人造物品；手工艺品
words.example_en: Software is a cultural artefact of the modern world.
words.example_zh: 软件是现代社会的一种文化人造品。
words.word_formation: 字根 fact 指“制作（to make）”，如 factory（制作的地方→工厂）。art 指“技艺（skill）”。故 artefact 是“用技艺制作出来的东西，非天然的东西”，即“人造物品；手工艺品”。
words.notes: [记] artificial adj. 人造的；矫揉造作的，虚伪的

words.meaning_zh: n. 材料，原料；人才  adj. 物质的
words.example_en: There is singer material among these young girls.
words.example_zh: 在这些年轻姑娘中有当歌手的料。

words.meaning_zh: 天然的，未经加工的；（感情）原始的
words.example_en: Today, the main sources of raw cotton are China and India.
words.example_zh: 如今，主要的原棉产国是中国和印度。
words.collocations: [搭] raw material 原材料

words.meaning_zh: adj. 天然的，未经加工的；粗糙的  n. 原油
words.example_en: The price of crude oil has come down recently.
words.example_zh: 最近，原油的价格下降了。

words.meaning_zh: 必需品，必不可少的事物；必要
words.example_en: Water is a necessity of life.
words.example_zh: 水是维持生命必不可少的。
words.notes: [记] necessary adj. 必需的，必要的

words.meaning_zh: n. 全套服装；全套装备  v. 配备，装备
words.example_en: The football team were wearing orange outfits.
words.example_zh: 这支足球队的队员都穿着一身橘色运动服。

words.example_en: There is a repair kit provided in the boot of each car.
words.example_zh: 每辆车的行李箱内都备有一套修理工具。

words.example_en: He took a camping utensil that can serve as a knife, fork and spoon to school.
words.example_zh: 他把一个可以用作刀、叉和勺子的野营用具带到学校去了。

words.example_en: They fouled the water by throwing in garbage.
words.example_zh: 他们向水中扔垃圾，弄脏了水。
words.collocations: [搭] a garbage can 垃圾箱，垃圾筒

words.example_en: The dustman comes once a week to collect the rubbish.
words.example_zh: 清洁工每周来收一次垃圾。
words.collocations: [搭] clear away the rubbish 清除垃圾

words.example_en: Trash can do great damage to the environment.
words.example_zh: 垃圾会对环境造成很大危害。

words.meaning_zh: 使再循环，回收利用；反复应用
words.example_en: I plan on recycling old warehouses as condominiums.
words.example_zh: 我打算把旧仓库改建成公寓。
words.word_formation: cycle 意为“循环；一圈”，源自表示“圆圈，轮”的希腊语，相关单词如：mono（一个）+ cycle（轮）→ monocycle（独轮车）；bi（两个）+ cycle（轮）→ bicycle（自行车）；tri（三个）+ cycle（轮）→ tricycle（三轮车）；motor（引擎）+ cycle（来自 bicycle）→ motorcycle（摩托车）；cyclist（骑自行车的人）；re（重复）+ cycle（循环）→ recycle（回收利用）。

words.example_en: These bottles are designed to be reused up to 20 times.
words.example_zh: 这些瓶子被设计成可以重复使用多达20次。

words.meaning_zh: n. 垃圾，废弃物  v. 乱丢东西
words.example_en: Litter covered the cinema floor after the film.
words.example_zh: 电影结束后，电影院的地上全是垃圾。

words.meaning_zh: n. 废物；浪费  v. 浪费
words.example_en: It’s a waste of time to speak to her.
words.example_zh: 和她说话是在浪费时间。

words.example_en: What about junk food?
words.example_zh: 垃圾食品怎么样？
words.notes: [记] junk food n. 垃圾食品

words.example_en: Americans send more than 30 million tons of food to the landfill every year.
words.example_zh: 美国人每年将3000余万吨食物丢进垃圾填埋场。

words.meaning_zh: 排水系统，污水处理系统；(= sewage) 污水
words.example_en: Our town has a modern sewerage system.
words.example_zh: 我们城镇有一套现代化的污水处理系统。

words.example_en: He recommended a new detergent to me.
words.example_zh: 他向我推荐一种新的洗涤剂。

words.example_en: This lotion helps brighten and smooth your skin.
words.example_zh: 这款乳液可帮你提亮肤色并使皮肤更光滑。

words.meaning_zh: v. 用洗发剂洗（头发）  n. 洗发剂
words.example_en: She wetted her hair and then put shampoo on it.
words.example_zh: 她把头发弄湿，然后抹上洗发剂。

words.meaning_zh: n. 肥皂  v. 用肥皂擦洗
words.example_en: Don’t touch anything before you soap your hands.
words.example_zh: 没用肥皂洗手之前，什么都不要碰。
words.collocations: [搭] a soap opera 肥皂剧

words.example_en: She comforted her husband by putting his feet in a tub of hot water.
words.example_zh: 她把丈夫的两只脚放在一桶热水中，使他舒服一些。

words.meaning_zh: n. 塞子；插头  v. 把……塞住
words.example_en: You don’t need to plug your ears since the music is not so loud.
words.example_zh: 你不用塞住耳朵，音乐又不是很响。

words.example_en: He rigged a rubber hose to the tap in the kitchen.
words.example_zh: 他将一条橡皮软管安装在厨房的水龙头上。
words.notes: The example continues from the top of printed page 126.

words.example_en: All through the afternoon and the evening, he went on thinking silently, and smoking pipe after pipe.
words.example_zh: 整个下午乃至傍晚，他都一声不吭地思考着，抽了一烟斗又一烟斗的烟。
words.notes: [记] pipeline n. 管道，管线

words.meaning_zh: 管；（电视机的）显像管；[英]（伦敦）地铁
words.example_en: She passed me a tube of toothpaste.
words.example_zh: 她递给我一管牙膏。

words.meaning_zh: n. 拖把  v. 用拖把擦
words.example_en: She mopped up the water.
words.example_zh: 她用拖把把水擦干净了。

words.meaning_zh: n. 扫帚  v. 用扫帚扫
words.example_en: She used a broom to sweep up the scraps of paper.
words.example_zh: 她用一把扫帚清扫纸屑。

words.example_en: I saw the tops of trees moving in circles, and pieces of wood were swept up into the air.
words.example_zh: 我看见树梢来回摆动，木片被风卷上了天空。
words.word_formation: 短语 sweep the board 指“（在比赛中）囊括所有奖项”，源于赌博。board 指“赌桌”。可能源于某人独胜时将桌面上所有的筹码和钱一扫（sweep）而空的情景，引申为“（在比赛中）囊括所有奖项”。

words.example_en: A mattress is filled with feathers, cotton, or straw.
words.example_zh: 床垫里填充着羽毛、棉花或稻草。

words.example_en: The armchair blends well with the colour of the carpet.
words.example_zh: 扶手椅与地毯的颜色很好地融为一体。
words.collocations: [搭] red carpet（迎接贵宾用的）红地毯

words.meaning_zh: 小地毯；（盖肩或腿的）小毯子
words.example_en: He bargained with the merchant for an hour before he bought the rug.
words.example_zh: 他与那商人讨价还价了一个小时才买下这块小地毯。

words.example_en: I wiped my shoes on the mat before I came in.
words.example_zh: 我进门前在地垫上蹭了蹭鞋。

words.example_en: She plumps up the sofa cushion.
words.example_zh: 她把沙发垫拍得鼓鼓的。
words.collocations: [搭] a back cushion 靠背垫  a sofa cushion 沙发垫

words.meaning_zh: n. 衬垫，垫；便笺本  v.（用软材料）填塞
words.example_en: She always kept a pad and a pencil by the phone.
words.example_zh: 她总在电话机旁准备便笺本和铅笔。

words.example_en: She huddled herself in the blanket.
words.example_zh: 她裹着毯子缩成一团。

words.example_en: If you air your quilt on such a wet day, it’ll soak up the moisture.
words.example_zh: 如果在这么潮湿的天晾被子，被子就会把湿气都吸进去。

words.example_en: We change the sheet every week.
words.example_zh: 我们每个星期换一次床单。

words.example_en: My daughter asked me to buy her a pillow stuffed with feathers.
words.example_zh: 我女儿请求我给她买一个羽绒枕头。

words.example_en: That child soaks up new facts like a sponge!
words.example_zh: 那孩子像海绵一样吸收着新知识！

words.example_en: I dry my hands and face with a towel.
words.example_zh: 我用毛巾擦干了双手和面部。
words.collocations: [搭] wring a towel 拧毛巾

words.example_en: He used a pair of scissors to take the staple out of the document.
words.example_zh: 他用剪刀将订书钉从文件上取了下来。

words.meaning_zh: n. 指甲；钉子  v.（用钉子）钉住
words.example_en: Please hammer a nail into the wall.
words.example_zh: 请在墙上钉一个钉子。

words.meaning_zh: n. 剃刀  v.（用剃刀）剃
words.example_en: He razored his face clean of his beard.
words.example_zh: 他用剃刀将脸上的胡须刮干净。
words.collocations: [搭] an electric razor 电动剃须刀

words.example_en: I lathered my face and started to shave.
words.example_zh: 我在脸上打了肥皂，然后开始刮胡子。
words.notes: [记] shaver n. 理发师；电动剃须刀

words.meaning_zh: n. 保险丝；导火线  v.（使）熔化；（使）融合
words.example_en: We fuse copper and tin to make bronze.
words.example_zh: 我们把铜和锡熔制成青铜。

words.meaning_zh: 电缆；缆绳，钢索；电报；有线电视
words.example_en: This country has almost 15 million subscribers to satellite and cable television.
words.example_zh: 该国有将近1500万卫星电视和有线电视用户。
words.collocations: [搭] a cable car 缆车

words.example_en: Our voices depend on our vocal cords.
words.example_zh: 我们的声音取决于声带。
words.notes: 源自表示“肠线（catgut）”的希腊语。与 cord 相关的同源词是 chord（[乐器的]弦；和音；心弦），strike/touch a chord in/with sb. 就是“拨动某人心弦”“引起某人共鸣”的意思。

words.example_en: One strand of silk doesn’t make a thread; one tree doesn’t make a forest.
words.example_zh: 单丝不成线，独木不成林。

words.meaning_zh: n. 火柴；比赛；匹配的人或物  v. 与……匹配
words.example_en: A high standard of play marked the match between the two teams.
words.example_zh: 这两队之间的比赛表现了很高的技术水平。
words.collocations: [搭] meet one’s match 遇到某人的对手

words.example_en: The candle was blown out by the wind.
words.example_zh: 蜡烛被风吹灭了。
words.collocations: [搭] light / blow out a candle 点亮/吹灭蜡烛

words.example_en: The candle gutters when the melted wax runs down its sides.
words.example_zh: 熔化的蜡从蜡烛的边上滑下时，烛光摇曳不定。

words.example_en: She has left her portfolio in a chair.
words.example_zh: 她把文件夹落在椅子上了。
words.notes: [记] briefcase n. 公事包。字根 port 指“拿，带，运 (to carry)”，如：portfolio（运纸 [folio 指“对开本”的东西] → 公事包）；portable（可带着的 → 便携的）；porter（运送之人 → 搬运工）；transportation（运过去 → 运输）。此外，单词 port 有“港口”之义，同根词如：passport（通过港口必要的东西 → 护照），opportunity（当船来到港口，就可能获得补给，开展贸易，大发一笔 → 机会）。

words.example_en: This bookshop only sells paperbacks.
words.example_zh: 这家书店只出售平装书。

words.example_en: I took a few pamphlets from the travel agency.
words.example_zh: 我从旅行社拿了几本小册子。
words.notes: [记] booklet n. 小册子，资料手册  leaflet n. 传单  brochure n.（广告或资料）手册

words.example_en: She wiped off the sweat from her face with a tissue.
words.example_zh: 她用一张面巾纸擦掉脸上的汗水。

words.example_en: The front cover of the novel has been torn off.
words.example_zh: 这本小说的封面已被撕掉。

words.example_en: He kept the original copy and gave her only a Xerox.
words.example_zh: 他保留了原本，只给了她一份复印件。
words.collocations: [搭] a Xerox machine 施乐复印机  a Xerox copy 施乐复印件

words.meaning_zh: v. 重复  n. 副本，复制品
words.example_en: Don’t duplicate what you have already done.
words.example_zh: 不要重复你已经做过的事。

words.meaning_zh: 备忘录；建议书；(= memo)（公司或组织内部的）公务便条
words.example_en: They agreed on the memorandum.
words.example_zh: 他们就这份备忘录达成了一致意见。
words.word_formation: 字根 memor 指“记着的（mindful, remembering）”，如：memorandum（备忘录）；com（加强意义）+ memor（记着的）+ ate（动词后缀）→提醒你记住→ commemorate（纪念）；re（回来）+ member（记着的）→回想起来→ remember（记起，想起）。
words.notes: [记] memo n. 备忘录

words.example_en: Stationery can be imprinted with your message or logo.
words.example_zh: 可以把你的信息或标志印在信纸上。
words.notes: [记] stationer n. 文具店；文具商

words.example_en: Stick them on the card using a small amount of glue.
words.example_zh: 用少量胶水把它们贴到卡片上。

words.example_en: If the ink sinks in, it’ll be hard to remove it.
words.example_zh: 如果墨水渗入，就很难去除。

words.example_en: Rubber is the country’s principal export.
words.example_zh: 橡胶是该国主要的出口产品。

words.example_en: It is rumoured that Leonardo Da Vinci invented the scissors.
words.example_zh: 有传言称是达·芬奇发明了剪刀。

words.meaning_zh: n. [~s]（尤指修剪篱笆用的）大剪刀  v. 剪
words.example_en: With a few quick snips of the shears, he pruned the bush.
words.example_zh: 他用大剪刀几下子就把灌木丛修剪好了。

words.example_en: Look out! You could fall off the edge here!
words.example_zh: 小心！你会从这边缘掉下去的！

words.example_en: Mike liked very much the golden rims of his glasses.
words.example_zh: 麦克很喜欢他的眼镜的金色边框。

words.meaning_zh: （化学中的）元素；组成部分；基本部分
words.example_en: Both hydrogen and oxygen are elements.
words.example_zh: 氢和氧都是化学元素。

words.example_en: Her friendly manner is an important factor in her rapid success.
words.example_zh: 待人友好是她迅速获得成功的一个重要因素。

words.example_en: One section of the class was reading and the other section was writing.
words.example_zh: 这堂课一部分讲阅读，另一部分讲写作。
words.word_formation: 字根 sect 指“切割（to cut）”，如：insect（躯体分割成一节一节的 → 昆虫），sect（派别；教派；党派），bisect（将……一分为二），intersection（相互切割，纵横切割 → 交叉；十字路口），vivisect（切割活的东西 → 活体解剖）。

words.example_en: Don’t forget to put tags with your name and address on your suitcases.
words.example_zh: 别忘了在你的箱子上贴上写有你的姓名和住址的标签。

words.example_en: I read the information on the labels before deciding which jam to buy.
words.example_zh: 在决定买哪种果酱之前，我先看了看标签上的说明。

words.example_en: Wisdom is the badge of maturity.
words.example_zh: 智慧是成熟的标志。

words.meaning_zh: n. 螺栓；插销  v. 闩上（门、窗）
words.example_en: We need an eye bolt to fit this valve.
words.example_zh: 我们需要一个有眼螺栓来固定这个阀门。

words.example_en: He twisted the knob of the door and went inside.
words.example_zh: 他转动门把手，然后走了进去。

words.meaning_zh: n. 柄；把手  v. 拿；处理
words.example_en: You have to press on the handle to turn it; it’s very stiff.
words.example_zh: 你必须用力压这个把手才能转动它，它很不灵活。
words.collocations: [搭] handle with care 小心轻放

words.meaning_zh: n. 百叶窗；（相机）快门  v. 停止（营业）
words.example_en: The company shuttered its Hong Kong investment banking business a year ago.
words.example_zh: 该公司一年前停止了其香港投资银行的业务。

words.meaning_zh: n. 窗帘；帘；幕布  v. 给……装上帘子
words.example_en: I have enough material to curtain all the windows.
words.example_zh: 我有足够的料子，可以给所有窗户都挂上窗帘。

words.example_en: He suffered a lot of pain after he accidentally broke a pane of glass.
words.example_zh: 他意外将一块窗玻璃打碎后，疼痛万分。

words.example_en: They have chosen the frosted glass owing to its opacity.
words.example_zh: 他们选择了这种磨砂玻璃，因为它不透明。
words.notes: [记] opaque n. 不透明物 adj. 不透明的

words.example_en: I can’t get the lid off this jar.
words.example_zh: 我打不开这个广口瓶的盖子。

words.example_en: The wine is aged in oak barrels.
words.example_zh: 酒在橡木桶里陈化。

words.example_en: One bucket of paint will be enough for the ceiling.
words.example_zh: 刷天花板，一桶油漆足够用了。
words.collocations: [搭] a drop in the bucket 沧海一粟

words.meaning_zh: [尤美]（通常是金属或木制的）桶，提桶
words.example_en: He tipped the slops out of the pail.
words.example_zh: 他倒出桶里的脏水。

words.example_en: We swapped phone numbers.
words.example_zh: 我们交换了电话号码。
words.collocations: [搭] a cell phone / mobile phone 手机  make a phone call 打电话  on the phone 在打（或接）电话

words.example_en: I was roused by the sound of the bell this morning.
words.example_zh: 今天早晨，我被铃声唤醒。
words.collocations: [搭] ring a bell 听起来有印象

words.example_en: You’d better declare the camera to the official.
words.example_zh: 你最好向海关官员申报这台照相机。
words.collocations: [搭] a built-in camera（手机）内置照相机

words.example_en: The new portable computers are selling like hot cakes.
words.example_zh: 这款新的便携式电脑十分畅销。

words.meaning_zh: 聚光灯；聚光灯照出的光圈
words.example_en: The spotlight followed the dancer round the stage.
words.example_zh: 聚光灯的光圈追随着舞者在舞台上转。

words.example_en: The Ice Lantern Festival held in Harbin every winter is fantastic.
words.example_zh: 哈尔滨每年冬天举办的冰灯节非常棒。

words.example_en: An efficient bulb may lighten the load of power stations.
words.example_zh: 一个节能灯泡也许就能减轻发电站的负荷。

words.example_en: You can use the flashlight when you take a photo indoors.
words.example_zh: 你在室内拍照时可用闪光灯。

words.example_en: My refrigerator suddenly broke down yesterday evening.
words.example_zh: 我的冰箱昨晚突然出了故障。
words.notes: [记] refrigeration n. 冷藏

words.example_en: The butter will soften out of the fridge.
words.example_zh: 黄油被取出冰箱后会变软。

words.meaning_zh: n. 真空；真空吸尘器  adj. 真空的
words.example_en: The food is kept in a vacuum pack.
words.example_zh: 这食物被保存在真空包装中。
words.word_formation: 字根 vac(u)/void 表示“空（empty）”，如：vacuum（真空）；e（出）+ vacu（空）+ ate（动词后缀）→空出去→evacuate（疏散，撤离）；a（出）+ void（空）→空出来→avoid（回避）。

words.meaning_zh: n. 扇子；风扇；狂热爱好者  v. 扇
words.example_en: He has charmed most of them into membership of his fan club.
words.example_zh: 他施展魅力，让他们大部分人都加入了他的支持者行列。

words.meaning_zh: n. 开关；转换  v. 转换
words.example_en: Press the switch to see if the light comes on.
words.example_zh: 按一下开关，看看灯会不会亮。

words.example_en: With her speed and agility, she can beat all her competitors in the hurdle race.
words.example_zh: 以她的速度和敏捷性，她能在跨栏赛跑中击败所有对手。

words.example_en: That fence is the limit of the schoolyard.
words.example_zh: 那道围栏是校园的边界。
words.collocations: [搭] set up fences 设立栅栏

words.meaning_zh: n. 踏板  v. 踩踏板
words.example_en: One of the pedals has come off my bicycle.
words.example_zh: 我那辆自行车有一个踏板脱落了。

words.example_en: The shelf is too weak to hold all those books.
words.example_zh: 这架子不结实，承受不了所有那些书。

words.meaning_zh: 梯子；（进步、晋升等的）阶梯
words.example_en: Diligence is often a ladder to success.
words.example_zh: 勤奋常常是通往成功的阶梯。
words.collocations: [搭] climb a ladder 爬梯子

words.meaning_zh: v. 提，抬；提高  n. [英]电梯（美式英语用 elevator）
words.example_en: This box is too heavy for me to lift.
words.example_zh: 这箱子太重，我抬不起来。

words.example_en: Because of that stool and a pair of computers, I gained a best friend.
words.example_zh: 因为那个凳子和两台电脑，我得到了一个最好的朋友。

words.example_en: The keys are in the back left-hand corner of the drawer.
words.example_zh: 钥匙在抽屉最里面的左边一角。

words.example_en: The wind blew my umbrella inside out.
words.example_zh: 风把我的伞吹得翻过来了。

words.example_en: He had no raincoat on when the rain started.
words.example_zh: 开始下雨时，他没穿雨衣。

words.meaning_zh: n. 挖泥船，挖掘机  v. 挖掘；撒（糖、面粉等）
words.example_en: She dredged a little sugar over the cake.
words.example_zh: 她在蛋糕上撒了点糖。

words.meaning_zh: v. 把（食品）装罐保存  n. 罐头，听
words.example_en: She was carrying an armful of cat-food cans and talking to herself.
words.example_zh: 她正抱着一堆猫食罐头自言自语。

words.meaning_zh: n. 磨粉机；磨坊  v. 碾碎；无目的地乱转
words.example_en: Corn is ground into flour in a mill.
words.example_zh: 谷物在磨坊里被磨成粉。

words.meaning_zh: n. 锻铁炉  v. 锻造；伪造
words.example_en: These machine parts have been forged with the finest steel.
words.example_zh: 这些机器零件是用优质钢材锻造的。

words.example_en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
words.example_zh: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。

words.example_en: A gust of wind pried loose a section of sheet-metal roofing.
words.example_zh: 一阵狂风把一块用来铺屋顶的板料刮松动了。

words.meaning_zh: n. 铁；熨斗  v. 熨，烫
words.example_en: They analysed the ore and found iron in it.
words.example_zh: 他们分析了这矿砂，从中发现了铁。

words.example_en: Lead is one of the softer metals.
words.example_zh: 铅是硬度较低的金属之一。

words.example_en: Brass is formed by the fusion of copper and zinc.
words.example_zh: 黄铜是由铜和锌熔合制成的。

words.example_en: We fuse copper and tin to make bronze.
words.example_zh: 我们把铜和锡熔制成青铜。

words.meaning_zh: n. 水泥；胶接剂  v. 使黏结
words.example_en: The mixed cement has been hoisted up the building.
words.example_zh: 拌好的水泥已被吊上建筑物。
words.notes: [记] cementer n. 水泥工人

words.example_en: They used pitch to cover roofs.
words.example_zh: 他们用沥青涂盖屋顶。

words.example_en: Lime in the soil is detrimental to some plants.
words.example_zh: 土壤里的石灰对某些植物有害。

words.example_en: The plaster had started to come away from the wall.
words.example_zh: 灰泥已经开始从墙上脱落。

words.meaning_zh: 皮革；（尤指骑摩托车者穿的）皮衣
words.example_en: Wax polish preserves wood and leather.
words.example_zh: 上光蜡可以保护木材和皮革。

words.meaning_zh: n. 塑料  adj. 有塑性的；塑料的
words.example_en: Many items in daily use are made out of plastic.
words.example_zh: 很多日常生活用品是塑料制的。

words.example_en: Scientists are recommending that people eat more fibre.
words.example_zh: 科学家建议人们多吃些纤维素。
words.notes: The example continues from the bottom of the left column to the top of the right column.

words.example_en: The jacket is comfortable because the fabric breathes.
words.example_zh: 这件短上衣穿着很舒适，因为这种布料透气。

words.example_en: My grandmother knitted me some socks.
words.example_zh: 祖母给我织了一些袜子。

words.example_en: We are weaving garlands of flowers for heroes.
words.example_zh: 我们在为英雄编织花环。

words.example_en: They carried canvas sacks over their shoulders.
words.example_zh: 他们肩上扛着帆布袋。

words.example_en: Low elasticity, imparting a hard and smooth texture, makes linen subject to wrinkling.
words.example_zh: 较差的弹性使亚麻布质地硬而光滑，但也容易起皱纹。
words.collocations: [搭] fine linen 细亚麻布  fresh linen 干净的床单和枕套

words.example_en: The cotton has been picked and weighed up.
words.example_zh: 棉花已摘下来，并已称重。

words.example_en: This dress is 80% nylon.
words.example_zh: 这件连衣裙的料子含有80%的尼龙。
words.notes: The example continues at the top of printed page 133.

words.example_en: Forested areas have been expanding every year, with the amount of the increase in standing timber greater than that of felled lumber.
words.example_zh: 森林面积每年都在增加，常备林木的增长量大于被砍伐的木材量。

words.example_en: There is a wooden porch over the sidewalk.
words.example_zh: 人行道上有一个木制的门廊。

words.example_en: The mine was closed owing to exhaustion.
words.example_zh: 这个矿井因矿源枯竭而被关闭。
words.notes: [记] miner n. 矿工  mineral n. 矿物 adj. 矿物的

words.example_en: When you fall into a pit, you either die or get out.
words.example_zh: 若你落入险境，要么等死，要么设法逃脱。

words.meaning_zh: n. 燃料  v. 给……加燃料
words.example_en: We aim for a 10% saving in fuel.
words.example_zh: 我们的目标是节省10%的燃料。
words.collocations: [搭] add fuel to 给……加燃料  burn up fuel 烧完燃料  lack fuel 缺少燃料

words.example_en: We find it necessary to lubricate machines.
words.example_zh: 我们发现给机器加润滑油是必要的。
words.collocations: [搭] lubricating oil 润滑油

words.example_en: The diamond ring on her finger glittered in the light.
words.example_zh: 她手指上的钻石戒指在光下闪闪发光。

words.example_en: People imitate diamonds with crystal.
words.example_zh: 人们用水晶仿造钻石。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 差的；下级的，低等的  n. 级别（或地位）低的人；次品
words.example_en: I grudge paying so much for such inferior goods.
words.example_zh: 花这么多钱买这种次品，我很不情愿。
words.notes: [记] inferiority n. 低等，劣等

words.meaning_zh: adj. 假冒的  v. 伪造
words.example_en: It is against the law to counterfeit money.
words.example_zh: 伪造货币是违法的。
words.word_formation: counter（反）+ feit（做）→反着做→伪造。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 假冒的  n. 冒充者；假货
words.example_en: On closer examination, the painting was proved to be a fake.
words.example_zh: 经过更仔细的检查，那幅画被证实是假品。

words.example_en: Glass is fragile and must be handled with great care.
words.example_zh: 玻璃制品易碎，必须轻拿轻放。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 微型的，很小的  n. 缩微模型；微型画
words.example_en: The locket contained a miniature portrait of her late husband.
words.example_zh: 这个盒式项链坠里有她已故丈夫的微型肖像。

words.example_en: Water and electric hook-ups are available and facilities are good.
words.example_zh: 水和电都可以接通，设施也很不错。
words.collocations: [搭] be available to do sth. 可用于做某事

words.example_en: Some parts of the machine have to be made from durable materials.
words.example_zh: 机器里的一些部分必须由耐用材料制成。

words.meaning_zh: n. 时尚  v. 制作，制成
words.example_en: Loose trousers are the latest fashion.
words.example_zh: 穿宽大的裤子是最新的时尚。
words.collocations: [搭] come into fashion 流行起来，开始风行  out of fashion 过时的
words.notes: [记] fashionable adj. 流行的

words.example_en: The style of this skirt is just in season.
words.example_zh: 这条裙子的样式正在流行。
words.notes: [记] stylish adj. 时髦的，有格调的

words.example_en: The youth like to follow the latest trends in fashion.
words.example_zh: 年轻人喜欢追随最新的时尚潮流。

words.example_en: There is a growing tendency for people to work at home instead of in offices.
words.example_zh: 人们在家里而不是在办公室工作的趋势日益显著。
words.notes: [记] tend v. 趋向；易于

words.meaning_zh: n. 潮流，趋势  adj. 当前的
words.example_en: Newspapers influence the current of thought.
words.example_zh: 报纸影响着思想潮流。
words.collocations: [搭] against the current 逆流而行的；与潮流相反的

words.example_en: That record made the singer’s popularity boom.
words.example_zh: 那张唱片捧红了这位歌手。
words.notes: [记] popular adj. 流行的

words.example_en: Long hair for men and high boots for ladies are no longer in vogue.
words.example_zh: 男士留长发和女士穿高筒靴不再流行了。
words.collocations: [搭] in vogue 流行时

words.example_en: Truth will ultimately prevail.
words.example_zh: 真理终究会获胜。
words.collocations: [搭] prevail over/against 压倒，战胜
words.notes: [记] prevalence n. 流行，普遍存在  prevailing adj. 盛行的

words.meaning_zh: n. 模型；模范；模特儿  v. 使模仿
words.example_en: After a brief spell as a model, she got into singing.
words.example_zh: 在短暂地当过一阵子模特儿后，她进入歌唱界。

words.example_en: That singer is one of the pop culture icons of 1980s.
words.example_zh: 那位歌手是20世纪80年代的流行文化偶像之一。

words.meaning_zh: 偶像，受到崇拜的人或物；神像
words.example_en: That football player is the idol of many young people.
words.example_zh: 这位足球运动员是许多年轻人的偶像。

words.example_en: The increasing sales of luxuries are an indication of the country’s prosperity.
words.example_zh: 奢侈品的销售量日益升高，这是该国繁荣的表现。
words.notes: [记] luxurious adj. 奢侈的，豪华的

words.example_en: She’s very extravagant—she spends all her money on clothes.
words.example_zh: 她很铺张浪费——她把所有的钱都用来买衣服。

words.example_en: This piece of jewellery is priceless.
words.example_zh: 这件首饰是无价之宝。

words.example_en: That jewel has a beautiful shimmer.
words.example_zh: 那颗宝石闪着美丽的光。

words.example_en: This picture is the gem of the collection.
words.example_zh: 这幅画是这些藏品中的珍品。
words.notes: [记] gene n. 基因  germ n. 细菌

words.example_en: I have a pair of jade bracelets.
words.example_zh: 我有一对翡翠手镯。

words.example_en: She likes to adorn herself with jewels.
words.example_zh: 她喜欢用珠宝来装扮自己。

words.meaning_zh: n. 装饰品  v. 装饰
words.example_en: Clearness ornaments profound thought.
words.example_zh: 清晰性能使深刻的思想增辉。

words.example_en: The door of the old church was embellished with intricate carvings.
words.example_zh: 老教堂的门是用复杂的雕饰美化的。

words.meaning_zh: 对（故事等）加以渲染；在……上刺绣
words.example_en: Her shirt is embroidered with roses.
words.example_zh: 她的衬衣上绣着玫瑰花。

words.example_en: She has spent much money and time on hairdressing.
words.example_zh: 她在美发上花了不少钱和时间。

words.example_en: This pigment is a good and common food additive.
words.example_zh: 这色素是一种优质且常见的食品添加剂。

words.meaning_zh: n. 染料；（染上的）颜色  v. 染
words.example_en: My roommate has dyed her hair red—it looks so unnatural.
words.example_zh: 我的室友把头发染成了红色，看起来很不自然。

words.meaning_zh: n. 化装舞会  v. 化装；假扮
words.example_en: She masqueraded as a shepherdess.
words.example_zh: 她假扮成一名牧羊女。

words.example_en: The bride’s face was covered with a white veil.
words.example_zh: 新娘的脸上蒙着白色的面纱。

words.meaning_zh: 戏服；（某历史时期或某地的）服装
words.example_en: Her national costume showed which country she came from.
words.example_zh: 她的民族服装显示了她来自哪个国家。
words.collocations: [搭] academic costume 学位服  a costume ball 化装舞会
words.notes: cosplay 简化自 costume play，意思是“角色扮演”或“服饰装扮”，主要指动漫、游戏爱好者将自己装扮成所喜爱的动漫或游戏角色的表演活动。如果你小时候曾拿条毛巾当披风、用鸡毛掸子作宝剑扮过大侠的话，就能完全理解这个单词的含义。

words.example_en: This city fascinates him.
words.example_zh: 这座城市令他着迷。
words.collocations: [搭] be fascinated with 迷上
words.notes: [记] fascinating adj. 迷人的

words.example_en: He made a decent record.
words.example_zh: 他成绩尚佳。
words.notes: [记] indecent adj. 下流的

words.example_en: He has exquisite taste and decent manners.
words.example_zh: 他有高雅的情趣和得体的举止。
words.word_formation: 字根 quisit 指“追求（to seek）”，如：exquisite（追求到的，选拔出来的 → 精致的），acquisition（获得），requisite（再次追求 → 必需的），prerequisite（再次追求之前的，事先必备的 → 先决条件，前提）。
words.notes: The word-formation note continues from the bottom of printed page 137 to the top of printed page 138.

words.example_en: She was a beautiful girl with the grace and poise of a natural model.
words.example_zh: 她是一个美丽的姑娘，天生有着模特儿的那种优雅仪态。
words.notes: [记] graceful adj. 优雅的

words.example_en: He is admired for the elegance of his writing.
words.example_zh: 他文风典雅，受人钦佩。
words.notes: [记] elegant adj. 优雅的

words.example_en: No one expects you to be perfect, but we do expect you to do your best always.
words.example_zh: 没人指望你完美无缺，但是我们盼望你永远尽最大的努力。
words.notes: [记] perfection n. 完美

words.example_en: Don’t judge by appearances.
words.example_zh: 不能以貌取人。
words.notes: [记] appear v. 出现

words.example_en: We have many types of cosmetics for sale.
words.example_zh: 我们有许多类型的化妆品在售。
words.word_formation: 字根 cosm(o) 来源于希腊语 kosmos，有两个意思：一是指“装饰（ornament）”，如 cosmetics（脸部的装饰 → 化妆品）；二是指“秩序（order）；世界（world）”。古希腊人认为宇宙是一个有序的地方，所以 cosmic 就是“宇宙的”。而 cosmopolitan（世界性的）来源于 kosmos（世界）和 polites（市民）的结合。

words.example_en: I cannot tell who’s who when the women take off their make-up.
words.example_zh: 女士们卸了妆，我就分辨不出谁是谁。
words.notes: [记] make up 化妆

words.example_en: The waitress received a handsome tip.
words.example_zh: 女侍者收到了数额可观的小费。

words.example_en: Her colourful character makes her very charming.
words.example_zh: 她有趣的性格使她非常富有魅力。
words.collocations: [搭] Prince Charming 白马王子

words.meaning_zh: adj. 漂亮的  adv. 相当地
words.example_en: All the pretty women wore their smartest dresses.
words.example_zh: 所有漂亮女士都穿着自己最漂亮的连衣裙。

words.example_en: Looking at a beautiful painting always gives one satisfaction.
words.example_zh: 观赏一幅美丽的图画总能给人一种满足感。

words.example_en: You can’t persuade me to buy this ugly vase!
words.example_zh: 你无法说服我买这个丑陋的花瓶！

words.example_en: She wears a beautiful evening dress.
words.example_zh: 她穿着一件漂亮的晚礼服。

words.example_en: He had to work hard to feed and clothe the large family.
words.example_zh: 他必须努力工作才能使一大家子人有饭吃，有衣穿。
words.notes: [记] clothes n. 衣服  clothing n. 衣服

words.meaning_zh: n. 制服  adj. 一致的
words.example_en: Do you have to wear a uniform if you work at McDonald’s?
words.example_zh: 在麦当劳供职时必须穿制服吗？
words.word_formation: uni（单一的）+ form（形状，形式）→单一的形式→制服。

words.example_en: This garment should be washed carefully.
words.example_zh: 这件衣服应该小心清洗。

words.meaning_zh: 洗衣店；要（或正在）洗的衣物，刚洗好的衣物
words.example_en: There’s a lot of laundry in the basket.
words.example_zh: 篮里有许多要洗的衣物。
words.collocations: [搭] do/hang/iron the laundry 洗/晾/熨衣物

words.example_en: Can you hang these in the wardrobe, please?
words.example_zh: 你能把这些挂在衣柜里吗？

words.meaning_zh: n. [英]（工作时穿的）罩衣  adj. 全面的
words.example_en: The shop assistant was wearing a white overall.
words.example_zh: 那店员穿着白色的罩衣。

words.example_en: He turned his overcoat collar up.
words.example_zh: 他把大衣的衣领竖了起来。

words.example_en: She was simply dressed in a plain white robe.
words.example_zh: 她只穿了一件朴素的白色长袍。

words.example_en: She put on her silk gown and went to the ball.
words.example_zh: 她穿上丝质的礼服，前去参加舞会。

words.example_en: This woollen sweater may keep you warm in winter.
words.example_zh: 这件羊毛衫可以让你在冬天保暖。

words.example_en: He wore a pair of dark glasses and a jacket all day long.
words.example_zh: 他整天戴着一副墨镜，穿着一件夹克衫。

words.example_en: How many skirts do you have?
words.example_zh: 你有多少条裙子？

words.example_en: Jeans are made of jean, denim, or other durable fabrics.
words.example_zh: 牛仔裤是用粗斜纹棉布、蓝粗棉布或其他耐磨布料制成的。

words.example_en: This pair of trousers is too tight for me.
words.example_zh: 这条裤子对我来说太紧了。

words.meaning_zh: n. 搭扣  v. 扣住
words.example_en: The button won’t clasp.
words.example_zh: 这颗扣子扣不上。

words.meaning_zh: n. 纽扣；按钮  v. 扣上……的纽扣
words.example_en: One of the buttons has come off my coat.
words.example_zh: 我外套上的一颗扣子掉了。
words.notes: [记] unbutton v. 解开……的纽扣；如解开纽扣一样解开

words.example_en: It’s getting cold and I have to take out my woollen gloves.
words.example_zh: 天气变冷了，我不得不把毛线手套拿出来了。

words.example_en: She bought a hat yesterday.
words.example_zh: 她昨天买了一顶帽子。

words.meaning_zh: （有帽舌的）帽子；（经费等的）最高限额
words.example_en: The cap goes well with your suit.
words.example_zh: 这顶帽子跟你的套装很配。

words.example_en: He drank at the fountain’s brim.
words.example_zh: 他在喷泉边喝酒。

words.example_en: The price of this scarf is below ten dollars.
words.example_zh: 这条围巾的价格不到10美元。

words.example_en: He was playing with his handkerchief all the while during the speech.
words.example_zh: 演讲期间，他一直在摆弄手帕。

words.meaning_zh: [尤英] 钱包；[美] 小手提包
words.example_en: The loss of her purse caused her much inconvenience.
words.example_zh: 丢失钱包给她带来了诸多不便。

words.example_en: She placed the receipt in her wallet.
words.example_zh: 她把收条放到皮夹子里了。

words.example_en: One button on the vest is loose.
words.example_zh: 西装背心上的一粒纽扣松了。

words.example_en: Over her shoulders was a much-mended wrap.
words.example_zh: 她的肩上搭着一条被多次缝补的披肩。
