words.example_en: She picked up the old brown cloak and handed it to him.
words.example_zh: 她捡起棕色的旧斗篷递给他。

words.example_en: He turned up his coat collar against the chilly wind.
words.example_zh: 他竖起大衣领来抵御寒风。

words.example_en: A stranger pulled at my sleeve as I was leaving.
words.example_zh: 我刚要离去，一个陌生人拽了拽我的袖子。

words.example_en: There is a hole in my sock.
words.example_zh: 我的短袜上有个洞。

words.example_en: The thief masked his face with a stocking.
words.example_zh: 那个贼套上长筒袜遮住脸。

words.example_en: No slipper is allowed in the laboratory.
words.example_zh: 实验室里不允许穿拖鞋。

words.example_en: My foot won’t go into this boot.
words.example_zh: 我的脚穿不上这只靴子。

words.example_en: He stopped to tie the laces of his sneakers.
words.example_zh: 他停下来把运动鞋的鞋带系上。

words.meaning_zh: n. 裁缝  v. 专门制作
words.example_en: The tailor can alter your new coat to fit you.
words.example_zh: 裁缝会将你的新外套改合体。

words.example_en: The skirt is finished and I’m now going to sew a pocket.
words.example_zh: 裙子做好了，我现在要再缝上个口袋。

words.meaning_zh: v. 纺；（使）旋转  n. 高速旋转；（乘车）兜风
words.example_en: We took a spin around the town.
words.example_zh: 我们乘车在城里兜了一圈。

words.example_en: My mother is stitching a new dress.
words.example_zh: 我妈妈正在缝一条新裙子。

words.example_en: The needle pierced her finger.
words.example_zh: 针刺进了她的手指。
words.collocations: [搭] thread a needle 穿针，纫针

words.meaning_zh: n. 别针，大头针  v. 别住，钉住
words.example_en: Pin the bills together so you won’t lose them.
words.example_zh: 把账单钉在一起以防遗失。

words.example_en: We have had a string of complaints about the programme.
words.example_zh: 我们已经收到了对该节目的 一连串投诉。

words.example_en: She is looking for threads which match the cloth.
words.example_zh: 她在找和这块布相配的线。

words.meaning_zh: n. 带子  v. 用带子系（或捆、扎）
words.example_en: A safety strap is used to prevent falling.
words.example_zh: 安全带被用来防止滑落。

words.example_en: The body of a zebra is marked by black and white stripes.
words.example_zh: 斑马的身体特征是有黑白条纹。

words.example_en: Her hair was tied up with a ribbon.
words.example_zh: 她的头发用一条丝带扎着。

words.example_en: A belt of trees grew between the two fields.
words.example_zh: 两块田之间有一条树木带。
words.collocations: [搭] fasten/loosen a belt 扣紧/松开皮带

words.example_en: She wore a silver chain around her neck.
words.example_zh: 她的脖子上戴着一条银链子。

words.example_en: I’d like you to take this bracelet as a gift.
words.example_zh: 我希望你把这只手镯作为礼物收下。

words.example_en: I value this necklace at 5,000 dollars.
words.example_zh: 我估计这条项链值5000美元。

words.meaning_zh: n. 珠子；（液体的）小滴  v. 形成珠状
words.example_en: She wore a string of beads round her neck.
words.example_zh: 她的脖子上挂了一串珠子。
words.word_formation: 源自表示“祈祷”的古英语。后来西方开始盛行在祈祷时手拨念珠，就演化出表示“念珠”的中古英语 bede。最后发展为现在的 bead，表意的范围也扩大了，可表示“珠子”（液体的）小滴等。复数形式 beads 仍常被用来指“念珠”，如在英语短语 count one’s beads（数念珠祷告）中。

words.meaning_zh: n. 纺织品  adj. 纺织的
words.example_en: He intends to retail textile goods.
words.example_zh: 他打算零售纺织类的商品。

words.example_en: The lawn looks like green velvet.
words.example_zh: 草坪看上去就像绿色的天鹅绒。

words.example_en: He found a job of shearing wool from sheep.
words.example_zh: 他找到一份剪羊毛的工作。
words.notes: [记] woollen (= woolen) adj. 羊毛的

words.meaning_zh: n. 补丁；（与周围不同的）小片  v. 补缀
words.example_en: She sewed a patch onto the knee of the trousers.
words.example_zh: 她在裤子的膝部缝了个补丁。
words.notes: [记] patchwork n. 拼布工艺；混杂物

words.example_en: She wrapped the box with an old rag.
words.example_zh: 她用一块破旧的布包住这个盒子。
words.notes: [记] ragged adj. 破旧的。The example continues at the top of printed page 142.

words.example_en: His shabby appearance creates a bad impression.
words.example_zh: 他衣衫褴褛的样子给人留下不好的印象。

words.example_en: This drawer is too tight for me to open it.
words.example_zh: 这抽屉太紧了，我打不开。
words.notes: [记] tighten v.（使）变紧；使更加严格

words.example_en: Due to the use of natural pigments, these folk paintings retain their colour well.
words.example_zh: 因为使用了天然颜料，这些民俗画的颜色很好地保留了下来。
words.notes: [记] colourful (= colorful) adj. 富于色彩的

words.meaning_zh: adj. 白的  n. 白色
words.example_en: He was white with fury.
words.example_zh: 他气得脸色发白。
words.notes: [记] whitewash v. 粉刷，刷石灰水

words.meaning_zh: adj. 黄的  n. 黄色
words.example_en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
words.example_zh: 秋天时，叶子变黄。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 褐色的  n. 褐色
words.example_en: He had brown skin.
words.example_zh: 他的皮肤是褐色的。

words.meaning_zh: (= gray) adj. 灰色的  n. 灰色
words.example_en: He dressed in grey.
words.example_zh: 他穿着灰色衣服。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 粉红色的  n. 粉红色
words.example_en: She carried a spray of pink roses.
words.example_zh: 她拿着一簇粉红色的玫瑰花。
words.collocations: [搭] in the pink 容光焕发

words.meaning_zh: adj. 紫的  n. 紫色
words.example_en: That girl like to wear purple dresses.
words.example_zh: 那个女孩喜欢穿紫色的连衣裙。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 棕黄色的  n. 棕黄色；晒成的棕褐色
words.example_en: It took me all summer to get this tan.
words.example_zh: 我花了整个夏天才晒出这样的棕褐色。

words.example_en: Beauty fades like a flower.
words.example_zh: 红颜易逝如花败。
words.collocations: [搭] fade away 衰弱；病重死亡

words.meaning_zh: v. 染污  n. 污渍
words.example_en: The coffee stained his shirt brown.
words.example_zh: 咖啡把他的衬衫染上了棕色。
words.notes: [记] stainless adj. 无瑕疵的；不锈钢制的

words.example_en: The new power station is a blot on the landscape.
words.example_zh: 那座新建的发电厂大煞风景。

words.meaning_zh: n. 身材；身影；重要人物；数字  v. 认为
words.example_en: I could see a tall figure near the door.
words.example_zh: 我可以看见门附近有一个高大的身影。
words.collocations: [搭] figure out 理解，弄明白
words.word_formation: 看看如何描述各种身材：a slender/slim figure（苗条的身材）；a curvy figure（有曲线美的身段）；a hot figure（惹火的身材）；a round figure（浑圆的体型〔注意，round figure 在数学中指“整数”〕）；an hourglass figure（沙漏身材）——不许笑！这可是夸奖女子的身材玲珑有致，是“魔鬼身材”！

words.example_en: All of us admired her slender figure.
words.example_zh: 我们都羡慕她的苗条身材。

words.example_en: Our army suffered a slight reverse.
words.example_zh: 我们的部队遭受了轻微的损失。
words.notes: [记] slightly adv. 稍微

words.example_en: I prefer vegetarian food.
words.example_zh: 我更喜欢吃素食。
words.notes: [记] foodie n. 美食家，吃货

words.meaning_zh: 日常饮食；（医生指定的）特别饮食；节食
words.example_en: A sugar-free diet is recommended for diabetics.
words.example_zh: 建议糖尿病患者食用无糖食品。
words.collocations: [搭] on a diet 进行节食
words.notes: [记] dietary adj. 饮食的

words.example_en: I lost my appetite.
words.example_zh: 我没什么食欲了。
words.collocations: [搭] have a bad appetite 没有食欲
words.word_formation: 字根 pet 指“寻求（to seek）”，如：appetite（寻求的情绪 → 食欲；强烈欲望），appetiser（开胃饮料、开胃小吃），appetising（引起食欲的、开胃的），compete（一起寻求一样东西 → 竞争）。

words.meaning_zh: v. 请（客）；对待；治疗  n. 款待
words.example_en: It is my turn to treat us today.
words.example_zh: 今天该轮到我请客了。
words.notes: [记] treatment n. 对待；处理；治疗

words.meaning_zh: 为……提供饮食；满足……的需要
words.example_en: Our hotel also caters for weddings and parties.
words.example_zh: 本饭店也承办婚礼和聚会的酒宴。
words.collocations: [搭] cater to/for 满足……的需要，迎合

words.meaning_zh: 供应；预备；[~s] 食品供应
words.example_en: Provision of shelter was the Red Cross’s main concern for the disaster victims.
words.example_zh: 为灾民提供避难处是红十字会的主要关切。

words.example_en: Take something edible with you when you go there.
words.example_zh: 你去那儿时带些吃的。
words.word_formation: 形容词后缀 ible = able，指“能……的”，如：audible（听得见的），inaudible（听不见的），visible（可见的）。“可饮用的”是 drinkable。
words.notes: [记] inedible adj. 不宜食用的

words.example_en: In the recipe, it says that I must use two eggs.
words.example_zh: 这个食谱上说，我必须用两个鸡蛋。

words.example_en: I had my breakfast in a small restaurant.
words.example_zh: 我在一家小餐馆里吃了早餐。

words.meaning_zh: （学校或其他机构的）食堂，餐厅
words.example_en: The meal of the school refectory is healthy and delicious.
words.example_zh: 学校食堂提供的饭菜健康又可口。

words.example_en: There weren’t any free tables, so I sat on a stool at the bar.
words.example_zh: 没有空桌子了，所以我坐在了吧台前的高凳上。

words.example_en: In the cafeteria, we serve ourselves.
words.example_zh: 在自助餐厅，我们自行取餐。
words.word_formation: 相关词语：cafe（咖啡馆），cyber cafe / Internet cafe（网吧），snack bar（小吃店；快餐柜台），pub（酒馆，酒吧）。pub 是 public house 的简称，是英联邦国家常见的饮酒场所，其中一般设有两种酒吧间（bar）：public bar（大众酒吧）和 saloon bar（雅座酒吧）。

words.example_en: We serve buffet during lunchtime only.
words.example_zh: 我们只在午餐时间供应自助餐。

words.meaning_zh: n. 烧烤野餐；烤架  v. 烧烤
words.example_en: If you’re not busy Sunday, we’d love to have you both over for a barbecue.
words.example_zh: 如果你们周日有空，我们想请你俩来吃烧烤。
words.word_formation: 源于美洲西班牙语 barbacoa，可能源自泰诺语，字面意思是“木棍组成的框架”，当地人可能用它支床篷，也可能用它烧烤大块的肉。还可以写作 barbecue 或 BBQ。
words.notes: The word-formation note continues from the bottom of printed page 146 to the top of printed page 147.

words.example_en: His wife made some pumpkin pies for supper.
words.example_zh: 他妻子为晚餐做了一些南瓜馅饼。
words.notes: [记] breakfast n. 早餐  lunch n. 午餐  brunch n. 早午餐  dinner n.（中午或晚上吃的）正餐

words.example_en: He met his foreign friends and gave a banquet in their honour.
words.example_zh: 他会见了外国朋友，并设宴欢迎他们。

words.example_en: We only serve drinks and light refreshments on this short flight.
words.example_zh: 在这班短途航班上，我们只供应饮料和小点心。

words.example_en: Apples are a more nutritional snack than popcorn.
words.example_zh: 苹果是比爆米花更有营养的零食。

words.meaning_zh: (= appetizer) 开胃饮料，开胃小吃
words.example_en: We served some crackers and cheese as an appetiser.
words.example_zh: 我们提供一些饼干和奶酪作为开胃小吃。

words.example_en: Chinese cuisine is the perfect fusion of colour, shape, appearance and flavour.
words.example_zh: 中式菜肴将颜色、形状、外观和味道完美融合。

words.example_en: He called the waiter to bring the menu.
words.example_zh: 他叫侍者拿菜单来。

words.meaning_zh: n. 订单；点的餐  v. 点（酒菜等）
words.example_en: He gave his order to the waiter.
words.example_zh: 他把他点的东西告诉侍者了。

words.example_en: Eat-in or takeaway?
words.example_zh: 店内吃或带走？（快餐店服务员常问）

words.example_en: There is only one chef in that grand hotel.
words.example_zh: 那家大酒店里只有一个厨师。
words.notes: [记] chief n. 首领，头目 adj. 主要的

words.meaning_zh: n. 美食家  adj. 美味佳肴的
words.example_en: The gourmet is very particular about food.
words.example_zh: 这位美食家对食物很挑剔。
words.collocations: [搭] gourmet food 美味佳肴

words.meaning_zh: n. 素食者  adj. 素食的；无肉的
words.example_en: I’ve become used to a vegetarian diet.
words.example_zh: 我已经习惯了吃素。
words.word_formation: 是 vegetable（蔬菜）和 arian（后缀，表示“支持、相信某事物的人”）的组合。而 vegetable 源自拉丁语 vegetus（精力充沛的，生气蓬勃的）。

words.example_en: Knife and fork is the main cutlery used by European people.
words.example_zh: 刀叉是欧洲人的主要餐具。

words.meaning_zh: n. 银；银器  adj. 银的；银色的
words.example_en: She wore a silver chain around her neck.
words.example_zh: 她脖子上戴着一条银链子。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 陶瓷的  n. 陶瓷制品
words.example_en: The ceramic industry dates from the ancient times.
words.example_zh: 陶瓷业可以追溯到古代。

words.example_en: The museum displays specimens of ancient Chinese porcelain.
words.example_zh: 这家博物馆展出了中国古瓷样本。

words.example_en: I have a bowl of cereal every morning.
words.example_zh: 我每天早晨吃一碗麦片粥。
words.collocations: [搭] a fish bowl 鱼缸

words.example_en: The careless waiter dropped the dish onto the ground.
words.example_zh: 那个粗心的侍者把盘子摔到了地上。

words.example_en: He is drinking with a cup and saucer.
words.example_zh: 他正在用带茶托的茶杯喝茶。

words.example_en: He put the toast on the breakfast tray.
words.example_zh: 他把烤面包片放到早餐托盘里。

words.example_en: They usually eat with a knife and fork.
words.example_zh: 他们通常用刀叉吃饭。

words.example_en: He halved an apple with a knife.
words.example_zh: 他用一把刀子将苹果切成两半。

words.example_en: His soup spoon dropped onto the ground.
words.example_zh: 他的汤匙掉到了地上。
words.notes: [记] spoonful n. 一匙（的量）

words.example_en: I cut my hand on some broken glass.
words.example_zh: 破碎玻璃割伤了我的手。

words.example_en: He asked me to make him a mug of coffee.
words.example_zh: 他要我给他弄一大杯咖啡。

words.example_en: The kettle is boiling.
words.example_zh: 壶里的水开了。
words.collocations: [搭] a different kettle of fish 截然不同的人；另一回事

words.example_en: I cracked two eggs into the frying pan.
words.example_zh: 我往煎锅里打了两个鸡蛋。
words.notes: [记] pancake n. 烙饼，薄饼

words.example_en: Will you help me wash up all these pots and pans?

words.example_en: A great deal of whisky is made in Scotland.

words.example_en: I drank a miniature bottle of brandy last night.

words.word_formation: 与 brand（品牌）相关。brand 古义为“火炬；火”，给某种东西烙上烙印，就是原始的品牌标识了。brand-new（崭新的）原来指刚出炉的金属品——还因为高温而发着光。brandy 源自荷兰语 brandewijn。一般认为，以前有商人为了方便运输，将葡萄酒进行蒸馏浓缩，打算到了目的地再重新兑水，但蒸馏后的酒竟意外受到欢迎。这就是 brandewijn，字面意思是“烧过的酒（burnt wine）”，即“蒸馏浓缩后的酒”。这个词进入英文后变化为 brandywine，最后被简化为 brandy，中文音译为“白兰地”。

words.word_formation: 关于汉堡的起源，有很多说法，其中一种是：许多世纪前，鞑靼人喜欢生吃切碎的牛肉，这种吃法经俄罗斯传入德国。德国汉堡（Hamburg）地区的人在做法上进行了改进，将这种肉馅制成饼状。19 世纪中后期，这种烹饪方法随德国移民进入美国，以这种方法烹饪的牛肉被称为 Hamburger steak（汉堡风味的牛排），简称为 hamburger。后来人们喜欢在面包片里夹上 hamburger，于是 hamburger 一词逐渐有了现如今的“汉堡包”的意思。

words.word_formation: 17世纪的英国有一种习俗：人们饮酒时，喜爱把加有香料的烤面包片（toast）放入酒中，据说能使酒的味道更美。后来在祝酒时，有人开始用 toast 指代被祝酒的女士，象征被祝酒者像加有香料的烤面包片一样会为酒增添风味。所以有了现在的说法：Let’s drink a toast to...（让我们为……干一杯！）toast 也有了“为……干杯，向……祝酒”的词义。

words.word_formation: 每逢美国国会开会讨论立法事宜，不同地区和不同行业都纷纷派代表到华盛顿特区，为自己的利益集团去游说。这些人不能去议员开会的地方，只能在参议院和众议院外的大厅（lobby）里聚集，见缝插针地去游说进出的议员。于是，lobby 有了“游说”之义，而 lobbyist（大厅人）就是“说客”的意思。

words.meaning_zh: 暂缓；暂令停职（或停赛等）
words.example_en: I think her suspension from the team is a very harsh punishment.
words.example_zh: 她被暂时禁止随团队参赛，我觉得这是很严厉的处罚。

words.example_en: Hang your coat on the hook.
words.example_zh: 把你的外衣挂在钩上。
words.word_formation: 《小飞侠》（Peter Pan）中的大坏蛋是虎克船长（Captain Hook）。虎克船长最可怕的武器是右手的铁钩（hook），那是在被彼得·潘吹掉右手（并被一条鳄鱼吃掉了断手）后装上的。

words.example_en: Push the lever and the machine will start.
words.example_zh: 推动操纵杆，机器就会启动。

words.example_en: The hut is made of poles covered with grass mats.
words.example_zh: 这个棚屋用木杆搭成，上面盖着草席。

words.example_en: The worker fell down from the scaffold.
words.example_zh: 那个工人从脚手架上摔了下来。

words.example_en: The local government is too poor to invest in social welfare programmes, new infrastructure or anything else.
words.example_zh: 当地政府很穷，无法对社会福利工程、新的基础设施或其他事情进行投资。

words.example_en: A new piece of apparatus was used in the experiment.
words.example_zh: 在这项实验中使用了一个新装置。

words.example_en: We used a crane to lift a slab of concrete.
words.example_zh: 我们用起重机抬起一块混凝土板。

words.example_en: The computer malfunctioned and printed out wrong words.
words.example_zh: 计算机出了毛病，打印出的字不对。
words.word_formation: 前缀 mal 指“坏的，糟糕的”，如 malnutrition（营养不良）和 maltreat（虐待）。

words.example_en: It is absolutely vital that food supplies should be maintained.
words.example_zh: 维持食物供给是绝对必要的。
words.notes: [记] maintenance n. 维持；维护，保养

words.example_en: My watch has stopped. Can you fix it?
words.example_zh: 我的表停了。你能修理吗？

words.example_en: It won’t take long to mend the car.
words.example_zh: 修理这辆汽车用不了很长时间。

words.example_en: We have to modify our plan a little bit.
words.example_zh: 我们得稍微修改一下我们的计划。
words.notes: [记] modification n. 修改，改进

words.meaning_zh: v. 修剪；装饰  adj. 整齐的，整洁的
words.example_en: They trimmed their Christmas tree and put strings of coloured lights on it.
words.example_zh: 他们修剪了一下圣诞树并挂上了一串串彩灯。
words.notes: The example continues at the top of this page.

words.example_en: His job is to weld all those parts together.
words.example_zh: 他的工作是把那些零件全部焊接在一起。

words.example_en: The electric saw whined when my uncle used it to cut the fallen tree.
words.example_zh: 在我叔叔用电锯切割倒下的大树时，电锯呜呜作响。
words.audio_headword: Saw. The electric saw whined when my uncle used to cut the fallen tree.

words.example_en: Turn the screw to the right to tighten it.
words.example_zh: 将螺丝钉向右旋紧。

words.meaning_zh: n. 钻机；反复练习  v. 钻（孔）；训练
words.example_en: The Saudi government has announced plans to drill for water in the desert.
words.example_zh: 沙特政府宣布他们计划在沙漠里钻井探水。

words.meaning_zh: n.（表示垂直度等的）铅锤  v. 用铅垂线校正
words.example_en: We need to plumb the line.
words.example_zh: 我们需要用铅垂线校正这条线。

words.example_en: An overhead road for cars or trains is called a viaduct.
words.example_zh: 供汽车或火车通过的高架道路被称为高架桥。

words.example_en: The bridge has a clear span of 40 metres.
words.example_zh: 这座桥的净跨径为40米。
words.collocations: [搭] span of life 寿命

words.meaning_zh: n. 水坝  v. 控制，抑制
words.example_en: A new dam is under construction at the valley.
words.example_zh: 河谷里正在建一座新水坝。

words.example_en: She assembled the bookshelf all by herself.
words.example_zh: 她是自己一个人组装好这个书架的。
words.notes: [记] assembly n. 集会；[计]汇编

words.example_en: We’re installing a new heating system.
words.example_zh: 我们正在安装新的取暖装置。
words.notes: [记] installation n. 安装的设备；安装

words.example_en: The house is well furnished.
words.example_zh: 这栋房屋被布置得很好。
words.notes: [记] furniture n. 家具

words.example_en: The placement of the buttons and knobs in the car is well thought out.
words.example_zh: 车中按钮和旋钮的布置是经过精心考虑的。

words.example_en: The new page layout is appealing to teenagers.
words.example_zh: 新的版面设计对青少年很有吸引力。

words.meaning_zh: v. 设计；计划  n. 设计
words.example_en: He has already designed a good excuse for not attending the conference.
words.example_zh: 他已经为不参加这次会议编造了一个好借口。

words.example_en: I’ll meet you at the entrance of the zoo tomorrow.
words.example_zh: 明天，我会在动物园的入口处和你会合。

words.example_en: He pretended not to observe our entry.
words.example_zh: 他装作没有看见我们进来。

words.example_en: Please knock on the door before you enter.
words.example_zh: 进来前请先敲门。

words.meaning_zh: n. 出口；退场；离去  v. 离去
words.example_en: I was eventually granted an exit visa.
words.example_zh: 我终于获得了出境签证。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 外部的  n. 外表
words.example_en: He has a rough outside but a kind heart.
words.example_zh: 他外表粗野，但心地善良。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 向外的  adv. 向外
words.example_en: Frost consists of tiny crystals of ice which grow outward from a solid surface.
words.example_zh: 霜由冰的微晶组成，它们从固态表面向外生长。

words.meaning_zh: n. 外部，外观  adj. 外部的
words.example_en: The designer gives a design for the exterior of the container.
words.example_zh: 设计师给出了该容器的外观设计方案。

words.example_en: The external sector has improved performance significantly during the period.
words.example_zh: 在此期间，涉外行业的业绩大大提高。

words.example_en: I can feel the inner peace again.
words.example_zh: 我又能感受到内心的平静了。
words.collocations: [搭] inner feeling/peace 内在的感情/平静

words.meaning_zh: n. 内部  adj. 内部的
words.example_en: Interior design is a very promising industry nowadays.
words.example_zh: 室内设计是当今前景极好的行业。
words.collocations: [搭] interior design 室内设计
words.notes: The example and collocation continue within this page from the bottom of the left column.

words.meaning_zh: adj. 向内的；内心的  adv. 向内
words.example_en: The expedition discovered an inward passage.
words.example_zh: 探险队发现了一条通向内部的通道。

words.example_en: Every theory has its internal logic.
words.example_zh: 每种理论都有其内在逻辑。

words.example_en: He was the first man who navigated the Atlantic alone.
words.example_zh: 他是第一个独自横渡大西洋的人。
words.word_formation: 字根 nav/nau 指“船（ship）”，如：navigate（航行），navy（海军），naval（海军的），nausea（乘船航海 → 晕船 → 恶心），astronaut（星际航行者 → 宇航员）。
words.notes: [记] navigation n. 航行  navigator n. 领航员

words.example_en: He goes on a voyage on a warship in the name of the government.
words.example_zh: 他以政府的名义乘战舰在海上航行。
words.word_formation: “Bon voyage!” 是从法语引入英语的表达，表示“一路顺风！”。在法语中，bon 意为“好的”，voyage 意为“旅行”，相当于英语“Have a nice trip!”。

words.example_en: He was a pilot in the early days of aviation.
words.example_zh: 他是航空业发展初期的飞行员。
words.word_formation: 字根 avi 指“鸟（bird）”，如：avian（鸟[类]的），aviate（鸟的动作 → 驾驶[飞机]），aviator（鸟人 → 飞行员），aviary（鸟的地方 → 大鸟笼，鸟舍）。

words.example_en: I wish a pleasant journey to you!
words.example_zh: 祝你旅行愉快！

words.example_en: During his travels, he met many interesting people.
words.example_zh: 旅行中，他遇到了许多有趣的人。
words.collocations: [搭] travel abroad 出国旅行

words.example_en: We’ll go on safari in Africa after the wedding.
words.example_zh: 婚礼结束后，我们会去非洲进行一次观兽旅行。
words.collocations: [搭] be/go on safari 进行观兽旅行

words.meaning_zh: v. 游行；炫耀  n. 庆祝游行；列队行进；炫耀
words.example_en: The sports meeting began with a parade of all the competing teams.
words.example_zh: 运动会以参赛各队列队入场开始。

words.meaning_zh: v.（鬼魂等）常出没于  n. 常去的地方
words.example_en: This cafe used to be my favourite haunt.
words.example_zh: 这家咖啡馆曾是我最爱去的地方。
words.collocations: [搭] a haunted house 鬼屋

words.meaning_zh: 吸引；具有吸引力的事物
words.example_en: The main attraction in this amusement park is a large swimming pool with salt water.
words.example_zh: 这个游乐园的主要景点是一个大型盐水游泳池。
words.notes: [记] attractive adj. 吸引人的

words.meaning_zh: n. 纪念碑  adj. 纪念的，悼念的
words.example_en: A memorial for victims of the blast was built.
words.example_zh: 人们建起了一座纪念这场爆炸的受害者的纪念碑。
words.notes: [记] memory n. 记忆，回忆  commemorate v. 纪念  monumental adj. 纪念碑上的；不朽的

words.example_en: The ancient pyramid in Egypt is one of the wonders of the world.
words.example_zh: 古埃及金字塔是世界奇迹之一。
words.notes: [记] pharaoh n. 法老  mummy n. 木乃伊

words.example_en: The boy often watched the boats return to port in the late afternoon.
words.example_zh: 这个男孩常常看着小船在傍晚回到港口。
words.word_formation: 由“港口”联想记忆：porter（在港口工作的人 → 搬运工），import（从港口进来 → 进口），export（从港口出去 → 出口），seaport（海港城市），airport（空港 → 机场），transport/transportation（在港口间转移 → 运输），report（从港口回来需要打报告 → 报告），passport（通过港口必要的东西 → 护照）。

words.example_en: You need a visa to enter that country.
words.example_zh: 你要获得签证才能进入那个国家。
words.word_formation: 字根 vis 指“看见（to see）”，如：visa（被看见的东西 → 出示的证件 → 签证），visible（可见的），visit（去看 → 拜访），revise（重新看 → 修改；校订）。

words.example_en: Traffic reaches a peak between 8 and 9 in the morning.
words.example_zh: 早晨八点到九点之间是交通高峰时段。
words.collocations: [搭] traffic regulations 交通规则  traffic flow 车流量  a traffic jam 交通堵塞  traffic congestion 交通堵塞  traffic signals/lights 交通信号灯

words.example_en: The airline launched a European route for the first time.
words.example_zh: 这家航空公司首次开设了欧洲航线。

words.example_en: An airplane engine is a complex mechanism.
words.example_zh: 飞机引擎是一套复杂的机械装置。
words.notes: [记] aeroplane n. 飞机  aircraft n. 飞机

words.meaning_zh: n. 直升机  v. 用直升机载送；乘直升机旅行
words.example_en: The president helicoptered to that city yesterday.
words.example_zh: 总统昨天乘直升机前往那座城市。

words.example_en: Developing the supersonic jet was quite an accomplishment.
words.example_zh: 研发超音速喷气式飞机是一项了不起的成就。

words.example_en: The parachutes in the air look like colourful mushrooms.
words.example_zh: 空中的降落伞看起来像五彩缤纷的蘑菇。

words.example_en: I’ll book a direct flight to Shanghai for you.
words.example_zh: 我将为你预订直飞上海的航班。

words.example_en: A pilot must stay alert for the changes in the weather.
words.example_zh: 飞行员必须对天气变化保持警觉。

words.example_en: The baggage allowance per passenger is 25 kg.
words.example_zh: 每个旅客的行李限重为25公斤。

words.example_en: We may have lost some pieces of baggage, so we want to make a lost-baggage report.
words.example_zh: 我们可能遗失了几件行李，所以想填一份行李遗失报告。
words.collocations: [搭] check in one’s baggage 托运某人的行李

words.example_en: I’ve just been informed that my luggage had already arrived.
words.example_zh: 我刚接到通知说我的行李已经到了。

words.example_en: Her suitcase is stuffed with her clothes.
words.example_zh: 她的手提箱里塞满了她的衣服。

words.meaning_zh: n. [美]（可随身携带上飞机的）小包  adj. 随身携带上飞机的
words.example_en: I only have two carry-on bags with me.
words.example_zh: 我只有两个可随身携带的包。
words.notes: [记] carry v. 携带

words.example_en: He put his bag on the luggage rack.
words.example_zh: 他把包放在行李架上。

words.meaning_zh: n. 货运；货物  v. 运送（货物）
words.example_en: We can send these goods by air freight or by sea freight.
words.example_zh: 我们可以通过空运或海运运送这些商品。
words.notes: [记] freighter n. 货船，运输飞机

words.example_en: She didn’t have enough money for the railway fare.
words.example_zh: 她没有足够的钱买火车票。

words.example_en: Check where Sydney is in your atlas.
words.example_zh: 在你的地图册里查一查悉尼在哪里。
words.word_formation: 阿特拉斯（Atlas）是希腊神话中的提坦巨人（Titan）之一，因反对宙斯（Zeus）失败而被罚在世界的西边尽头以双肩扛天。在16世纪，地理学家墨卡托把阿特拉斯擎天图作为其地图册的卷首插图。其他地图册也争相效仿，atlas 就逐渐被用于指“地图册”了。另外，大家也猜到 Atlantic（大西洋的）一词的来历了吧。

words.example_en: We came by a longer route than usual.
words.example_zh: 我们过来时走了一条比通常要长的路线。
words.notes: The example is printed at the top-right of this page.

words.example_en: We have some more places to visit on our itinerary.
words.example_zh: 在我们的行程中，还有几个地方要游览。

words.example_en: The bridge is not strong enough to allow for the passage of vehicles.
words.example_zh: 这座桥不够牢固，车辆不能通行。
words.collocations: [搭] block passage of information 封锁消息

words.example_en: The town lies at the intersection of three motorways.
words.example_zh: 这座城镇位于三条高速公路的交叉口。

words.meaning_zh: n. 十字形；十字架  v. 穿过
words.example_en: It’s very dangerous for children to cross a busy road.
words.example_zh: 对孩子们来说，穿过交通繁忙的马路很危险。

words.example_en: I am on my way to the grocery store.
words.example_zh: 我正在去食品杂货店的路上。
words.collocations: [搭] on one’s way to 在某人去……的路上

words.example_en: We bumped up and down along the gravel path.
words.example_zh: 我们沿砾石小路颠簸而行。

words.example_en: There are many small lanes in the quaint town.
words.example_zh: 在这古香古色的小镇里，有很多小巷。

words.example_en: One of the world’s most beautiful avenues is the Champs-Élysées in Paris.
words.example_zh: 巴黎的香榭丽舍大街是世界上最美的大街之一。
words.word_formation: 字根 ven 指“来（to come）”，如：avenue（来到，到达 → 大街）；con（共同）+ ven（来）+ tion（后缀）→ 大家一起来 → convention（大会）；event（来到的 → 事件）。世界著名化妆品品牌之一伊丽莎白·雅顿（Elizabeth Arden）最出名的香水叫“第五大道”（Fifth Avenue），得名于美国纽约的第五大道。
words.notes: The word-formation paragraph continues at the top of printed page 175.

words.example_en: A four-lane highway connects the two towns.
words.example_zh: 一条四车道的公路连接着这两座城镇。

words.meaning_zh: 路缘；起控制作用的事物
words.example_en: I stopped and stood at the curb, trying to breathe.
words.example_zh: 我停下来，站在马路牙子上，想缓口气。

words.example_en: The signpost showed us the right road to follow.
words.example_zh: 路标为我们指示了应走的路。

words.example_en: The road was paved with cobblestones.
words.example_zh: 那条路是用鹅卵石铺成的。
words.notes: [记] pavement n.（硬化）路面

words.meaning_zh: 车辆，交通工具；工具，手段
words.example_en: Subway is a convenient vehicle for white-collar workers.
words.example_zh: 地铁对于白领职工来说是很方便的交通工具。
words.collocations: [搭] load a vehicle 把东西装入车中

words.example_en: The auto industry has brought many people to Detroit.
words.example_zh: 汽车工业把许多人吸引到了底特律。
words.notes: [记] automobile n. 汽车

words.meaning_zh: n. 特快列车；快递服务  v. 表示  adj. 特快的
words.example_en: We have to change here for the express train.
words.example_zh: 我们必须在这里换乘特快列车。
words.collocations: [搭] express mail 特快邮件

words.example_en: If you want to go to that place, you can travel by tram.
words.example_zh: 如果你要去那个地方，可以搭乘有轨电车。

words.meaning_zh: n. [英]长途汽车；教练；[英]私人教师  v. 训练
words.example_en: We went to New York City by coach.
words.example_zh: 我们是坐长途汽车去纽约市的。
words.word_formation: 过去指“四轮马车”，后来马车被汽车取代。马车在古代是最快的交通工具，能帮助人们快速到达目的地。同样，有了私人教师或教练的辅导，学生可较快进步，取得理想成绩。通过这种比喻和联想，coach 引申出“私人教师”“教练”“训练”等含义。

words.example_en: An ambulance was racing by with its siren wailing.
words.example_zh: 一辆救护车响着警报急驰而过。

words.example_en: They transported the goods by truck.
words.example_zh: 他们用卡车运货。

words.example_en: A heavy lorry is floundering in deep snow.
words.example_zh: 一辆重型卡车正在厚厚的积雪中挣扎。

words.example_en: As the car turned the corner, it collided with a van.
words.example_zh: 这辆轿车在转过街角时与一辆厢式货车相撞了。

words.meaning_zh: 四轮运货马车（或牛车）；[英]（火车的）货车车厢
words.example_en: An ox pulls a wagon into the village.
words.example_zh: 一头牛拉着一辆四轮车进入村庄。

words.meaning_zh: 四轮马车；[英]（客运火车的）车厢
words.example_en: The carriage which he had ordered arrived, and we drove off.
words.example_zh: 他的马车到了，于是我们出发了。

words.example_en: The tractor has been damaged owing to rough usage.
words.example_zh: 因使用时很不小心，这辆拖拉机受到了损坏。

words.meaning_zh: 运货马车；[美]（超市等提供的）手推车，购物车
words.example_en: A heavy cart rumbled down the street.
words.example_zh: 一辆笨重的马车轰隆隆地驶过街道。

words.example_en: They hopped a pedicab and toured the park.
words.example_zh: 他们坐上一辆人力三轮车，游览了这个公园。

words.meaning_zh: v. 骑（自行车）  n. 周期；自行车
words.example_en: In many universities, students cycle from their dorms to the classroom or library.
words.example_zh: 在许多大学里，学生骑自行车从寝室赶到教室或图书馆。
words.word_formation: 源自表示“圆圈，轮”的希腊文，同根词如：cyclist（骑自行车的人），bicycle（两个轮 → 自行车），recycle（回收利用），cyclone（旋风）。

words.example_en: My car broke down and has been towed to a garage.
words.example_zh: 我的车坏了，已被拉到修理厂去了。

words.meaning_zh: n. 发动机  adj. 机动的
words.example_en: If the battery is dead, the motor won’t be started.
words.example_zh: 电池要是没电了，发动机就无法启动。
words.collocations: [搭] motor vehicles 机动车辆
words.word_formation: 字根 mov/mob/mot 指“移动（to move）”，如：motor（发动机），motion（运动；动作），motive（动机），motivate（激发），promote（向上移动 → 晋升），remote（向后移动，移走 → 遥远的），emotion（移动到了外面 [e = ex] → 感情，情绪）。
words.notes: [记] motorist n. 汽车驾驶人

words.example_en: The horsepower of the engine is not very impressive.
words.example_zh: 该发动机的马力不是很出色。

words.example_en: The driver slumped over the steering wheel.
words.example_zh: 司机重重地倒伏在方向盘上。

words.meaning_zh: n. 车闸；刹车  v. 刹车
words.example_en: The car in front of me stopped suddenly and I had to brake sharply.
words.example_zh: 我前面的那辆车突然停住，我只好急刹车。

words.example_en: My uncle jacked up his car to fix a flat tyre.
words.example_zh: 我叔叔用千斤顶把汽车顶起来，以修理漏气的轮胎。

words.meaning_zh: n. 汽车喇叭声；鹅叫声  v. 按（汽车喇叭）
words.example_en: The drivers honked their horns, hoping to disperse the crowd in the streets.
words.example_zh: 司机们按响汽车喇叭，想把街上的人群驱散。

words.meaning_zh: （轮船、飞机等上的）全体工作人员；（有专门技术的）一组工作人员
words.example_en: I’d like to thank you on behalf of the crew.
words.example_zh: 我代表全体工作人员向你表示感谢。
words.collocations: [搭] a film crew 电影摄制组
words.word_formation: 男孩子国外理发须知：crew cut 是“船员发型”，即“平头”；buzz cut 是“寸头”发型（英文叫法来源于理这种发型时推子所发出的声音）；如果想表现放荡不羁的个性，可考虑 mop-top，“拖把头”（披头士乐队成员的发型）；当然如果你想省钱，可以理 shaved head，即“光头”。

words.example_en: The captain of the sinking ship used flares to attract the attention of the coastguard.
words.example_zh: 轮船正在下沉，船长利用闪光信号吸引海岸警卫队注意。
words.word_formation: 联想记忆：cap 是“帽子”，戴着帽子的“领头人”是 captain。

words.example_en: He is the steward of that great mansion.
words.example_zh: 他是那座大宅子里的管家。
words.notes: [记] stewardess n. 女乘务员

words.meaning_zh: n. 紧急事件  adj. 应急的
words.example_en: He has the ability to keep calm in emergencies.
words.example_zh: 他有处变不惊的本事。

words.meaning_zh: v. 使失事；破坏  n. 失事的船只（或汽车、飞机等）；残破的东西
words.example_en: Because of the tsunami, the coast was a wreck.
words.example_zh: 因为此次海啸，海岸变成一片废墟。

words.example_en: The rocks crashed down onto the car.
words.example_zh: 岩石砸在了汽车上。

words.meaning_zh: v. 压碎，压坏  n. 拥挤的人群；迷恋；迷恋对象
words.example_en: There was such a crush on the bus that I could hardly breathe.
words.example_zh: 公交车上这么拥挤，我几乎透不过气来。
words.word_formation: 该词的经典用法是在表达爱情的场景中，指“迷恋”或“迷恋对象”，如：David has a crush on her.（戴维迷恋她）。身体和心灵时刻都因你的 crush（迷恋对象）而被 crush（压坏），透不过气，那就是 crush（迷恋）。
words.notes: The word-formation note continues at the top of this page.

words.example_en: He dashed the bowl to bits against the ground.
words.example_zh: 他把碗猛扔到地上，摔得粉碎。

words.example_en: He seemed to vanish into thin air.
words.example_zh: 他似乎突然就消失无踪了。

words.example_en: He has disappeared for three years.
words.example_zh: 他已经失踪三年了。
words.collocations: [搭] disappear from 从……消失
words.notes: [记] appear v. 出现；显得

words.meaning_zh: n. 危险  v. 使冒风险
words.example_en: There are many hazards in a journey across the Arctic.
words.example_zh: 穿越北极地区的旅行存在着许多危险。
words.collocations: [搭] at all hazards 不顾一切地
words.word_formation: 源自古法语，指“掷骰子的赌博游戏”，也就是冒险。而 at sixes and sevens（相当于汉语中的“乱七八糟”）这一表达也常被认为源于掷骰子赌博。可以这么联想：你在赌博时押两个骰子（dice）一个出6点，一个出7点，肯定属于大脑缺氧，心绪混乱！听一下麦当娜的《阿根廷，别为我哭泣》（Don’t Cry for Me Argentina）：You won’t believe me. All you will see is a girl you once knew. Although she’s dressed up to the nines（打扮漂亮）, at sixes and sevens with you。
words.notes: [记] hazardous adj. 有危险的

words.example_en: Our hotel room overlooked a pretty little harbour.
words.example_zh: 从我们所在的宾馆房间可以俯瞰一个美丽的小海港。

words.example_en: The ship’s hull scraped along the side of the dock.
words.example_zh: 船身蹭着码头的边。
words.word_formation: 姑苏城外寒山寺，夜半钟声 dock（到客）船。

words.example_en: We raised the anchor and set sail during the night.
words.example_zh: 我们在夜里起锚出发了。
words.notes: The example is printed at the top of PDF page 189.

words.example_en: I watched the submarine submerge.
words.example_zh: 我望着潜艇潜入水中。

words.example_en: A sailor is at the mercy of the weather.
words.example_zh: 水手受制于天气。

words.example_en: There are many skilled seamen on our ship.
words.example_zh: 我们船上有很多老练的水手。

words.example_en: The missile is launched from the aircraft carrier.
words.example_zh: 导弹是从航空母舰上发射的。

words.example_en: The steamer arrived in harbour this morning.
words.example_zh: 这艘轮船今早进港了。

words.example_en: The liner has been refitted from stem to stern.
words.example_zh: 那艘邮轮被全面整修了一遍。

words.example_en: We have sighted the vessel and are following it.
words.example_zh: 我们已发现了那艘船舰，正在跟着它。

words.meaning_zh: n. 渡船  v. 渡运
words.example_en: We can take the ferry that crosses the river every hour.
words.example_zh: 我们可以搭乘每小时过一次河的渡船。
words.collocations: [搭] a steam ferry 蒸汽渡船

words.example_en: His ship has been given the all-clear to sail.
words.example_zh: 他的船已得到航行许可。

words.example_en: After a series of adventures alone on a raft, he eventually reached the village.
words.example_zh: 他独自乘着木筏，经历了一系列冒险，终于到达了那个村庄。

words.example_en: We crossed the lake in a canoe.
words.example_zh: 我们乘独木舟过湖。

words.meaning_zh: n. 桨  v. 用桨划（船）
words.example_en: In dragon boat rowing, each paddler has one oar.
words.example_zh: 划龙舟时，每个桨手都拿着一枝桨。

words.meaning_zh: n. 甲板  v. 装饰
words.example_en: The deck of the sailing ship was made of thick planks.
words.example_zh: 这艘帆船的甲板是用厚木板制成的。
words.collocations: [搭] deck sth. out 装饰某处

words.example_en: The turbine is spun by the high-pressure gases.
words.example_zh: 这台涡轮机是由高压气体驱动旋转的。

words.example_en: The propeller starts to spin around.
words.example_zh: 螺旋桨开始旋转起来。

words.example_en: She seated herself in the stern.
words.example_zh: 她坐进了船尾。
words.notes: [记] bow n. 船头  v. 鞠躬

words.example_en: All passengers aboard fell into the river.
words.example_zh: 船上的所有乘客皆落入河中。

words.example_en: They embarked at Liverpool for New York.
words.example_zh: 他们在利物浦上船，前往纽约。
words.word_formation: 联想记忆：bark 有“树皮”的意思，可以联想为木头，当人从岸边跳上水中的一块木头时，就是“上船”。再想想 aboard：board 是“木板”，aboard（在[船、飞机等]上）就是“在一块木板上”。

words.example_en: The English Channel is between France and England.
words.example_zh: 英吉利海峡在法国和英国之间。

words.meaning_zh: 运河；（人体内输送食物、空气等的）管
words.example_en: The canal is now open to shipping.
words.example_zh: 该运河现已通航。

words.meaning_zh: n. 沟，渠  v. 抛弃
words.example_en: When the road became impassable, they ditched their car and walked.
words.example_zh: 当道路变得无法通行时，他们弃车步行。

words.example_en: The building of the railroad is progressing.
words.example_zh: 这条铁路正在建造中。

words.example_en: The goods were sent to you by railway.
words.example_zh: 货物已由铁路运送到你处。
words.collocations: [搭] a railway station 火车站

words.example_en: The locomotive is detached from the train.
words.example_zh: 火车头脱离了列车。

words.example_en: There is a new subway being built.
words.example_zh: 新的地下通道正在建设中。

words.meaning_zh: adj. 地下的；秘密的  n. [英]地铁
words.example_en: There is an underground passage leading to the old house.
words.example_zh: 有一条地下通道通往这栋老房子。
words.notes: 地铁在美国被称为 subway，在英国则通常被称为 underground，在巴黎等一些城市被称为 metro。

words.example_en: The train roared into a tunnel and everything went black.
words.example_zh: 火车轰隆隆地驶入一条隧道，四周变得漆黑一片。

words.example_en: The man was holding onto the rail as he walked down the stairs.
words.example_zh: 下楼梯时，这名男子一直抓着扶手。

words.example_en: When does the next train depart?
words.example_zh: 下一班列车什么时候出发？
words.collocations: [搭] depart from 离开，从……出发
words.notes: [记] departure n. 离开

words.example_en: You must arrive at the airport at least two hours in advance.
words.example_zh: 你必须提前至少两个小时到达机场。
words.notes: [记] arrival n. 到达

words.example_en: We eventually arrived at our destination.
words.example_zh: 我们终于到达了目的地。

words.meaning_zh: n. 耽搁；延期  v. 使耽搁；使延期
words.example_en: We have decided to delay our holiday until September.
words.example_zh: 我们决定将休假推迟到9月。

words.example_en: The match is postponed from March 5th to March 19th.
words.example_zh: 比赛从3月5日延期到3月19日举行。

words.example_en: We have to defer our departure because of the snowstorm.
words.example_zh: 因为暴风雪，我们不得不推迟出发时间。
words.collocations: [搭] defer payment 拖延付款

words.meaning_zh: n. 暂停，暂时平静期  v. 使昏昏欲睡
words.example_en: The monotonous sound of the train’s movement lulled me to sleep.
words.example_zh: 火车运行时的单调声音使我昏昏欲睡。

words.example_en: My passport is about to expire.
words.example_zh: 我的护照快要到期了。
words.notes: [记] expiration n. 截止，期满。The Chinese example continues at the top of printed page 180.

words.example_en: If you’re going to the library, would you mind returning this book for me? It’s due today.
words.example_zh: 如果你要去图书馆的话，是否介意替我还一下这本书呢？它今天到期。
words.notes: [记] overdue adj. 过期未完成的

words.example_en: What is the postage for an airmail letter?
words.example_zh: 寄一封航空信的邮费是多少？
words.notes: [记] post n. 邮件；职位  postman n. 邮递员  postcode n. 邮政编码

words.meaning_zh: n. 邮票；印章  v. 在……上贴邮票；盖（章）
words.example_en: You can buy a stamp over there and affix it to the postcard.
words.example_zh: 你可以在那里买一张邮票，再把它贴在这张明信片上。

words.example_en: He glued a stamp onto the envelope.
words.example_zh: 他把一张邮票贴在信封上。
words.collocations: [搭] an airmail envelope 航空信封

words.meaning_zh: n. 邮件，邮包；邮政  v. 邮寄
words.example_en: She opened her mail and took out a vase carefully.
words.example_zh: 她打开了邮包，小心翼翼地取出一个花瓶。
words.notes: [记] e-mail n. 电子邮件

words.example_en: The government has imposed an additional tax on a packet of cigarettes.
words.example_zh: 政府对每包香烟进行了额外征税。

words.meaning_zh: n. 包裹；[美]盒，包  v. 包装
words.example_en: The old town was packaged to attract tourists.
words.example_zh: 为了吸引游客，这座老城镇被包装了一下。
words.notes: [记] pack n. 包；背包  v. 打点（行装）

words.example_en: Love rules without a sword and binds without a cord.
words.example_zh: 爱的统治不用刀枪，爱的捆绑不用绳索。
words.collocations: [搭] bind up 包扎

words.meaning_zh: v. 打包，包  n.（土地的）一块；[尤英]包裹
words.example_en: He parceled up the books.
words.example_zh: 他把书打成了包。

words.meaning_zh: v. 装载，装满  n. 负荷；大量
words.example_en: The lorry was carrying a load of pineapples.
words.example_zh: 这辆卡车装着很多菠萝。
words.collocations: [搭] a load of 大量的
words.notes: [记] unload v. 从……卸货

words.meaning_zh: v.（使）担负  n. 重担，负担
words.example_en: It’s a burden I have been carrying for a long time.
words.example_zh: 这是一个我背负了很长时间的重担。
words.collocations: [搭] bear the burden of 背负着……的重担

words.example_en: The cat has transferred her affection to her new master.
words.example_zh: 那只猫已把感情转移到新主人身上了。
words.collocations: [搭] transfer to 转移到
words.word_formation: 前缀 trans 表示“横着穿过，跨越（across）”。

words.example_en: Parents transmit some of their values and ideas to their children.
words.example_zh: 父母会把自己的一些价值观和想法传输给子女。
words.notes: [记] transmission n. 传送；变速器

words.meaning_zh: v. 通过；运送  n. 运输；通行；过境，中转
words.example_en: Transit passengers please go to the transit lounge.
words.example_zh: 中转旅客请前往中转候机室。
words.collocations: [搭] a transit lounge 中转候机室  a transit visa 过境签证  in transit 在运输中
words.notes: [记] transition n. 过渡  transitional adj. 过渡时期的

words.example_en: You don’t have to go out into the rain since the store delivers for free.
words.example_zh: 既然商店可以免费送货上门，你就不用冒雨出去了。
words.notes: [记] delivery n. 递送，交付

words.example_en: It’s hard to convey my feelings in words.
words.example_zh: 我的情感难以言表。

words.example_en: The police advise motorists to reduce their speed because of the fog.
words.example_zh: 由于有雾，警察建议驾驶者减速慢行。

words.example_en: The velocity of light is about 300,000 kilometres per second.
words.example_zh: 光速大约是每秒30万千米。

words.example_en: With the failure of the peace talks, all hopes of a swift end to the war have flown out of the window.
words.example_zh: 随着和谈失败，迅速结束战争的希望全部化为乌有。

words.example_en: He was one of the architects of the republic.
words.example_zh: 他是这个共和国的缔造者之一。
words.collocations: [搭] the People’s Republic of China 中华人民共和国；establish a republic 建立共和国
words.notes: [记] republican adj. 共和的

words.example_en: The essence of Marxism is seeking truth from facts.
words.example_zh: 实事求是是马克思主义的精髓。
words.word_formation: Marx（马克思，马克思主义的创始人，19世纪德国的政治理论家）+ ism（主义，思想）。

words.example_en: Let us do our best to build socialism.
words.example_zh: 让我们尽最大努力建设社会主义。
words.collocations: [搭] serve socialism 为社会主义服务
words.notes: [记] socialist adj. 社会主义的  social adj. 社会的；社交的  society n. 社会；团体

words.example_en: Communism is based on Marxism.
words.example_zh: 共产主义以马克思主义为基础。
words.notes: [记] communist n. 共产主义者  common adj. 普通的；共同的  communal adj. 公共的

words.example_en: The regime got rid of most of its opponents.
words.example_zh: 这一政权除掉了多数反对者。
words.word_formation: 字根 reg 指“统治，管理（to rule）”，如：region（统治的地区 → 区域；领域），regular（有管理的，受统治的 → 有规律的；规则的），irregular（不规则的），regulate（管理，控制），regulation（规定）。

words.example_en: He is a man of some influence in the government.
words.example_zh: 他是个在政府内有一定影响力的人。
words.notes: [记] govern v. 统治，治理；支配  governor n. 统治者；主管

words.meaning_zh: 权力；权威人士；行政管理机构；[the authorities] 当局
words.example_en: The government is the highest authority in a country.
words.example_zh: 政府是国家最高级别的行政管理机构。
words.collocations: [搭] abuse authority 滥用职权
words.notes: [记] authorise（= authorize）v. 授权，批准

words.example_en: The British political system has evolved over several centuries.
words.example_zh: 英国的政治制度经历了几个世纪的发展。
words.collocations: [搭] a political party 政党
words.notes: [记] policy n. 政策  politics n. 政治  politician n. 政治家

words.example_en: There is a rigid hierarchy of power in that country.
words.example_zh: 那个国家有一套严格的权力等级制度。

words.meaning_zh: 民主，民主制度；民主国家
words.example_en: The military government promised to restore democracy within one year.
words.example_zh: 该军政府承诺在一年之内重新建立民主制度。
words.word_formation: demo 指“民众（people）”，cracy 指“统治（to rule）”，所以 democracy 就是“由人民统治”。
words.notes: [记] democratise（= democratize）v. 使民主  democrat n. 民主主义者  democratic adj. 民主的

words.example_en: The government promised to reorganise the bureaucracy.
words.example_zh: 政府承诺重新整顿官僚体制。
words.notes: [记] bureaucratism n. 官僚主义

words.meaning_zh: adj. 平等主义的  n. 平等主义者
words.example_en: Clearly, the egalitarian society remains a dream.
words.example_zh: 显然，平等主义社会仍然是一个梦。

words.example_en: Both of them believed in Marxism and materialism.
words.example_zh: 他们两人都信仰马克思主义和唯物主义。
words.notes: [记] material n. 物质；素材；材料

words.example_en: The invention of aircraft caused a revolution in our ways of travelling.
words.example_zh: 飞机的发明使我们的旅行方式发生了巨大改变。
words.notes: [记] revolutionary adj. 革命的  n. 革命者

words.meaning_zh: n. 改革，改良  v. 改革，改良；（使）改过自新
words.example_en: He promised to reform if given another chance.
words.example_zh: 他保证，只要再给他一个机会，他就改过自新。
words.collocations: [搭] reform and opening up 改革开放

words.meaning_zh: n. 过程，进程  v. 处理；加工；列队前进
words.example_en: They went over every process again, but couldn’t find the cause of the problem.
words.example_zh: 他们把每步过程又检查了一遍，但是找不到问题的原因所在。
words.collocations: [搭] in the process of 在……过程中  in process 在进行中
words.notes: 第二个读音 /prəˈses/ 用于 v. 列队前进。[记] procession n. 队伍，行列；一连串

words.meaning_zh: adj. 保守的  n. 保守党党员
words.example_en: The researchers made a conservative estimation of the population of New Delhi.
words.example_zh: 研究人员对新德里的人口进行了保守的估计。
words.notes: 英国两大政党之一的“保守党”即 Conservative Party。很多人用 conservative 和 reticent 两个词来形容英国人的个性。reticent 表示他们寡言少语，轻易不开口讲话。不像很多北美人给人留下的印象是 IBM——International Big Mouth，到哪里都很健谈。

words.example_en: The commentator sees a bright side to the financial meltdown.
words.example_zh: 这评论员看见了金融危机的乐观一面。

words.example_en: He went to a municipal university.
words.example_zh: 他考上了一所市立大学。
words.collocations: [搭] a municipal government 市政府
words.notes: 例句的中文“市立大学。”续排在本页右栏顶部。

words.example_en: She is neutral in this argument and doesn’t care who wins.
words.example_zh: 在这场争论中，她保持中立，不在乎谁输谁赢。
words.collocations: [搭] remain neutral 保持中立
words.notes: [记] neutrally adv. 中立地

words.example_en: They have signed a bilateral peace treaty.
words.example_zh: 他们已经签署了双边和平协议。
words.collocations: [搭] a bilateral agreement 双边协定  bilateral negotiations 双边谈判

words.meaning_zh: 竞技场，运动场；舞台，活动领域
words.example_en: He withdrew from the political arena.
words.example_zh: 他从政治舞台上退出了。
words.word_formation: arena 在拉丁语中原指“沙；沙地”，指撒上沙子用于打斗的场地。古罗马圆形露天竞技场（amphitheatre）的中央角斗场上用沙土覆盖着地面；在西班牙的斗牛表演（bullfight）中，也可看到公牛血染“沙场”的情景。

words.example_en: Flags were fluttering in the wind.
words.example_zh: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.collocations: [搭] a national flag 国旗

words.example_en: Banners demanding an immediate ceasefire are flying in the city’s main square.
words.example_zh: 要求立即停战的横幅在该城市的主广场上飞扬。
words.collocations: [搭] under the banner of 以……的名义，在……的旗帜下

words.example_en: When the president of the company retired, the vice-president was elevated to his position.
words.example_zh: 该公司的董事长退休时，副董事长被提升为董事长。
words.collocations: [搭] elect sb. (as) president 选举某人为总统

words.meaning_zh: n. 总理，首相  adj. 首要的，第一的
words.example_en: The premier deals with important state affairs.
words.example_zh: 总理处理重要国务。
words.collocations: [搭] of the premier importance 头等重要的
words.notes: [记] premiership n. 总理（或首相）职位（或任期）

words.example_en: The minister can only act in this matter with the sanction of parliament.
words.example_zh: 部长只有得到议会批准才能就此事采取行动。
words.collocations: [搭] foreign minister 外交部部长

words.example_en: The new secretary is being lectured for the poor quality of her work.
words.example_zh: 新来的秘书因为工作质量差而正在被训斥。
words.collocations: [搭] employ a new secretary 雇用新秘书

words.example_en: He lost his seat in the Parliament at the election.
words.example_zh: 他在选举中失去了在议会中的席位。

words.meaning_zh: 大学理事会；[the S~]（美国等国家的）参议院
words.example_en: The bill was approved by both the House and the Senate.
words.example_zh: 那项法案在众议院和参议院均获通过。
words.collocations: [搭] disband a senate 解散理事会

words.meaning_zh: （常持续数日的大型正式）会议；正式商谈
words.example_en: The World Conference on Human Rights discussed the common problems of mankind and advanced human rights work around the world.
words.example_zh: 世界人权大会讨论了人类共同面临的问题，推动了全世界的人权工作发展。
words.collocations: [搭] attend a conference 出席大会

words.example_en: I have written down the date of the next meeting in my diary.
words.example_zh: 我在日记本上记下了下次会议的日期。
words.collocations: [搭] address a meeting 在会上发言  hold a meeting 开会
words.notes: 例句和搭配续排在右栏顶部。

words.example_en: The company’s headquarters is in Paris.
words.example_zh: 这家公司的总部在巴黎。
words.word_formation: head（头）+ quarters（营房，住所）→ 头儿的营房 → 司令部。

words.example_en: The delegation ended their visit to China on March 30th.
words.example_zh: 代表团于3月30日结束了对中国的访问。
words.notes: [记] delegate v. 委派

words.example_en: The president signed the document on behalf of the school.
words.example_zh: 校长代表校方签署了这份文件。
words.collocations: [搭] on behalf of sb. / on sb.’s behalf 代表某人

words.example_en: His strange behaviour made the police suspicious.
words.example_zh: 他不寻常的举止引起了警方的怀疑。
words.collocations: [搭] call the police 叫警察

words.example_en: He will go down in history as a great statesman.
words.example_zh: 他将作为伟大的政治家被载入史册。

words.example_en: The mayor is determined to clean up the city.
words.example_zh: 市长决心清除市内的不良现象。

words.meaning_zh: 服务；公共服务事业；公共事业机构
words.example_en: The volunteers for community service are doing a good job.
words.example_zh: 提供社区服务的志愿者们做得很出色。
words.collocations: [搭] at sb.’s service 可供某人使用

words.meaning_zh: 办公室；要职，官职；[O~] 部，局，厅
words.example_en: Now he holds office in the Foreign Ministry.
words.example_zh: 他现在在外交部担任要职。
words.collocations: [搭] come into office 上任，就职
words.notes: [记] officer n. 官员；军官

words.example_en: The Bureau of Land Management is not so far from here.
words.example_zh: 土地管理局离这里不远。
words.notes: [记] bureaucracy n. 官僚制度；官僚作风

words.meaning_zh: （政府、企业等机构的）部门；（大学的）系，所
words.example_en: He worked in Community Welfare Department.
words.example_zh: 他在社区福利部工作。

words.example_en: Some scientists are working hard at how tide can be harnessed to produce electricity.
words.example_zh: 有些科学家正在努力研究怎样利用潮汐发电。

words.example_en: You will need some experience in administration before you can run the department.
words.example_zh: 你需要有一些行政管理经验才能掌管这个部门。
words.word_formation: minister（部长，大臣）原指“小人物，仆人”，字根 min 指“较少的”。古代大臣们对君主自称“小”，老百姓却称他们为“大人”“大臣”。administer 可理解为：ad（加强意义）+ minister（仆人 → 服务）→ 为相对大的事业服务 → 管理，治理（要高于 manage 的意思）。MBA（学位）就是 Master of Business Administration 的缩写，意为“工商管理学硕士”。

words.example_en: A great man can dominate others by force of character.
words.example_zh: 伟人能以人格的力量支配他人。
words.collocations: [搭] dominate the weaker 支配弱者
words.notes: [记] domination n. 控制，统治  predominate v. 占主导地位；以……为主  predominant adj. 主导的，占优势的；盛行的

words.example_en: A person should rely upon his or her own power.
words.example_zh: 人应该依靠自身的力量。
words.collocations: [搭] come into power 上台，开始执政
words.notes: [记] powerful adj. 强有力的；强大的；有权势的

words.meaning_zh: n. 影响，作用  v. 影响
words.example_en: I was influenced by my teacher and chose to study science at college.
words.example_zh: 我受到了老师的影响，在大学选择了学习理科。
words.collocations: [搭] have an influence on 对……产生影响
words.notes: [记] influential adj. 有影响力的，有势力的

words.meaning_zh: 影响；（感情上）打动，使悲伤
words.example_en: The disease affects the central nervous system.
words.example_zh: 这种疾病侵害的是中枢神经系统。
words.notes: [记] effect n. 影响，作用

words.example_en: The police officer emphasised the importance of careful driving.
words.example_zh: 这位警官强调了小心驾驶的重要性。
words.collocations: [搭] realise the importance 意识到重要性
words.notes: [记] important adj. 重要的；有势力的

words.example_en: This fact has little significance for us.
words.example_zh: 这一事实对我们而言没有什么意义。
words.collocations: [搭] a matter of significance 有重大意义的事情
words.notes: [记] significant adj. 有意义的，重要的

words.example_en: They have established a student organisation.
words.example_zh: 他们建立了一个学生组织。
words.notes: [记] organise (= organize) v. 组织；安排

words.example_en: Have you joined the parent-teacher association?
words.example_zh: 你加入家长教师协会了吗？
words.notes: 例句和[记]在 PDF page 199 顶部续排。[记] associate v. 联想，联系

words.example_en: The largest teachers’ union supports the education reforms.
words.example_zh: 最大的教师工会支持教育改革。
words.collocations: [搭] a trade union [英]工会  a labor union [美]工会
words.word_formation: union（联合）和 onion（洋葱）不但形似而且同源，都来自后期拉丁语 unio，表示“联合；一体”。onion 之所以也来自“联合；一体”之义，是因为它是由若干层包裹而成的一个圆球整体。onion 在古代极受青睐，据说能增强体力。建造金字塔的古埃及工人们吃过它，亚历山大大帝的军队也吃过。

words.example_en: To host the Olympic Games, Beijing expanded its English-speaking community.
words.example_zh: 为主办奥运会，北京扩大了说英语的群体。
words.collocations: [搭] a community centre 社区活动中心

words.example_en: Several big companies have formed a consortium.
words.example_zh: 几家大公司组成了一个财团。

words.example_en: Our club is a member of the Football League.
words.example_zh: 我们的俱乐部是足球联盟的一员。
words.collocations: [搭] form a league 结成联盟

words.meaning_zh: 社会福利机构；（大学、银行等大型）机构
words.example_en: Universities are educational institutions.
words.example_zh: 大学是教育机构。
words.collocations: [搭] an educational institution 教育机构
words.notes: [记] institute n. 研究所，学院

words.example_en: All parties should unite their efforts to bring peace.
words.example_zh: 各方都应团结起来，为实现和平而努力。
words.collocations: [搭] unite closely 紧密团结
words.notes: [记] united adj. 联合的，一致的  unity n. 统一；一致，团结

words.meaning_zh: 独一无二的，唯一的；独特的
words.example_en: Each person’s fingerprints are unique.
words.example_zh: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。
words.collocations: [搭] unique ability 独特的才能

words.example_en: My judgement may be faulty, but my loyalty to the nation could not be questioned.
words.example_zh: 我的判断可能会出错，但是我对国家的忠诚是毋庸置疑的。
words.collocations: [搭] establish a nation 建立国家
words.notes: [记] national adj. 民族的；国家的  nationality n. 国籍；民族  international adj. 国际的

words.example_en: In the coming decades, the Pacific Rim will become the main impetus of the global economy.
words.example_zh: 未来几十年，环太平洋地区将成为全球经济发展的主要动力。
words.collocations: [搭] global warming 全球气候变暖

words.meaning_zh: 世界范围的，遍及全球的
words.example_en: The money came from worldwide contribution.
words.example_zh: 这笔钱是世界各地捐赠的。

words.example_en: Switzerland is a federal state in Europe.
words.example_zh: 瑞士是欧洲的一个联邦制国家。
words.notes: [记] federation n. 联邦制国家；联盟。美国的 FBI（联邦调查局）是 Federal Bureau of Investigation 的首字母缩写，而 CIA（中央情报局）是 Central Intelligence Agency 的首字母缩写。

words.example_en: The new policy helped us to attract a lot of foreign investment.
words.example_zh: 新政策帮助我们吸引了大量的外国投资。
words.collocations: [搭] a foreign policy 外交政策
words.notes: [记] foreigner n. 外国人

words.meaning_zh: adj. 海外的，国外的  adv. 向海外；在国外
words.example_en: The overseas students were concerned about the destiny of their motherland.
words.example_zh: 这些海外留学生关心着祖国的命运。
words.collocations: [搭] overseas trade 海外贸易  an overseas student 留学生

words.meaning_zh: 到国外，在国外；广为流传
words.example_en: The news spread abroad.
words.example_zh: 那消息四处传播。
words.collocations: [搭] travel abroad 到国外旅行

words.meaning_zh: 公民的，国内的；民用的；斯文的
words.example_en: Gone with the Wind, a film about American civil war, is still regarded as one of the best Hollywood films.
words.example_zh: 《乱世佳人》这部关于美国内战的影片仍被认为是好莱坞最好的电影之一。
words.collocations: [搭] civil rights 公民权利  a civil war 内战
words.notes: [记] civilise（= civilize）v. 使文明；开化  civilisation（= civilization）n. 文明

words.example_en: They did not receive the permission to emigrate to the United States.
words.example_zh: 他们没有获准移民美国。
words.notes: [记] emigration n. 移居国外

words.example_en: Many British colonists immigrated to the New World.
words.example_zh: 许多英国殖民者移居到了新大陆。
words.notes: [记] immigration n. 移居（入境）  immigrant n. 移民

words.meaning_zh: n. 君主统治时期  v. 统治
words.example_en: The reign of Queen Victoria lasted more than sixty years.
words.example_zh: 维多利亚女王的统治持续了60多年。

words.example_en: Are we the puppets of fate?
words.example_zh: 我们是听任命运摆布的傀儡吗？
words.collocations: [搭] a puppet government 傀儡政府
words.notes: 例句的中文在右栏顶部续排。

words.example_en: He was only eight when he ascended the throne.
words.example_zh: 他登上王位时才8岁。
words.collocations: [搭] come to the throne 即位，登基

words.meaning_zh: n. 王冠  v. 为……加冕
words.example_en: They crowned him shortly after the old king’s death.
words.example_zh: 老国王去世后不久，他们就为他加冕了。
words.collocations: [搭] succeed to the crown 继承王位

words.meaning_zh: 花环，花冠；（祭奠用的）花圈
words.example_en: A group of students placed a wreath at the tomb of the national hero.
words.example_zh: 一群学生在那位民族英雄的墓前献上花圈。
words.collocations: [搭] a laurel wreath 桂冠（旧时作为胜利的象征）

words.example_en: Britain lost its American colonies in a revolution.
words.example_zh: 在一场革命中，英国丧失了它在美洲的殖民地。
words.notes: [记] colonial n. 生活在殖民地的宗主国居民  adj. 殖民地的，殖民的

words.example_en: Those prisoners are dreaming of liberty.
words.example_zh: 那些囚犯们梦想着获得自由。
words.collocations: [搭] the Statue of Liberty 自由女神像
words.notes: [记] liberate v. 解放；使解脱；释放  liberation n. 解放

words.example_en: The country attained its independence in 1972.
words.example_zh: 这个国家在1972年获得了独立。
words.collocations: [搭] fight for independence 为独立而斗争
words.notes: 例句、[记] independent adj. 独立的；自主的及搭配续排在 PDF page 201 顶部。

words.example_en: I grew up in the East London slums.
words.example_zh: 我是在东伦敦的贫民窟长大的。
words.collocations: [搭] a slum area 贫民区

words.example_en: A small cave was the only refuge from the cold.
words.example_zh: 一个小山洞是唯一的避寒处。
words.collocations: [搭] seek refuge 寻求庇护

words.example_en: The terrorist tried to seek political asylum in that country.
words.example_zh: 该恐怖分子想在那个国家寻求政治庇护。
words.collocations: [搭] an asylum seeker 寻求庇护的人

words.example_en: There is a steady increase in population of this city.
words.example_zh: 这个城市的人口在稳步上升。
words.collocations: [搭] control population 控制人口
words.notes: [记] populate v. 居住于

words.meaning_zh: 人口（学）的，人口统计（学）的
words.example_en: I have no knowledge of demographic theory.
words.example_zh: 我对人口统计学理论一无所知。
words.word_formation: demo（人民）+ graph（写）+ ic（形容词后缀）→ 写关于人民的情况 → 人口统计（学）的。
words.notes: [记] demography n. 人口统计学

words.example_en: She is a lawful citizen.
words.example_zh: 她是个守法的公民。
words.collocations: [搭] an ordinary citizen 普通公民

words.meaning_zh: n. 居民  adj. 居住的
words.example_en: The residents of the town are proud of its new library.
words.example_zh: 该镇的居民为镇上新建的图书馆感到自豪。
words.notes: [记] residential adj. 住宅的，适合居住的

words.example_en: She is keen on ethnic dance.
words.example_zh: 她热衷于民族舞蹈。
words.collocations: [搭] an ethnic minority 少数民族

words.example_en: A new law has been brought in to eliminate racial discrimination.
words.example_zh: 为消除种族歧视，一项新法律已被提出。
words.collocations: [搭] racial equality 种族平等
words.notes: [记] race n. 人种，种族

words.example_en: The whole clan will be here over Christmas.
words.example_zh: 整个家族将在这里过圣诞节。
words.collocations: [搭] rival clans 敌对的家族

words.meaning_zh: v. 出售……的特许经营权  n. 特许权；[the ~]选举权
words.example_en: In Britain, women were given the franchise in 1918.
words.example_zh: 英国妇女于1918年获得了选举权。
words.collocations: [搭] franchise one’s business 出售某人公司业务的特许经营权
words.notes: [记] franchiser n. 授予（他人）特许权者

words.example_en: This ticket entitles you to one-day admission to all three parks.
words.example_zh: 凭这张票你可以在一天内无限次进出全部三个公园。
words.collocations: [搭] be entitled to sth. / do sth. 有获得某物 / 做某事的权利

words.example_en: A teacher should not show preference for any one of his or her students.
words.example_zh: 老师不应表现出对自己的任何一个学生的偏爱。
words.notes: [记] prefer v. 偏好

words.meaning_zh: n. 选举权；投票  v. 表决，投票
words.example_en: The vote will be held next month.
words.example_zh: 下个月将举行投票。
words.collocations: [搭] vote against 投票反对

words.example_en: They organised a poll to elect a president.
words.example_zh: 他们组织了一次投票来选举总统。
words.notes: [记] elective adj. 选任的，由选举产生的  n. 选修课  election n. 选举；当选

words.example_en: Only 34 percent of respondents said they were satisfied.
words.example_zh: 只有34%的调查对象表示他们很满意。

words.meaning_zh: 民意调查；选举投票；投票数
words.example_en: A public-opinion poll shows that most people see the protectionist policies negatively.
words.example_zh: 一项民意调查显示，大多数人对贸易保护政策持负面看法。
words.collocations: [搭] carry out / conduct a poll 进行民意调查
words.word_formation: 英语中的“人头税”叫 poll tax，在美国也叫 head tax。poll 来源于德语，原指“人头”。过去，人们聚集在一起表决，一眼望去只能看见人头攒动，只有数人头来计数。渐渐地，该词的意思演变为“投票数”以及“民意调查”等。

words.example_en: Her ambition was to be a famous politician.
words.example_zh: 她的理想是成为著名的政治家。
words.word_formation: ambit 指“到处走动（to go around）”。古罗马政治家为谋求一官半职，要四处走动、演讲来争取民众选票，因此 ambition 有“雄心，抱负”等含义，很有点儿中文里“好男儿志在四方”的感觉。词源相近的词如：ambulance（救护车），也包含“到处走动”“流动的医院”的意思；ambiguous（到处走动的，不能确定的 → 不明确的，模棱两可的）。
words.notes: [记] ambitious adj. 有雄心的；有野心的

words.example_en: He has been nominated as Minister of Education.
words.example_zh: 他被任命为教育部长。
words.collocations: [搭] nominate sb. for 提名某人为……的候选人
words.notes: [记] nomination n. 提名；任命

words.example_en: The guide contains a useful checklist of points to consider when buying a car.

words.word_formation: 字根 pose 是“放置”的意思，前缀 im 有“在上”或“进入”的意思。impose 就是“放在上面”的意思，引申为“强加”。op 是常见的表示否定意义的前缀之一，是“对着，相反”的意思。op 和 pose 组合就是“向反方向摆放”，所以 oppose 就是“反对，阻挠”的意思。
words.notes: 词源说明续排在右栏顶部。

words.example_en: Chinese people consume huge amounts of rice every year.
words.example_zh: 中国人每年都会吃掉大量的大米。
words.notes: [记] consumption n. 消费；消耗量；吃，喝

words.meaning_zh: v. 花费  n. 开支
words.example_en: The time I spend in commuting every day adds up to two hours.
words.example_zh: 我每天通勤花费的时间加起来有两个小时。
words.collocations: [搭] spend time/money on sth. 在某事物上花费时间 / 金钱  spend time/money (in) doing sth. 花费时间 / 金钱做某事

words.meaning_zh: v. 需付费  n. 费用；代价；[~s] 成本
words.example_en: I’m determined to attain my purpose at any cost.
words.example_zh: 我决心无论如何都要达到目的。
words.collocations: [搭] at a cost of 付出……的代价  the cost of living 生活费用
words.notes: [记] costly adj. 昂贵的  cost-effective adj. 划算的

words.example_en: Societies should try to save every plant and animal species regardless of the expense.
words.example_zh: 社会应不惜代价，尽力挽救每一个动植物物种。
words.notes: [记] expensive adj. 昂贵的

words.meaning_zh: （公司、组织的）收入；（政府的）税收，财政收入
words.example_en: State universities in the U.S. get most of their revenue from taxes.
words.example_zh: 美国的州立大学的大部分收入来自税款。
words.collocations: [搭] a revenue officer 税务员  tax revenue 税收

words.example_en: GDP stands for Gross Domestic Product.
words.example_zh: GDP 表示“国内生产总值”。
words.collocations: [搭] Gross National Product (GNP) 国民生产总值

words.example_en: This country was in a deep economic recession.
words.example_zh: 这个国家处于严重的经济衰退期。
words.word_formation: re（往回）+ cess（走）+ ion（名词后缀）→ 往回走 → 衰退。
words.notes: 例句中文续排在 PDF page 212 顶部。[记] recess v. 暂停，休会

words.meaning_zh: 沮丧，消沉；萧条期，不景气
words.example_en: A holiday may help him cope with feelings of depression.
words.example_zh: 度假也许能帮助他改善抑郁情绪。
words.word_formation: Great Depression（大萧条）：美国历史上一次空前严重的经济危机。1929年10月，股票价格与9月初相比猛跌40%以上。1929年至1932年，美国众多银行和公司破产。据1932年9月《财富》杂志给出的信息，约占美国全国总人口28%的人没有足够的收入。而且，当年有200万人到处流浪。在这次大萧条中，工业、农业、信用危机并发，并波及整个资本主义世界，使世界工业生产总产值下降36%，世界贸易缩减三分之一。
words.notes: [记] depress v. 使沮丧；使萧条

words.example_en: They suffered huge losses in the financial crisis.
words.example_zh: 他们在金融危机中遭受了巨大的损失。
words.collocations: [搭] aggravate a crisis 加深危机  avert a crisis 防止危机  cause a crisis 引起危机  ease a crisis 缓和危机  face a crisis 面临危机  overcome a crisis 克服危机

words.meaning_zh: 安全工作；安全；[securities] 证券
words.example_en: The government looks after the security of the country.
words.example_zh: 政府保障国家的安全。
words.collocations: [搭] the Security Council（联合国）安全理事会

words.example_en: A company issues a bond to collect money and will pay back with interest.
words.example_zh: 一家公司发行债券来募集资金并将会偿还利息。
words.notes: 例句后半句续排在本页右栏顶部。

words.example_en: Liabilities are the debt or obligation that a businessman must pay in money or services at some time in the future.
words.example_zh: 负债是指某个商人将来必须用货币或服务偿还的债务或义务。
words.collocations: [搭] clear a debt 还清债  owe sb. a debt 欠某人一笔债

words.example_en: The current trade deficit indicates a serious imbalance between our imports and exports.
words.example_zh: 当前的贸易逆差表明我们的进口和出口之间存在严重的失衡。

words.example_en: Inflation erodes the purchasing power of the families with lower income.
words.example_zh: 通货膨胀使低收入家庭的购买力不断下降。

words.example_en: Deflation and financial distress stifled economic growth.
words.example_zh: 通货紧缩和金融困境抑制了经济增长。

words.example_en: The number of people going to the bookstores seems to dwindle steadily.
words.example_zh: 逛书店的人数似乎在持续下降。
words.collocations: [搭] dwindle away 渐渐减少

words.meaning_zh: n. 减少，减小  v.（使）减少，（使）减小
words.example_en: Her interest in this subject gradually decreases.
words.example_zh: 她对这个科目的兴趣逐渐减退。

words.example_en: The factory has to downsize and more fully utilise the remaining workers.
words.example_zh: 该工厂不得不裁员，并更加充分地利用剩余的员工。

words.example_en: There is a sharp decline in unemployment.
words.example_zh: 失业率急剧下降。
words.collocations: [搭] decline steadily 逐渐下降  moral decline 道德水准下降
words.notes: [记] declination n. 倾斜；背离；谢绝。相关说明续排在 PDF page 213 顶部。

words.example_en: We should try to diminish the cost of production.
words.example_zh: 我们应尽力减少生产成本。
words.notes: [记] diminution n. 减少

words.example_en: The prices in the shop have been reduced, so it’s a good time to buy.
words.example_zh: 商店里的商品价格降低了，所以现在是买东西的好时候。
words.notes: [记] reduction n. 减少，降低

words.meaning_zh: n. 增加，增长  v.（使）增加，（使）增长
words.example_en: His employer has increased his salary.
words.example_zh: 他的雇主提高了他的薪水。
words.notes: [记] increasing adj. 日益增加的

words.example_en: Your salary will be $12,000 a year, with annual increments of $500.
words.example_zh: 你的年薪为12,000美元，每年增加500美元。
words.collocations: [搭] yearly/annual increment 年增长量

words.example_en: Cold weather constrained the plant’s growth.
words.example_zh: 寒冷的天气抑制了植物的生长。
words.collocations: [例] considerable growth 相当大的增长  gradual growth 逐步增长

words.example_en: The cost of living is escalating in the country.
words.example_zh: 这个国家的生活费用在不断上涨。
words.word_formation: 拉丁语 scala 指“梯子（ladder）”。escalate 源自 escalator（自动扶梯），而 escalator 是 escalate（[用梯子]攀登）和 elevator（升降机）的结合。

words.example_en: Metals expand when they are heated.
words.example_zh: 金属遇热则膨胀。
words.collocations: [搭] expand contact 扩大交往  expand influence 扩大影响
words.notes: [记] expansive adj. 广阔的；扩张的；豪爽的。搭配续排在右栏顶部。

words.example_en: The country simply cannot handle this influx of refugees.
words.example_zh: 这个国家实在没有能力应对大批涌入的难民。
words.collocations: [搭] influx of capital 资本的涌进

words.example_en: We live in an affluent society.
words.example_zh: 我们生活在一个富裕的社会中。
words.word_formation: 字根 flu 指“流（to flow）”，如：fluid（液体），fluent（流利的），fluency（流利）。affluent 中的 a 表示 to，该词原表示“流向……”。财富不断滚滚流入，引申一下即为“富裕的”。

words.example_en: Giving much to the poor will enrich a man’s store.
words.example_zh: 多施舍，财富多。
words.collocations: [搭] enrich the brain/mind 充实头脑 / 心灵
words.notes: [记] enrichment n. 丰富；充实

words.example_en: We must work hard, but equally we must get sufficient rest.
words.example_zh: 我们必须努力工作，但同时也要得到充分的休息。
words.notes: [记] insufficient adj. 不足的

words.example_en: We had adequate food for a week’s journey.
words.example_zh: 我们有足够的食物可以进行一周的旅行。
words.notes: [记] inadequate adj. 不够格的；不充分的

words.meaning_zh: adj. 多余的，空闲的  v. 剩余
words.example_en: If you have a spare bed, may I stay tonight?
words.example_zh: 如果你有空余的床，今晚我可以留下吗？
words.collocations: [搭] spare no effort in doing sth. 不遗余力地做某事  spare time 空闲时间

words.example_en: A saving of 20% is obtainable under this scheme.
words.example_zh: 按这一计划做，可以节约20%。
words.notes: [记] save v. 拯救；节约；保存

words.example_en: During the financial crisis, many workers were made redundant.
words.example_zh: 在金融危机期间，许多职工被裁。
words.collocations: [搭] a redundant worker 被裁的职工
words.notes: [记] redundancy n. 裁员

words.meaning_zh: n. 缺乏，不足  v. 缺少，没有
words.example_en: Serious lack of circulating funds forced the closure of the company.
words.example_zh: 公司因严重缺乏流动资金而被迫关闭。
words.collocations: [搭] lack of 缺少

words.example_en: The company has connections with a number of Canadian firms.
words.example_zh: 这家公司与一些加拿大公司有业务往来。
words.collocations: [搭] keep sb. company 陪伴某人
words.notes: [记] accompany v. 陪伴；伴随

words.meaning_zh: n. 公司  adj. 坚定的；坚固的
words.example_en: Because of their common values, they soon formed a firm friendship.
words.example_zh: 因为有着共同的价值观，他们很快就建立起牢固的友谊。
words.collocations: [搭] firm faith 坚定的信念

words.example_en: They are involved in an exciting scientific enterprise.
words.example_zh: 他们投身于一项激动人心的科学事业。
words.collocations: [搭] build an enterprise 创办一家企业  manage/run an enterprise 经营企业
words.notes: [记] entrepreneur n. 企业家

words.example_en: The travel agent has made all the reservations for my journey.
words.example_zh: 旅行代理商已为我的旅程做好了一切预约安排。
words.collocations: [搭] sole agent 独家代理商

words.example_en: The country is no longer a sovereign entity.
words.example_zh: 这个国家不再是一个拥有主权的实体。
words.collocations: [搭] a business entity 企业实体  an economic entity 经济实体

words.example_en: The state has planned to invest two million in the dam.
words.example_zh: 该国计划投资200万来修建这个大坝。
words.collocations: [搭] invest in sth. 在某方面投资
words.word_formation: 拉丁语 vestis 指“衣服（clothing）”。英语中，vest 指“汗衫，背心”。所以 invest 就是进入（in）衣服（vest），“投资”之义可能源于“使某人的资本转换成其他形式（穿上新衣服）”的意思。
words.notes: [记] investment n. 投资  investor n. 投资者

words.example_en: We must increase the output with less labour input.
words.example_zh: 我们必须在投入更少劳动力的情况下提高产量。
words.notes: [记] output n. 输出量，产量

words.example_en: A series of technical issues delayed the launch of the new product.
words.example_zh: 一系列技术问题延误了新产品的上市。
words.notes: [记] production n. 生产；产生；产量  productive adj. 多产的；富有成效的  produce v. 生产。词形说明续排在 PDF page 215 顶部。

words.example_en: The acquisition of knowledge is a social activity.
words.example_zh: 获取知识是一种社会性的活动。
words.collocations: [搭] the acquisition of a fortune 获得一笔财富

words.example_en: You give me the money and I’ll give you the goods.
words.example_zh: 一手交钱，一手交货。

words.example_en: The ship is discharging the cargo.
words.example_zh: 船正在卸货。

words.example_en: His talent and commitment will insure his success.
words.example_zh: 他的天赋和投入将确保他成功。
words.notes: [记] insurance n. 保险

words.meaning_zh: v. 担保；确保  n. 保证；保修单；担保金，担保物
words.example_en: They offer a two-year guarantee on all their household appliances.
words.example_zh: 他们为销售的家用电器提供两年的保修服务。
words.collocations: [搭] a bank guarantee 银行担保  a credit guarantee 信贷担保

words.example_en: It’s not reliable to judge a man only by his looks.
words.example_zh: 单凭容貌来判断一个人是不可靠的。
words.notes: [记] rely v. 依靠  reliance n. 依靠，依赖  unreliable adj. 不可靠的

words.example_en: We are satisfied with the smoothness of the negotiation.
words.example_zh: 我们对谈判的顺利进行很满意。
words.notes: [记] negotiate v. 谈判，协商

words.example_en: A large number of people attended her birthday party.
words.example_zh: 很多人出席了她的生日聚会。
words.notes: [记] attendance n. 出席的人数；出席

words.meaning_zh: 不在场的，缺席的；心不在焉的
words.example_en: Daniel was absent from the house all the next day.
words.example_zh: 丹尼尔第二天一整天都不在家。
words.collocations: [搭] be absent from 不在（某处）
words.notes: [记] absence n. 缺席；缺乏  absent-minded adj. 健忘的

words.example_en: The store discounted all air conditioners for sale.
words.example_zh: 该店给全部待售的空调都打折了。
words.notes: [记] salesman n. 售货员，推销员  sell v. 卖，销售  seller n. 卖者，销售方

words.example_en: These wholesale dealers earned a large sum of money.
words.example_zh: 这些批发商赚了一大笔钱。

words.example_en: His house was sold at an auction.
words.example_zh: 他的房子被拍卖出去了。
words.collocations: [搭] auction price 拍卖价格  put sth. up for auction 将某物交付拍卖
words.word_formation: 源自拉丁语 augere（增加），与 augment（增加）同源，可以一起记忆。在古罗马时期已存在拍卖这一买卖方式，出价者（bidder）争相加价（增加），拍卖人（auctioneer）接受最高价成交。

words.example_en: They lost the contract because their bid was too high.
words.example_zh: 他们因投标索价太高而失去了那份合同。
words.notes: [记] bidder n. 投标者；出价者

words.meaning_zh: v. 买卖；[~ with] 处理，应付  n. 协议，交易；大量
words.example_en: I’ll deal with the children later.
words.example_zh: 孩子们的事由我以后去处理。
words.collocations: [搭] make a deal with 跟……达成交易  a good/great deal of 很多，相当多的

words.example_en: Because sellers and buyers manage business transactions, it leads companies to keeping in touch with customers.
words.example_zh: 买卖双方要进行交易，这使商家与顾客保持了联系。
words.word_formation: 前缀 trans 指“横着穿过，跨越（across）”，如：trans（跨越）+ action（行动）→ transaction（交易）；transit（通行；过境）；translate（越到了对面 → 翻译）；transparent（穿过来穿过去，两边都清楚明显 → 透明的）；transform（变形）；Transformer（形状变来变去的人 → 经典虚构角色“变形金刚”）。

words.example_en: Annual turnover is about 800 million pounds.
words.example_zh: 年营业额约为8亿英镑。

words.example_en: Some people just dump their rubbish in the river.
words.example_zh: 有些人竟往河里倒垃圾。
words.collocations: [搭] dump into 向……倾销

words.meaning_zh: v. 出口  n. 出口；出口商品
words.example_en: Oil has supplanted coffee as our main export.
words.example_zh: 原油已经取代咖啡，成为我们的主要出口商品。
words.collocations: [搭] export from 从……出口  export to 向……出口  bulk exports 大宗出口商品

words.meaning_zh: v. 进口  n. 进口；进口商品
words.example_en: We import a huge amount of produce from other countries every year.
words.example_zh: 我们每年从其他国家进口大量的农产品。
words.collocations: [搭] import from 从……进口  import duty 进口税

words.example_en: The committee reversed its decision on the import quota.
words.example_zh: 委员会撤销了其关于进口货物配额的决定。
words.collocations: [搭] above quota 超额  an export quota 出口配额，输出限额  an import quota 进口配额，输入限额

words.meaning_zh: n. 股份，股票；（在若干人之间分得的）一份  v. 分享；共享；分担
words.example_en: He has put all his money in stocks and shares.
words.example_zh: 他把钱都投放到股票里去了。
words.collocations: [搭] buy shares 购买股票  hold shares 持有股票  share dealing 股票交易  market share 市场份额

words.meaning_zh: n. 益处  v. 有利于；获益
words.example_en: A large number of students will benefit from the new teaching method.
words.example_zh: 很多学生将从这种新的教学方法中获益。
words.collocations: [搭] benefit from 得益于
words.notes: [记] beneficial adj. 有利的，有益的

words.meaning_zh: n. 兴趣；利益；利息  v. 使感兴趣
words.example_en: You must pay interest on that loan.
words.example_zh: 你必须为那笔贷款付利息。

words.example_en: The company declared a large dividend at the end of the year.
words.example_zh: 公司在年底宣布分发高额股息。
words.collocations: [搭] pay dividends 产生效益

words.example_en: All stock prices have jumped up this month.
words.example_zh: 本月所有股票的价格都暴涨了。
words.notes: [记] stockbroker n. 股票（或证券）经纪人  stockholder n. 股东，持股人

words.example_en: Have you got a bank account?
words.example_zh: 你有银行账户吗？
words.collocations: [搭] account balance 账户余额  on account 以赊账方式
words.notes: [记] accountable adj. 有责任的  accounting n. 会计；记账

words.example_en: The interest of the current account is lower than that of the deposit account.
words.example_zh: 活期存款的利息比定期存款的低。
words.collocations: [搭] bank deposits 银行存款

words.example_en: Buying goods in instalments has become an epidemic in recent years.
words.example_zh: 近几年来，十分流行用分期付款的办法购物。

words.example_en: The bank cashed my cheque.
words.example_zh: 银行兑现了我的支票。
words.collocations: [搭] cash a cheque 兑现支票  write/sign a cheque 开/签支票  dishonour a cheque 拒绝兑现支票  a bad cheque 不能兑现的支票

words.meaning_zh: n. 现金  v. 兑现（支票）
words.example_en: He paid for the meal in cash.
words.example_zh: 他用现金支付了这顿饭。
words.collocations: [搭] pay cash 付现金

words.meaning_zh: n. 硬币  v. 铸币；创造（新词语）
words.example_en: We’d better not coin terms which are not intelligible.
words.example_zh: 我们最好不要造一些别人不容易懂的词语。
words.notes: [记] coiner n. 创造新词语的人；铸硬币（尤其是假币）的人

words.example_en: Five pence was equal to a shilling.
words.example_zh: 五便士等于一先令。

words.example_en: He polished up the old copper coins.
words.example_zh: 他把旧铜币擦亮。
words.notes: [记] coppery adj. 似铜的，紫铜色的  cop n. 警察

words.example_en: This museum has many art treasures.
words.example_zh: 这家博物馆收藏了许多艺术珍品。
words.collocations: [搭] a national treasure 国宝
words.word_formation: 《金银岛》（Treasure Island）是19世纪出生于苏格兰爱丁堡的著名作家罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森（Robert Louis Stevenson）的畅销小说之一。如果说中国的孩子是看着《西游记》长大的，那么英美的孩子就是看着《金银岛》长大的。《金银岛》可算是有史以来最好看的海盗小说之一。
words.notes: [记] treasury n. 财政部；宝库

words.example_en: Health is better than wealth.
words.example_zh: 健康胜于财富。
words.collocations: [搭] accumulate wealth 积聚财富  add to wealth 增加财富
words.notes: [记] wealthy adj. 富有的

words.example_en: The old lady left an estate of three million pounds when she died.
words.example_zh: 这位老妇人去世时留下300万英镑的遗产。
words.notes: [记] real estate n. 房地产

words.example_en: She was possessed by the desire to be rich.
words.example_zh: 她被致富的欲望所控制。
words.word_formation: 字根 sed/sess 指“坐（to sit）”，如：possess（能够坐下来的地方 → 拥有），sediment（坐下的东西 → 沉淀物；沉积物），assess（使坐下 → 评估；估算），obsess（无法 [ob = against] 坐下 → [使]着迷；[使]心神不宁）。
words.notes: [记] possessive adj. 占有欲强的；自私的  possession n. 个人财产；拥有  possessor n. 持有人

words.example_en: The girl received a small legacy from her aunt.
words.example_zh: 这女孩从姑姑那里得到了一小笔遗产。

words.example_en: She is said to be descended from a French aristocratic family.
words.example_zh: 据说，她是法国贵族的后裔。

words.example_en: This book is worthy of reading.
words.example_zh: 这本书值得一读。
words.notes: [记] worthless adj. 无价值的，无用的

words.meaning_zh: 很值钱的，贵重的；很重要的
words.example_en: His wife put on her valuable ring and necklace.
words.example_zh: 他的妻子戴上贵重的戒指和项链。
words.notes: [记] value n. 价值  valuation n. 评价；估价

words.example_en: Cheap shoes soon wear out.
words.example_zh: 廉价的鞋子不耐穿。
words.notes: [记] cheaply adv. 便宜地，廉价地  cheapskate n. 小气鬼，守财奴（续排于本页右栏顶部）

words.example_en: Incentives differ from country to country and region to region.
words.example_zh: 激励政策在国与国、地区与地区之间都不尽相同。
words.collocations: [搭] an incentive to 激励……的措施  chief/main/major incentive 主要的激励措施

words.example_en: Good economic policies can accelerate the economic growth of a society.
words.example_zh: 好的经济政策能加快社会的经济发展。
words.notes: [记] decelerate v.（使）减速

words.meaning_zh: v. 促使  adj. 迅速的
words.example_en: What prompted you to do such a thing?
words.example_zh: 什么促使你做出这种事？
words.notes: [记] promptly adv. 立即

words.meaning_zh: 工资，（尤其指按月领的）薪水
words.example_en: She was employed with a salary of 3,000 dollars a month.
words.example_zh: 她以月薪3000美元受聘。
words.collocations: [搭] get/receive a salary 获取薪水
words.word_formation: 源自拉丁语 salarium（薪金，薪棒），该词又源自拉丁语 sal（盐），词源同英文 salt（盐）。盐在古代很重要，salarium 原本的字面意思即“买盐钱”，据说是古代社会“发给士兵用于购买食盐的津贴”。

words.example_en: Many staff members made an accusation that the earned incomes were not distributed upon the principle of equality.
words.example_zh: 许多员工控诉工资的分配没有遵循公平原则。
words.collocations: [搭] earn income 挣钱

words.example_en: These workers demanded a wage rise of 5%.
words.example_zh: 这些工人要求获得5%的加薪。

words.meaning_zh: 支付；支付的款项；付款额
words.example_en: You may defer payment until next week.
words.example_zh: 你可延期至下周支付。
words.collocations: [搭] demand prompt payment 要求立即支付
words.notes: [记] pay v. 支付。例句、搭配和 Alipay（支付宝）和 Apple Pay（苹果支付），你更喜欢哪一种支付方式呢？续排在 PDF page 219 顶部。

words.meaning_zh: n. 退款  v. 退（款）
words.example_en: We can refund the price difference.
words.example_zh: 我们可以退还差价。
words.collocations: [搭] claim a refund 要求退款

words.example_en: We will reimburse the customer for any loss or damage.
words.example_zh: 我们将赔偿顾客所受到的一切损失和损害。
words.collocations: [搭] reimburse sb. for sth. 向某人赔偿某损失
words.word_formation: 字母 b 和 p 经常相通，如 purse（钱包）和 burse（钱包）是同源词，都源自表示“钱包”的古单词，reimburse 中的 burse 也指“钱包”，故本词的构成是：re（重新）+ im（进入）+ burse（钱包）→ 把拿出来的钱重新放入钱包 → 赔偿。
words.notes: [记] reimbursement n. 赔偿，赔付

words.example_en: Every month she has to make a payroll of the staff.
words.example_zh: 她每月都得制作全体员工的工资名单。
words.collocations: [搭] payroll tax（向雇主和雇员征收的）工资税

words.example_en: He received a small remuneration.
words.example_zh: 他得到了少量报酬。
words.collocations: [搭] overall remuneration 全部报酬  average remuneration 平均报酬  net remuneration 净报酬
words.notes: [记] remunerate v. 给……报酬。搭配续排在本页右栏顶部。

words.example_en: The government has decided to increase subsidies on farm produce.
words.example_zh: 政府决定增加对农产品的补贴。
words.notes: [记] subsidise（= subsidize）v. 资助，给……发津贴

words.example_en: He has earned a lot of money this month.
words.example_zh: 这个月，他已经赚了好多钱。
words.collocations: [搭] earn a living 谋生  earn admiration 赢得人们的赞赏  earn fame 博得名声

words.example_en: I give an undertaking that we shall proceed with the legislation.
words.example_zh: 我保证我们将继续推进该项立法工作。
words.collocations: [搭] a written undertaking 书面保证  an undertaking clause 承诺条款

words.example_en: After the accident, she realised that her acting career was over.
words.example_zh: 这场事故之后，她意识到自己的演艺生涯结束了。

words.example_en: The medical profession requires a strong sense of responsibility.
words.example_zh: 医疗职业要求从业者具有很强的责任感。
words.notes: [记] professional n. 专业人员 adj. 专业的，职业的  professor n. 教授

words.example_en: I regard being a teacher as a decent occupation and I love being a teacher.
words.example_zh: 我觉得教师是个体面的职业，我喜欢当教师。
words.collocations: [搭] an occupation certificate 入住证明书
words.notes: [记] occupy v. 占据；居住  occupational adj. 职业的，工作的

words.meaning_zh: 职业，工作；（一份）工作，活儿
words.example_en: The job is not yet finished.
words.example_zh: 这项工作还没做完。
words.collocations: [搭] a routine job 平淡乏味的工作  a second job 第二职业

words.meaning_zh: （认为特别适合自己的）职业；使命感
words.example_en: She struggled for years to find her true vocation.
words.example_zh: 她挣扎了多年才找到真正适合自己的职业。
words.word_formation: career, occupation, job, vocation 的区别：从词源上看，career 原指“车走的道路”，含有沿着特定轨道一直走下去的意思，即不会改变。所以 career 指长期或终身的，需特殊技能的工作。occupation 来源于 occupy（占据），占据某个岗位，指为了谋生而规律地工作。job 是普通工作，学生打工的那种工作叫 part-time job（兼职），全职是 full-time job。vocation 中的字根 voc 指“召唤（to call）”，表示这份工作是上天的召唤，是“天职”，你特别适合做这份工作，有天分。

words.example_en: Many women do hard manual labour.
words.example_zh: 很多妇女从事艰苦的体力劳动。
words.word_formation: 源自拉丁语 labor（辛勤劳作），同根词如：laboratory（工作的地方 → 实验室），collaborate（一起工作 → 合作），elaborate（努力工作出来 → 精心制作；精巧的）。

words.example_en: This year, 5% of the workforce will be made redundant.
words.example_zh: 今年将有5%的员工下岗。

words.example_en: I do not want to become a workaholic.
words.example_zh: 我不想成为工作狂。
words.word_formation: work（工作）+ aholic（嗜好……的人）。aholic 是一个后缀，加到另一个词的后面可以表示某人喜欢前面这个事物，比如 shopaholic（购物狂），webaholic（网络迷，网虫）。

words.example_en: The next project needs new personnel.
words.example_zh: 我们的下一个项目需要新人员。
words.collocations: [搭] personnel department 人事部门
words.notes: [记] personal adj. 个人的；私人的

words.example_en: The clerk was elevated to a managerial position.
words.example_zh: 那个办事员被提拔到了经理职位。
words.collocations: [搭] an accounting clerk 记账员  an auditing clerk 审计员

words.meaning_zh: n. 面试；采访  v. 对……进行面试；采访
words.example_en: The interview has drawn considerable attention to the profession.
words.example_zh: 这个访谈使很多人关注这一行业。
words.notes: [记] interviewer n. 面试官；采访者  interviewee n. 被面试者；被采访者

words.example_en: Please e-mail your personal résumé to us before sitting a written test.
words.example_zh: 参加笔试之前，请将个人简历用电子邮件发给我们。

words.example_en: I recommend you to reserve a table in advance.
words.example_zh: 我建议你提前预订用餐的桌位。
words.notes: [记] recommendation n. 推荐；推荐信

words.example_en: They employ casual labour to pick the fruit.
words.example_zh: 他们雇用临时工摘水果。
words.collocations: [搭] be employed in 从事于
words.notes: [记] employer n. 雇主，老板  employee n. 雇员，职工  employment n. 雇用；工作  unemployment n. 失业  employed adj. 有工作的  unemployed adj. 失业的

words.meaning_zh: v. 雇用；租用  n. 租赁（业）
words.example_en: They hired an advertising company to help sell a new product.
words.example_zh: 他们雇用了一家广告公司来推销一款新产品。
words.notes: [记] hireling n. 给钱就什么都愿意做的人

words.example_en: He was fired by his boss.
words.example_zh: 他被他的老板解雇了。

words.meaning_zh: （因岗位不足的）解雇，裁员；歇工期
words.example_en: There are more lay-offs in the IT industry this year.
words.example_zh: 今年，信息技术行业有更多裁员行动。

words.example_en: If you are late again, you will be dismissed.
words.example_zh: 如果你再迟到，你就会被解雇。
words.collocations: [搭] dismiss the case 驳回该案件  dismiss the court 退庭
words.word_formation: 字根 miss 指“送（to send）”。所以被发送出的玩意儿叫 missile（导弹）；送给你的“任务”叫 mission，完成不了的任务就叫 Mission Impossible（《碟中谍》）；dis（分离）+ miss（送）→ 零零散散地送走 → dismiss（开除；解散）。
