words.collocations: [搭] veterinary medicine 兽医学

words.meaning_zh: 顾问，辅导顾问；（美国的）律师
words.example_en: I’d like to talk to my counsellor before I answer any of your questions.
words.example_zh: 在回答你提出的任何问题前，我想先和我的律师说话。

words.meaning_zh: （英国的）诉状律师，事务律师；（美国的）法务官
words.example_en: We asked a solicitor for advice.
words.example_zh: 我们向一位事务律师进行咨询。

words.example_en: The defense attorney’s objection was overruled by the judge.
words.example_zh: 辩护律师的反对意见被法官驳回了。
words.word_formation: 英联邦国家多用 lawyer，barrister，solicitor。lawyer 是律师的统称，使用范围广泛。barrister 指大律师，能在高等法院出庭办案。bar 作名词时有“栏杆，栅栏”之义，也指法庭上法官席附近的围栏（犯人接受传讯，大律师上来进行辩护的位置）。那么 solicitor 就是和 bar 没有关系的律师啦——小律师，不能出庭说话，一般是 barrister 的助手。

words.example_en: Mack was thrown out of the game for hitting an umpire.
words.example_zh: 麦克因为殴打裁判被逐出比赛。
words.word_formation: 英语中有一些词形拼写变化，即由于发音的原因而导致词形拼写发生变化。在中世纪，“一名裁判员”原来是 a noumpere，后来不定冠词 a 和名词的首字母 n 被错误地合在一起，就成了 an oumpere。同样情况的还有：apron（围裙），是从 a napron 变成 an apron 的；orange（橙），原来在阿拉伯语里是 nāranj，进入欧洲后，传着传着，词首的 n 就被合到冠词里去了；nickname（绰号），在中世纪英语中原本是 ekename，但 an ekename 后来被错分成了 a nekename。

words.example_en: A cashier takes and gives out money in a bank or shop.
words.example_zh: 出纳员在银行或者商店里收付钱款。
words.notes: [记] cash n. 现金

words.example_en: I saw a fireman racing into the burning house.
words.example_zh: 我看见一个消防队员冲入了着火的房子中。

words.meaning_zh: n. 护士；保姆  v. 护理
words.example_en: She is waiting for the nurse to give her an injection.
words.example_zh: 她正在等待护士过来给她打针。
words.notes: [记] nursing n. 护理工作

words.example_en: The old gardener had rough hands.
words.example_zh: 老园丁有一双粗硬的手。
words.collocations: [搭] a landscape gardener 园林设计师

words.example_en: He asked the barber to crop his hair short.
words.example_zh: 他让理发师把他的头发剪短。

words.example_en: He was unshaven and badly needed a haircut.
words.example_zh: 他没刮脸，头发也着实需要理一理了。

words.example_en: What is it like to be a tuna fisherman?
words.example_zh: 当一名捕金枪鱼的渔夫是什么感觉？

words.example_en: Tom is a friendly butcher in our neighbourhood.
words.example_zh: 汤姆是我们这个街区的屠夫，是个很友好的人。
words.collocations: [搭] a butcher’s 肉店，肉铺

words.meaning_zh: n. 马夫；新郎  v.（给动物）刷洗；理毛、梳毛
words.example_en: The head groom is responsible for seeing that his stablemates have safe journeys.
words.example_zh: 马夫长负责确保他的赛马都安全到达。
words.notes: [记] bridegroom n. 新郎  bride n. 新娘

words.example_en: A British journalist was held hostage for over two years.
words.example_zh: 一位英国记者被作为人质扣押了两年多。
words.notes: [记] ransom n. 赎金

words.meaning_zh: n. 苦工，苦活；网，圈套  v. 辛勤劳作，苦干
words.example_en: They spent months of toil on the water conservation project.
words.example_zh: 他们为这项节水工程辛辛苦苦干了数月。
words.collocations: [搭] toil and moil 辛辛苦苦地工作

words.example_en: He tossed the beggar a handful of coins.
words.example_zh: 他扔给那个乞丐一把硬币。
words.notes: [记] beg v. 恳求；乞讨

words.example_en: Slaves were mercilessly ground down by slave owners.
words.example_zh: 奴隶们受到奴隶主的残酷压迫。

words.example_en: He is a liar and a coward to boot.
words.example_zh: 他喜欢说谎，而且还是个懦夫。

words.meaning_zh: v. 行动  n. 行为
words.example_en: Dreaming is one thing but acting is another.
words.example_zh: 想是一回事，但做是另外一回事。
words.notes: [记] activity n. 活动  active adj. 活跃的，积极的  action n. 行动  interact v. 互相影响，互相作用

words.example_en: The children must behave in a way which will be socially acceptable.
words.example_zh: 孩子们的行为举止必须是社会能接受的。
words.notes: [记] behaviour (= behavior) n. 行为

words.example_en: The primacy of the deed is over word and thought.
words.example_zh: 行动胜过言语和想法。

words.example_en: They had to accustom themselves to the hot weather.
words.example_zh: 他们不得不去习惯炎热的天气。

words.example_en: An acid can react with an alkali to form a salt.
words.example_zh: 酸和碱能起化学反应从而形成盐。
words.collocations: [搭] react to 对……作出反应
words.notes: [记] reaction n. 反应；反对

words.example_en: I offered him a drink but he didn’t respond.
words.example_zh: 我请他喝酒，但他没有回应我。
words.notes: [记] response n. 反应，回应

words.example_en: Her look reflected the thought passing through her mind.
words.example_zh: 她的神情反映出她头脑中闪过的念头。
words.word_formation: 字根 flect/flex 指“弯曲（to bend）”，如：re（回来）+ flect（弯曲）→ 弯曲回来 → reflect（反射）；flexible（能弯曲的 → 灵活的）；inflexible（不能弯曲的 → 执着的，不屈的）；de（离去）+ flect（弯曲）→ 弯曲出去 → deflect（使偏转）。
words.notes: [记] reflection n. 反射；映象；倒影

words.example_en: They must bear most of the blame.
words.example_zh: 他们应承担大部分责任。
words.collocations: [搭] bear responsibility for 对……负有责任

words.example_en: They adopted our effective methods.
words.example_zh: 他们采用了我们的有效方法。
words.notes: [记] adapt v. 适应

words.example_en: Milk could nourish a baby.
words.example_zh: 牛奶可供给婴儿营养。
words.notes: [记] nourishment n. 营养品  nourishing adj. 有营养的，滋补的  malnourished adj. 营养不良的

words.meaning_zh: v. 割，修剪  n. 干草堆
words.example_en: I want to have my garden mowed.
words.example_zh: 我想请人来给我的花园割草。
words.collocations: [搭] mow the lawn 修剪草坪

words.meaning_zh: v. 支撑；支持；供养  n. 支持；帮助
words.example_en: We should encourage and support them to participate in collective activities with friends, family, colleagues and support groups.
words.example_zh: 我们应该鼓励和支持他们与朋友、家人、同事及互助小组一起参加集体活动。

words.example_en: Take a deep breath, then exhale slowly.
words.example_zh: 深吸一口气，然后慢慢呼出。
words.notes: [记] inhale v. 吸气

words.example_en: He heard a sharp intake of breath.
words.example_zh: 他听到有人猛地倒吸一口冷气。
words.collocations: [搭] dietary intake 饮食摄取量  caloric intake 热量摄取量

words.example_en: The fresh air soon revived him.
words.example_zh: 新鲜空气很快就使他苏醒过来了。
words.word_formation: 字根 viv 表示“活（to live）”，如：前缀 re 表示“再一次（again）”，revive 就是“再一次活过来”；前缀 su/super 表示“在……上（over）”，survive 就是“比……活得长”，即“幸存”；vivid 即“鲜活的，生动的”。相关字根 vit 表示“生命（life）”，如 vital（必不可少的）。

words.example_en: The man was very ill, but he survived.
words.example_zh: 这个男人病得很厉害，可是他活下来了。

words.meaning_zh: v. 怒目而视；发出强光  n. 刺眼的光；怒视
words.example_en: The glare of the oncoming headlights temporarily blinded me.
words.example_zh: 对向车灯发出的刺眼光照使我暂时什么也看不见。

words.meaning_zh: v. 瞥见  n. 一瞥
words.example_en: I caught a glimpse of our new neighbour.
words.example_zh: 我瞥见了我们的新邻居。
words.collocations: [搭] get a glimpse of 瞥见

words.meaning_zh: v. 瞥，迅速看一眼  n. 一瞥
words.example_en: The man glanced at the burglar climbing out of the window.
words.example_zh: 那人瞥见小偷从窗户爬出来。
words.collocations: [搭] at first glance 乍一看，乍看上去

words.meaning_zh: v. 窥视，偷看  n. 偷偷一瞥
words.example_en: I peeped through the window to see if she was there.
words.example_zh: 我通过窗子偷偷往里看，想看看她在不在。
words.word_formation: Peeping Tom 指“偷窥狂”。传说，古时的考文垂（Coventry）领主横征暴敛，他的妻子为民请命，与丈夫打赌：某日自己裸体骑马穿过整个城镇的街道，丈夫就要降低税率。全城百姓出于感激，自觉回避。只有一个裁缝汤姆（Tom）在窗口偷窥，而后双目失明。汤姆因此名垂史史。考文垂城中有一尊他的雕像。
words.notes: [记] peephole n.（门上的）窥视孔

words.example_en: The child gazed at the toys in the shop window.
words.example_zh: 这孩子的眼睛盯着商店橱窗里的玩具。

words.meaning_zh: v. 凝视，盯着看  n. 同等地位的人，同辈
words.example_en: The new postman peered through the mist, trying to find the right house.
words.example_zh: 新来的邮递员在雾中仔细张望，没法找到他要找的那一家。

words.example_en: He stared at the word, trying to remember what it meant.
words.example_zh: 他盯着这个单词，努力想记起它的意思。
words.collocations: [搭] stare at 凝视，盯着看
words.word_formation: 拉丁语中的 stare 指“站立（to stand）”，故英语单词中的 sta 常有“站立；持续；固定；静止”等含义，如：station（一直站立的地方 → 车站），statue（站立的，持续固定的东西 → 雕像）。

words.example_en: The young surgeon contemplated the difficult operation of kidney transplant.
words.example_zh: 年轻的外科医生考虑要做这一棘手的肾移植手术。

words.meaning_zh: n. 誓约  v. 发誓
words.example_en: The couple made their wedding vows at St. Paul’s Church.
words.example_zh: 这对情侣在圣保罗教堂里完成了婚礼宣誓。
words.word_formation: 一生中最大的承诺莫过于婚誓（wedding vow）。西方教堂婚礼上的常见誓言：I, Harvey, take you, Echo, to be my lawfully wedded wife, to have and to hold, from this day forward, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, to love and to cherish, till death do us part.（我，哈维，娶汝，埃科，为合法妻子。从今起，无论境遇顺遂或乖逆，富贵或赤贫，罹疾或康泰，当与汝长相厮守，相爱相惜，至死不渝。）

words.example_en: He swore an oath to support and protect the king.
words.example_zh: 他宣誓支持并保护国王。
words.collocations: [搭] take/swear an oath 宣誓

words.meaning_zh: v. 保证  n. 保证，誓言
words.example_en: The conflicts continued in spite of a no-strike pledge by the unions.
words.example_zh: 冲突仍在继续，虽然工会保证不罢工。

words.meaning_zh: n. 口哨；哨子；汽笛声  v. 吹口哨；吹哨子
words.example_en: The referee blew the whistle at the end of the game.
words.example_zh: 裁判在比赛结束时吹响了哨子。

words.example_en: He tried to reply and then stopped.
words.example_zh: 他似乎要回答，却又止住了。

words.example_en: I notified him that the meeting had been postponed.
words.example_zh: 我通知他会议已经延期。
words.notes: [记] notice n. 通知；布告；注意  v. 注意到

words.meaning_zh: 断言，坚称；坚持（自己）的主张
words.example_en: Justice will assert itself.
words.example_zh: 正义必将得以伸张。

words.example_en: He explained his plan in detail.
words.example_zh: 他详细说明了自己的计划。
words.notes: [记] explanation n. 解释，说明

words.example_en: We had a quarrel about the price.
words.example_zh: 我们就价格的问题争吵起来。
words.collocations: [搭] quarrel with 跟……吵架
words.notes: [记] complain v. 抱怨

words.example_en: A long dispute means that both parties are wrong.
words.example_zh: 持久的争论意味着双方都是错的。
words.collocations: [搭] a dispute against 与……的争议

words.example_en: We accepted the agreement without argument.
words.example_zh: 我们毫无异议地接受了这一协议。
words.collocations: [搭] accept an argument 接受论点
words.notes: [记] argue v. 争论；辩论；说理

words.example_en: As for that film you mention, not my scene.
words.example_zh: 至于你提到的那部电影，不合我的胃口。
words.collocations: [搭] at the mention of 在提到……时；一提起

words.meaning_zh: v. 赶紧；催促  n. 匆忙
words.example_en: I’m in no hurry to get back to school.
words.example_zh: 我不想急着回学校去。

words.example_en: It was now obvious that she was hastening to restore the car to its owner.
words.example_zh: 现在，她显然正急着把车归还原主。
words.notes: [记] hasty adj. 勿忙的，仓促的  haste n. 急速，匆忙，草率

words.meaning_zh: v. 催促，敦促  n. 冲动
words.example_en: They urged Washington to reconsider its decision.
words.example_zh: 他们敦促美国政府重新考虑其决定。
words.collocations: [搭] urge sb. to do sth. 敦促某人做某事
words.notes: [记] urgent adj. 紧迫的，紧急的

words.example_en: Don’t scold the child without reason.
words.example_zh: 不要无缘无故地责骂小孩。

words.meaning_zh: v. 诅咒；咒骂  n. 咒语；咒骂话
words.example_en: A light purse is a heavy curse.
words.example_zh: 无钱万事难。
words.collocations: [搭] be under a curse 被诅咒

words.example_en: He had to swear that his story was true.
words.example_zh: 他不得不发誓说他的故事是真实的。

words.example_en: Mind you, that dog is very dangerous when provoked.
words.example_zh: 当心，那条狗被激怒时是很危险的。
words.notes: [记] thought-provoking adj. 引起思考的，发人深省的

words.example_en: He was always preaching about the benefits of exercise and fresh air.
words.example_zh: 他总是宣扬运动和呼吸新鲜空气的好处。
words.collocations: [搭] preach at/to sb. 对某人说教

words.example_en: Nobody should boast of his knowledge.
words.example_zh: 谁也不应当夸耀自己的学识。
words.collocations: [搭] boast about/of 夸耀，吹嘘
words.notes: [记] boastful adj. 自夸的，自吹自擂的

words.example_en: If you always tease others like that, you’ll forfeit the good opinion of your friends.
words.example_zh: 你如果老是那样嘲弄别人，就会丧失朋友们的好感。

words.meaning_zh: v. 嘲笑，嘲弄  adj. 模拟的；假装的
words.example_en: They mocked at my timidity.
words.example_zh: 他们嘲笑我胆小。
words.collocations: [搭] a mock exam 模拟考试

words.meaning_zh: v. 触摸；触动  n. 触觉；接触
words.example_en: By the way, you don’t want to touch the onion and then touch your eyes.
words.example_zh: 顺便一提，碰过洋葱后别摸眼睛。
words.collocations: [搭] get in touch with 与……取得联系，和……接触  stay/keep in touch with 和……保持联系

words.example_en: He hugged his daughter tightly.
words.example_zh: 他紧紧抱住他的女儿。

words.example_en: My father tapped me on the shoulder.
words.example_zh: 我父亲轻轻拍了拍我的肩膀。

words.meaning_zh: v. 拍手；轻拍  n. 鼓掌
words.example_en: Let’s give the children a big clap.
words.example_zh: 让我们为孩子们热烈鼓掌。
words.collocations: [搭] clap hands 拍手

words.example_en: Everyone applauded when the play ended.
words.example_zh: 演出结束时，大家都热烈鼓掌。

words.example_en: The man knelt down to say his prayer.
words.example_zh: 这个男人跪下来进行祷告。

words.example_en: It is natural for a cat to catch mice.
words.example_zh: 猫捉老鼠是本能。
words.collocations: [搭] catch up on 了解；补做，赶做  catch up with 赶上，追上

words.example_en: He snatched the book from my hands.
words.example_zh: 他一把从我手里抢走了书。

words.example_en: She grabbed the seat near the fire before I could.
words.example_zh: 她赶在我前面抢占了靠近火的座位。

words.meaning_zh: 抓牢，握紧；完全理解，全面领会
words.example_en: A man who grasps at too much may lose everything.
words.example_zh: 贪得无厌的人可能反而会失去一切。

words.example_en: I had to drive very fast to overtake you.
words.example_zh: 我不得不开得非常快才能超过你。

words.meaning_zh: 跟随；是……的必然结果；遵循
words.example_en: You are to follow his advice.
words.example_zh: 你必须听从他的劝告。
words.collocations: [搭] follow suit 跟着做，照着做

words.meaning_zh: v. 紧握，抓牢  n. 紧握，抓牢；理解，了解
words.example_en: She has a fragile grip on reality.
words.example_zh: 她并不是十分了解现实形势。
words.collocations: [搭] in the grip of 受到……严重影响

words.meaning_zh: n. 混乱，脏乱  v. 弄乱
words.example_en: Your books and magazines are all in a mess; go and put them in order.
words.example_zh: 你的书和杂志简直是乱七八糟的，去把它们整理一下。
words.collocations: [搭] mess up 弄乱，弄脏
words.notes: [记] messy adj. 凌乱的；难以处理的

words.meaning_zh: v. 拧，扭；使缠绕  n. 拧，扭动
words.example_en: Twist the lid to open it.
words.example_zh: 拧这个盖子来打开它。

words.example_en: The crowd scattered when a dustbin suddenly exploded.
words.example_zh: 一个垃圾箱突然爆炸了，人群逃散开。

words.example_en: She folded the letter so that it would fit into her bag.
words.example_zh: 她把信折起来，以便可以装到包里。
words.notes: [记] foldable adj. 可折叠的  unfold v. 展开，打开；展示

words.example_en: Please fasten your seat belts while the plane is taking off.
words.example_zh: 飞机起飞时请系好安全带。

words.example_en: My belt is too tight. I must loosen it.
words.example_zh: 我的腰带太紧，我必须松一松它。

words.meaning_zh: 打碎；（使）猛烈撞击；（打球时）扣球
words.example_en: Although the bed was smashed to pieces, the man was miraculously unhurt.
words.example_zh: 虽然床碎得稀巴烂，人却奇迹般地没有受伤。

words.meaning_zh: v. 擦破，刮坏；搔  n. 乱涂；划痕，擦伤
words.example_en: He scratched the insect bite on his arm.
words.example_zh: 他挠了挠手臂上被虫咬的地方。

words.example_en: She wiped off the dust with a rag.
words.example_zh: 她用一块抹布擦掉了灰尘。
words.collocations: [搭] wipe away 擦掉，清除

words.meaning_zh: v. 刮掉；擦坏；勉强获得  n. 刮；擦伤
words.example_en: The family has to scrape by on social security.
words.example_zh: 这家人不得不靠社会保障金勉强维持生活。

words.example_en: Silver can be easily polished with this special cloth.
words.example_zh: 用这块特殊的布能很容易把银擦亮。

words.example_en: My skin always peels when I’ve been in the sun.
words.example_zh: 我晒过太阳后皮肤总会脱皮。

words.example_en: The crowd split into several groups.
words.example_zh: 这群人分成了数组。

words.example_en: Swaying hips properly is the basis of the heel-and-toe walking race.
words.example_zh: 正确地摆动臀部是竞走的基本要素。

words.meaning_zh: v. 摇动，（使）颤动  n. 摇动，颤动
words.example_en: The movie didn’t give me any kind of shake.
words.example_zh: 这部影片没有任何触动我的地方。
words.collocations: [搭] shake hands with 与……握手

words.example_en: Some insects’ wings vibrate so fast that the movement is invisible to the human eye.
words.example_zh: 有些昆虫的翅膀振动得很快，以至于人类用肉眼看不见。
words.notes: [记] vibration n. 振动，摆动

words.example_en: He whirled about in the yard.
words.example_zh: 他在院子里面走来走去。

words.example_en: You can rotate the wheel with your hand.
words.example_zh: 你可以用手转动车轮。

words.example_en: My head reeled with the facts and figures.
words.example_zh: 我的脑子被一堆事实和数据搅得一片混乱。

words.meaning_zh: v. 洗（牌）；拖着脚走；搅乱……的次序  n. 洗牌
words.example_en: With sore legs and aching chest, he shuffled over to the bathroom.
words.example_zh: 忍着腿上和胸口的疼痛，他拖着脚走向浴室。
words.word_formation: 可通过发音帮助记忆。仔细听听洗扑克牌时的声音，“洗牌”这个动作就叫 shuffle cards。那么 reshuffle 就是“重新洗牌”，引申为“改组，公司重组”。另外一个词 shuttle，指“（班车、飞机等）频繁穿梭往返”，从 shuttle 的发音本身也可体会“呼啸”和“穿梭”的含义。
words.notes: [记] reshuffle n. 改组，公司重组

words.example_en: In running round the corner, he collided with another man.
words.example_zh: 在跑过拐角时，他撞上另一个人。
words.collocations: [搭] collide with 与……相撞；与……冲突

words.example_en: This remote tribe had little contact with the outside world.
words.example_zh: 这个偏远的部落和外界几乎没有什么联系。
words.collocations: [搭] be in contact with 和……接触，与……有联系  lose contact with 和……失去联系

words.example_en: Has the phone been connected yet?
words.example_zh: 电话接通了吗？
words.collocations: [搭] connect A to/with B 使 A 和 B 连接起来

words.example_en: Carbon, hydrogen and oxygen can combine to form carbohydrates and fats.
words.example_zh: 碳、氢、氧可以结合在一起形成碳水化合物和脂肪。
words.notes: [记] combination n. 联合，结合

words.meaning_zh: v. 与……黏合（或连接）  n. 黏合；（感情的）纽带
words.example_en: These two different materials won’t bond together.
words.example_zh: 这两种不同的材料无法黏合在一起。

words.example_en: Little attempt was made to integrate the parts into a coherent whole.
words.example_zh: 在把各部分合并成一个连贯整体方面几乎未进行任何尝试。
words.collocations: [搭] integrate A into/with B 使 A 与 B 结合
words.notes: [记] integration n. 整合，一体化  integral adj. 构成整体所必需的

words.example_en: Wrapped up in this shawl, you look more pretty.
words.example_zh: 围上这条围巾，你看上去更漂亮了。

words.example_en: Western ideas penetrate slowly through the East.
words.example_zh: 西方观念逐渐渗入东方。

words.meaning_zh: 刺穿，刺破，穿透；使心如刀割
words.example_en: The needle pierced the material.
words.example_zh: 这根针刺穿了织物。

words.meaning_zh: v. 插入，嵌入  n. 插入物
words.example_en: He inserted the key into the lock but could not open the door.
words.example_zh: 他把钥匙插入锁中，但没能打开门。
words.collocations: [搭] insert A in/into B 把 A 插入 B 中

words.example_en: I tilted the cup to drink out of it.
words.example_zh: 我斜着杯子以便喝里面的水。
words.notes: [记] tile n. 瓦片；瓷砖

words.meaning_zh: v. 拖，拉，牵引  n. 牵引
words.example_en: We towed the car to the garage.
words.example_zh: 我们把车子拖到了汽车修理间。

words.meaning_zh: v.（使）拖在后面；跟踪  n. 踪迹
words.example_en: The carriage drove along a dirt road and left a trail of dust.
words.example_zh: 马车顺着一条土路行驶，车后扬起了一缕尘土。

words.example_en: Contact your local branch to arrange an appointment.
words.example_zh: 联络你们当地的分支机构安排一次约见。
words.notes: [记] arrangement n. 安排

words.example_en: He uses his credit to manipulate his supporters.
words.example_zh: 他用他的信用控制他的拥戴者。
words.notes: [记] manipulation n.（熟练的）操作；操纵

words.meaning_zh: 为（船）操舵，驾驶（船、车等）；操纵
words.example_en: He steered the ship carefully among the reefs.
words.example_zh: 他小心地在礁石间驾驭船。
words.word_formation: steer 源自表示“站立”的字根，后来引申出“站立着的事物”的意思。古代船只航行时，船舵立在船上，站立着 steer（掌舵）的就是 steerer（舵手）。
words.notes: [记] steerable adj. 可操纵的  steering n. 转向装置

words.example_en: It transpired that Mark had been baptised a Catholic.
words.example_zh: 马克受洗成为天主教徒的事已为人所知。
words.word_formation: 牧师以“I believe in God the Father Almighty（我信我全能的天父）”开始，在受洗者头上洒几滴 holy water（圣水），或将其身体浸入水中，以诵到“I baptise you in the name of the Trinity（我奉圣父、圣子、圣灵之命为你施洗）”结束。洗礼象征着洗清罪恶，准备接受上帝的恩典。
words.notes: [记] baptism n.（基督教的）洗礼，浸礼

words.meaning_zh: v. 下（注），打赌；敢说  n. 打赌；赌注
words.example_en: I bet our team will win.
words.example_zh: 我敢说我们队准能获胜。
words.collocations: [搭] You bet! 当然！的确！

words.meaning_zh: n. 赌注；桩  v. 以……打赌
words.example_en: I’d stake my all on it.
words.example_zh: 我敢拿我的一切打赌。
words.collocations: [搭] at stake 有风险

words.example_en: Don’t gamble with your future.
words.example_zh: 不要拿你的前途去冒险。
words.collocations: [搭] take a gamble on sth. 冒险从事某事
words.notes: [记] gambler n. 赌徒

words.meaning_zh: n. 诺言  v. 承诺
words.example_en: I hope you’ll keep your promise to come for a long visit.
words.example_zh: 我希望你遵守诺言，来这里多待几天。
words.collocations: [搭] break/keep a promise 违反/遵守诺言  promise to do sth. 承诺做某事
words.word_formation: pro（在前）+ mise（送出）→ 提前送出 → 提前说出来的 → 诺言。
words.notes: [记] promising adj. 有希望的，有前途的

words.example_en: She was attracted by the novel advertisement.
words.example_zh: 她被这个新颖的广告吸引了。
words.collocations: [搭] attract sb.’s attention 吸引某人的注意力
words.word_formation: 字根 tract 指“拉（to draw）”，如：去拉一拉 → attract（吸引）；拖拽留下的痕迹叫 track；拖拉机是 tractor；拉到一起 → contract（合同）；往回拉 → retract（撤回，收回）；拉出来 → 一个事物的实质内容被拉走了 → abstract（抽象的；摘要）；拉着离开 → distract（使分心）。
words.notes: [记] attraction n. 吸引；有吸引力的地方  distract v. 分散（注意力），使分心

words.example_en: He became absolutely obsessed with the girl in red.
words.example_zh: 他完全被这位红衣少女迷住了。
words.collocations: [搭] be obsessed by/with 被……迷住，对……着迷

words.example_en: I stood by the lake, mesmerised by the flashing colours of the fish.
words.example_zh: 我站在湖边，被鱼身上闪烁的色彩迷住了。
words.word_formation: 来源于现代催眠术先驱、德国医生梅斯梅尔（Mesmer）的名字。可表示“催眠状态”的单词 hypnosis 则来自希腊神话中的睡神许普诺斯（Hypnos），所以“催眠师”是 hypnotist，“对（某人）施催眠术”是 hypnotise。

words.example_en: This midterm exam is a nightmare.
words.example_zh: 这次的期中考试真是一场噩梦。
words.word_formation: mare 一词指“母马”，但在 nightmare 一词中，mare 指古时传说中的“梦淫妖”，即趁人在睡梦中时与之交合的妖怪。人们曾认为，做噩梦是因为此妖怪坐在睡眠者身上使其窒息的缘故。

words.example_en: John amazed his friends by suddenly getting married.
words.example_zh: 约翰突然结婚，令朋友们大为吃惊。
words.notes: [记] maze n. 迷宫

words.meaning_zh: v. 感到惊讶，大为赞叹  n. 奇迹
words.example_en: I marvel at how it can be so.
words.example_zh: 事情竟会如此，我感到惊异。
words.notes: [记] marvelous adj. 不可思议的，非凡的

words.example_en: We were astonished to hear that their football team had won the championship.
words.example_zh: 听说他们的足球队获得了冠军，这真叫我们想不到。
words.word_formation: 来看这组表示“吃惊”的单词：surprise 的“惊讶”程度最低；amaze 相当于 surprise very much，一般指好事；astonish 和 astound 同源，来自拉丁文 extōnare，指“被雷击中”，惊讶程度非常高，而 astound 指“使惊骇”，比 astonish 的程度更强烈。
words.notes: [记] astound v. 使大吃一惊，使惊骇

words.example_en: This forum will involve people with specialist knowledge.
words.example_zh: 这次论坛将由有专业知识的人参加。
words.collocations: [搭] involve sb. in (doing) sth. 使某人卷入某事  be/get involved in sth. 参与某事；被卷入某事
words.word_formation: 拉丁语 volvere 是“滚，转（to roll）”的意思，过去分词为 volutus。所以英语单词中的 volve 和 volut 常有 to roll 的含义：involve（滚在里边 → 包含，牵涉），evolve（滚动着展开 → 发展；进化），evolution（进化；发展），revolve（重新滚动 → 旋转；围绕），revolution（革命）。“沃尔沃”（Volvo）是瑞典著名的汽车品牌，是拉丁文，意为 I roll，即“我在旋转”“滚滚向前”。

words.example_en: Sometimes, we annoy or upset others unintentionally.
words.example_zh: 有时候，我们会在无意中惹别人 生气。
words.notes: [记] annoyance n. 恼怒，气恼

words.meaning_zh: 使心烦意乱，使生气；搅乱；打翻
words.example_en: I hope I haven’t said anything to upset you.
words.example_zh: 但愿我没有说什么让你不高兴的话。

words.example_en: A new environment can bewilder and frighten a child.
words.example_zh: 一个新环境会让孩子不知所措并感到害怕。

words.meaning_zh: 反话；有讽刺意味的情形
words.example_en: The irony is that some of the poorest countries have the richest natural resources.
words.example_zh: 讽刺的是，一些最贫穷的国家拥有最丰富的自然资源。
words.notes: [记] ironic adj. 反话的；具有讽刺意味的

words.example_en: The soldiers who were captured had to endure many indignities at the hands of the enemy.
words.example_zh: 被俘的士兵在敌人手中不得不忍受许多侮辱。

words.example_en: A liar is held in contempt.
words.example_zh: 说谎者为人轻视。
words.collocations: [搭] in contempt of 不把……放在眼里；蔑视

words.example_en: In course of time, old customs and observances tend to fall into neglect.
words.example_zh: 随着时间推移，旧风俗和传统仪式有被忽略的趋势。
words.collocations: [搭] neglect of 忽视
words.word_formation: 字根 neg 指“否定”，如 negative（消极的；否定的）。字根 lect 指“选（to select）；搜集（to gather）”，如 collect（收集）。所以 neglect 是：没被选出，没被搜集 → 忽视。
words.notes: [记] overlook v./n. 忽视

words.meaning_zh: v. 不顾，漠视  n. 忽视，漠视
words.example_en: Disregarding all difficulties, we succeeded in bringing them around in the end.
words.example_zh: 尽管困难重重，我们最终说服他们同意了。
words.collocations: [搭] in disregard of 不顾，无视

words.example_en: Where ignorance is bliss, ’tis (= it is) folly to be wise.
words.example_zh: 难得糊涂。
words.collocations: [搭] be in ignorance of 对……全然不知

words.meaning_zh: v. 使有偏见，使偏心  n. 偏见，偏心
words.example_en: His experiences bias him against businessmen.
words.example_zh: 他的经历使他对商人持有偏见。
words.collocations: [搭] have a bias against 对……有偏见  have a bias toward 偏重，偏爱
words.notes: [记] prejudice n. 偏见，成见

words.example_en: His statement deviates from the truth.
words.example_zh: 他的陈述偏离了事实。
words.notes: [记] deviation n. 偏离；偏差

words.example_en: The pupil was expelled for stealing.
words.example_zh: 那名学生因偷窃被开除。

words.example_en: Follow love and it will flee, flee love and it will follow thee.
words.example_zh: 追求爱情它高飞，逃避爱情它跟随。（thee 意为“你”，旧用词 thou 的宾格）
words.word_formation: 来练一段绕口令（tongue-twister）：A flea and a fly flew up in a flue. Said the flea, “Let us fly!” Said the fly, “Let us flee!” So they flew through a flaw in the flue.

words.meaning_zh: v. 恐吓，欺凌  n. 恃强凌弱者
words.example_en: He’s always bullying smaller boys.
words.example_zh: 他总是欺侮比他小的男孩子。
words.word_formation: 可能源自荷兰语 boel（情人）。后来英语里出现该词，意思是“恋人，心上人”。到了17世纪，bully 成了 someone who controls a prostitute，类似于“拉皮条的”，词义逐渐贬降。

words.meaning_zh: n. 惊恐，惊慌  v.（使）惊恐，（使）惊慌
words.example_en: When the theatre caught fire, there was a panic.
words.example_zh: 剧院失火时，出现了一阵恐慌。
words.word_formation: 希腊神话中的森林之主潘（Pan）长着人身羊足，头上有角，居住在森林之中。他常藏在隐蔽处，猛然跳出，把旅行者吓得魂不附体。故 panic 一词原指“潘引起的恐惧”。口语中常说：Don’t panic.（不要惊慌。）

words.example_en: Her husband’s violence terrified her.
words.example_zh: 丈夫的暴行使她感到恐惧。
words.notes: [记] terrifying adj. 可怕的  terrorist n. 恐怖分子  terror n. 恐惧  terrorism n. 恐怖主义

words.meaning_zh: n. 报仇，复仇  v. 向……报仇
words.example_en: Hamlet took revenge for his father’s murder.
words.example_zh: 哈姆雷特为他父亲的死报了仇。
words.collocations: [搭] be revenged on sb. / revenge oneself on sb. 向某人报仇
words.word_formation: 古法语“报仇”为 vengier，单词 avenge 和 revenge 都源自该词，所以都指“报仇”。从单词构成来看，avenge 中的 a=to，指“向某人报仇”，而 revenge 中 re 表示加强意义，似乎更强调了报复的意志和仇恨。avenger 是“复仇者”。

words.example_en: A businessman has been kidnapped.
words.example_zh: 一个商人被绑架了。
words.word_formation: kidnap 原为盗贼切口，字面意思是 to steal a child（诱拐小孩）。其中 kid 就是 child，nap 为 nab（捉住）。过去在英国，kidnap 往往只限于表示诱拐小孩并把他们贩卖到美洲大陆当契约佣役。

words.meaning_zh: 劫持（飞机或其他交通工具）
words.example_en: The terrorists hijacked the plane and held all the passengers hostage.
words.example_zh: 恐怖分子劫持了飞机，把所有乘客劫为人质。
words.word_formation: 也拼作 highjack。词源不明，也许是：歹徒在抢劫时害怕反抗，每每高呼“High, Jack!”（Jack 可用来泛称人、哥们儿、家伙），意思是“哥们儿，把手举高点儿！”。hijacker 指“劫匪”，skyjack 专指“劫机”。

words.example_en: He was caught smuggling cameras into the country.
words.example_zh: 他被抓到向这个国家走私照相机。
words.notes: [记] smuggler n. 走私者

words.meaning_zh: v. 定罪，宣判……有罪  n. 已决犯
words.example_en: He was convicted of murder.
words.example_zh: 他被判犯有谋杀罪。
words.word_formation: 字根 vict/vinc 指“征服（to conquer）”，如：convict（一起征服 → 宣告有罪），我们一起去征服别人之前，应该先宣告对方有罪；victor（胜利者）；victory（胜利）；convince 表示完全地征服了对方，引申为“说服，使信服”。

words.example_en: The economist argues that high taxation strangles the economy.
words.example_zh: 该经济学家反驳说，高额征税会扼杀经济。

words.example_en: The massacre of Jews by Nazi in World War II was appalling.
words.example_zh: 第二次世界大战中纳粹分子对犹太人的杀戮是骇人听闻的。

words.meaning_zh: 大批杀死，大量毁灭；大大削弱
words.example_en: Those policies resulted in a decimation of essential services used by the poor.
words.example_zh: 那些政策导致穷人能享受的必要服务大大减少。

words.example_en: I shall leave on Sunday if nothing intervenes.
words.example_zh: 如果没有事情干扰，我将于星期天动身。

words.example_en: Nothing can impede his progress.
words.example_zh: 没有什么能妨碍他的进度。
words.word_formation: 字根 ped 表示“足（foot）”，如：impede（脚不行了，双脚被缠住了 → 妨碍），pedal（用脚操作的东西 → 踏板），pedestrian（步行者），expedition（使脚向外 → 远征，探险）。
words.notes: [记] impair v. 削弱；妨碍

words.example_en: Those unwary investors are allured by promises of quick profits.
words.example_zh: 那些毫无风险意识的投资者被能快速获得利润的承诺吸引。
words.word_formation: 源自古法语。 al (= to，去) + lure（诱惑）→ 引诱。
words.notes: [记] lure v. 引诱

words.meaning_zh: v. 使上当受骗  n. 诱饵；诱惑物
words.example_en: He is known for baiting his opponents.
words.example_zh: 众所周知，他善于激怒对手。

words.example_en: Nothing shall induce me to join their club.
words.example_zh: 我怎么都不会加入他们的俱乐部。
words.collocations: [搭] induce sb. to do sth. 劝说某人做某事
words.notes: [记] inducement n. 引诱；刺激物  seduce v. 引诱，勾引

words.example_en: Apply generous amounts of sunscreen 15 minutes before you go out—don’t allow impatience to tempt you into sunburn.
words.example_zh: 外出15分钟前要涂抹足量的防晒霜——别因没耐心而被晒伤。
words.collocations: [搭] resist temptation 抵制诱惑
words.notes: [记] temptation n. 引诱，诱惑

words.example_en: He designated Smith as his successor.
words.example_zh: 他指定史密斯为他的继承人。
words.notes: [记] appoint v. 指派

words.example_en: It is not possible to assign this building an exact date.
words.example_zh: 这座建筑物的确切年代是无法确定的。
words.collocations: [搭] assign sb. to (do) sth. 指派某人去做某事  assign sth. to sb. 把某事物分配给某人

words.example_en: His part-time job on Sunday was to distribute leaflets on the street.
words.example_zh: 他在周日的兼职是在街上派发传单。
words.collocations: [搭] distribute sth. among 在……中分发某物
words.notes: [记] distribution n. 分发；分布  distributor n. 分发者；批发商

words.example_en: He despatched his breakfast and left.
words.example_zh: 他匆匆吃完饭就离开了。
words.word_formation: 国外的报纸上常有一个栏目叫 Hatch, Match and Despatch，登载五花八门的个人广告，比如：恭喜谁家生了小孩（hatch），找工作、征婚（match），哀悼某人去世（despatch，被派遣到上帝身边了）。

words.example_en: He had to detach himself from social activities for the time being in order to concentrate on his studies.
words.example_zh: 为了专注于学习，他只好暂时撇开社交活动。

words.example_en: He finally managed to undo this knot.
words.example_zh: 他终于设法解开了这个结。

words.meaning_zh: v. 掩饰；假扮，伪装  n. 假扮；伪装物
words.example_en: The spy disguised himself as a nurse.
words.example_zh: 这个间谍假扮成一名护士。
words.collocations: [搭] in disguise 伪装的

words.example_en: He was unable to conceal his surprise.
words.example_zh: 他无法掩盖自己的惊讶。
words.collocations: [搭] conceal your intentions 隐藏好你的意图

words.example_en: Jonah’s mother refused to let him go abroad.
words.example_zh: 乔纳的母亲不答应让他出国。
words.word_formation: 字根 fuse 指“倾倒（to pour）；融化，熔化（to melt）”，如：re（回来）+ fuse（倾倒）→ 不让倾倒出去 → refuse（拒绝）；fuse（熔丝，保险丝）；di（二；分别）+ fuse（倾倒）→ 向两边分别倾倒 → diffuse（散播；扩散）。
words.notes: [记] refusal n. 拒绝；推却

words.example_en: They excluded people under 18 from joining the club.
words.example_zh: 他们拒绝接纳18岁以下的加入俱乐部。
words.word_formation: 字根 clud/clos/clus 指“关闭（to shut or close）”，如：ex（向外）+ clude（关闭）→ exclude（拒绝；把……排除在外），而电视里经常听到的“独家新闻”就是 exclusive news，意思是“别人被排除了，只有我拥有的新闻”；in（里面）+ clude（关闭）→ 关在里面 → include（包括，包含）；dis（否定）+ close（关闭）→ 打开 → disclose（揭露）；con（共同）+ clude（关闭）→ 一同闭嘴 → conclude（结束；作出结论）。
words.notes: [记] exclusive adj. 排外的；独占的

words.meaning_zh: v. 颠倒，彻底改变；撤销  n. 相反的情况；反面  adj. 相反的
words.example_en: He reversed the judgement and set the prisoner free.
words.example_zh: 他撤销了原判并释放了囚犯。
words.notes: [记] reversal n. 颠倒

words.example_en: I can assure you of the reliability of the news.
words.example_zh: 我可以向你保证这消息是可靠的。
words.notes: [记] assurance n. 信心；保证

words.example_en: The developed countries should undertake the main responsibilities of global warming.
words.example_zh: 发达国家应承担应对全球变暖的主要责任。

words.example_en: We have stipulated a date of payment and a price.
words.example_zh: 我们规定了偿付日和价格。
words.notes: [记] stipulation n. 规定，明确要求

words.example_en: He finally convinced us of his innocence.
words.example_zh: 他终于使我们相信他是清白的。
words.collocations: [搭] convince sb. of sth. 使某人相信某事
words.notes: [记] convincing adj. 令人信服的

words.example_en: When the child was afraid in the storm, his parents reassured him.
words.example_zh: 孩子在暴雨中感到害怕时，他的父母就安慰他。

words.meaning_zh: v. 想要（某事发生）  n. 希望
words.example_en: I wish it to be clearly understood.
words.example_zh: 我希望大家能清楚地明白这一点。
words.collocations: [搭] make a wish 许愿  wish sb. a complete success 预祝某人取得圆满成功

words.example_en: These college graduates aspire to careers in finance.
words.example_zh: 这些大学毕业生渴望从事金融方面的工作。
words.collocations: [搭] aspire to do sth. 渴望做某事
words.word_formation: 字根 spir 指“呼吸（to breathe）”，如：aspire（对着某物呼吸 → 渴望）；spirit（呼吸，生命的根源 → 精神，灵魂）；inspiration（里面的呼吸，精神的启示 → 灵感）；conspiracy 的字面意思就是“一同呼吸”，所以是“密谋，合谋”的意思。有一句经典的话：A man respires, aspires, perspires, inspires, and finally expires.（一个人诞生于世，立志，奋斗，启发，最终辞世。）

words.meaning_zh: n. 愿望，欲望  v. 渴望，期望
words.example_en: He desired a college education.
words.example_zh: 他渴望接受大学教育。

words.example_en: The children who had been abducted and sold yearned to return to their homes.
words.example_zh: 那些被拐卖的孩子渴望回家。
words.collocations: [搭] yearn for 渴望

words.meaning_zh: 唤起（感情等）；向……祈求帮助；恳求
words.example_en: The man despaired and invoked the gods.
words.example_zh: 这个男人感到了绝望，并祈求神灵相助。
words.collocations: [搭] invoke sb.’s help 恳求某人帮助

words.meaning_zh: v. 发痒；渴望  n. 痒；渴望
words.example_en: I’ve got an itch on my back.
words.example_zh: 我的背上很痒。
words.collocations: [搭] itch for 渴望

words.meaning_zh: v. 尝试，试图  n. 尝试，企图
words.example_en: He studied hard in an attempt to pass the exam.
words.example_zh: 他努力学习，试图通过考试。
words.collocations: [搭] attempt at doing sth. 企图做某事，尝试做某事  attempt to do sth. 尝试做某事

words.example_en: With the power of will and wisdom, we can strive for victory.
words.example_zh: 带着意志力和智慧，我们就能够争取胜利。
words.collocations: [搭] strive after/for 为……奋斗

words.example_en: Our efforts were unavailing.
words.example_zh: 我们的努力都是徒劳。
words.collocations: [搭] make great efforts to do sth. 非常努力去做某事

words.example_en: We are determined to fulfil the task.
words.example_zh: 我们决心要完成这项任务。

words.example_en: The prices ranged from 10 pounds to 20 pounds.
words.example_zh: 价格自10英镑至20英镑不等。
words.notes: [记] ranger n. 护林员，公园看管人（助记：在一定范围内走来走去的人）

words.meaning_zh: n. 种类，类别  v. 把……分类
words.example_en: We must sort out the good apples from the bad ones.
words.example_zh: 我们必须把好苹果从坏苹果中挑出来。
words.collocations: [搭] sort of 有那么一点，有几分  of all sorts 各种各样的

words.meaning_zh: v.（庞大物或形状模糊之物）隐现；逼近  n. 织布机
words.example_en: A hard struggle looms ahead.
words.example_zh: 一场苦斗迫在眉睫。
words.word_formation: loom 的拼写很有意思。loo 像数字 100，m 可看作单位“米”。在 100m 开外的事物，若隐若现。loom 作名词有“织布机”的含义，也好记：织布机每天织布 100m。

words.meaning_zh: 发射；发布，推出；发起（运动等）
words.example_en: Full market research is needed before a new product is launched.
words.example_zh: 推出新产品之前需要进行充分的市场调查。

words.example_en: I will commence a round of visits.
words.example_zh: 我将开始一系列访问。
words.notes: [记] commencement n. 开始

words.example_en: They plan to exploit oil under the sea.
words.example_zh: 他们计划开发海底石油。
words.notes: [记] exploitation n. 开发，利用

words.example_en: We must explore all the possibilities to find the solution to the problem.
words.example_zh: 我们必须探讨所有可能性以找到解决这个问题的方法。
words.notes: [记] exploration n. 勘探  explorer n. 勘探者

words.example_en: For college students, to do a part-time job will exert a profound influence on their personality and life.
words.example_zh: 打工对大学生的个性和生活都会施加深远的影响。
words.collocations: [搭] exert an influence on 对……施加影响
words.word_formation: 字根 sert 指“结合（to join）”，如：ex（外）+ (s)ert（结合）→ 自己的能力、技巧等向外部结合 → exert（运用）；insert 指“向内部（in）结合（sert）”，即“插入”；desert 指“脱离（de）结合（sert）”，即被“舍弃”，而被舍弃的地方就是荒凉的“沙漠”。

words.meaning_zh: v. 处理，应对，解决  n. 用具，器材
words.example_en: Everyone has their own problems to tackle.
words.example_zh: 每个人都有自己的问题要去解决。
words.collocations: [搭] tackle the problem 解决问题

words.example_en: I’m afraid I can’t cope with these troubles.
words.example_zh: 恐怕我应付不了这些麻烦。
words.collocations: [搭] cope with 应付，对付

words.example_en: I have to dispose of this pile of old papers and magazines.
words.example_zh: 我得把这堆旧报纸和杂志清理掉。
words.collocations: [搭] dispose of sth. 清除某物；处理某事，解决某事
words.word_formation: 字根 pos 指“放，置”，如：dispose（分开放 → 布置，安排），pose（放好位置 → 姿势），position（位置），compose（放在一起 → 作曲；写；组成），deposit（往下放 → 使沉淀；存钱），propose（放在前面 → 提议；计划）。俗语：Man proposes, god disposes.（谋事在人，成事在天。）
words.notes: [记] disposal n. 处理；清除

words.meaning_zh: v. 进行，实施  n. 举止，行为
words.example_en: His conduct contradicts his words.
words.example_zh: 他言行不一。
words.notes: [记] conductive adj. 有传导性的，导电（或热等）的

words.example_en: The secretary omitted the date when typing the contract.
words.example_zh: 秘书在打合同时漏掉了日期。
words.collocations: [搭] omit a good chance 失去了好机会
words.notes: [记] omission n. 遗漏，疏忽；删除

words.example_en: References to places of battle were deleted from soldiers’ letters during the war.
words.example_zh: 在战时，士兵们的信件中提到作战地点的地方均被删掉。
words.collocations: [搭] delete sth. from 从……中删去某物

words.example_en: The match had to be cancelled due to the bad weather.
words.example_zh: 比赛因天气不好只得取消。
words.collocations: [搭] cancel an appointment 取消约会

words.meaning_zh: adj. 清晰的；明显的  v. 清除
words.example_en: It seems clear that he has no reasonable alternative.
words.example_zh: 他没有其他合适的选择，这一点似乎很明确。
words.collocations: [搭] clear up 使整洁，清理；（疾病等）痊愈
words.notes: [记] clearly adv. 明白地，清晰地

words.example_en: Jim tried to erase the idea from his mind.
words.example_zh: 吉姆试图从脑海中抹去这一念头。

words.example_en: They rescued the boy who fell into the river.
words.example_zh: 他们救起了掉进河里的小男孩。

words.meaning_zh: v. 求助于，采取，诉诸  n.（度假）胜地
words.example_en: I’m sorry you have resorted to deception.
words.example_zh: 我很遗憾你竟采取了欺骗手段。

words.meaning_zh: 重新拿回；恢复健康；（从不愉快的经历中）复原
words.example_en: She soon recovered and stopped crying.
words.example_zh: 她很快就恢复了常态，不再哭了。
words.notes: [记] recovery n. 恢复，痊愈；复苏

words.example_en: It’s hard to restore a broken mirror.
words.example_zh: 破镜难重圆。

words.example_en: I hope I can find a way to rectify your opinion of my behaviour.
words.example_zh: 我希望能设法纠正你对我行为的看法。
words.notes: [记] correct v. 改正

words.example_en: You botched the last job but can redeem yourself on this one.
words.example_zh: 你把上次的工作搞砸了，但可通过这次挽回声誉。
words.collocations: [搭] redeem one’s promise 履行某人的诺言

words.example_en: He offset his small salary by living economically.
words.example_zh: 他以节俭的生活来缓解收入低的问题。
words.collocations: [搭] offset sth. by (doing) sth. 以某物／做某事来补偿（或抵消）某事物

words.example_en: Your body is in survival mode and needs food to replenish its energy.
words.example_zh: 你的身体正处于生存模式，需要食物来补充能量。
words.word_formation: 字根 plen/plete/ple 表示“充满（to fill）”或“满（full）”，如：re（再）+ plen（满）+ ish（动词后缀）→ replenish（重新装满）；com（加强意义）+ plete（满）→ 全满 → complete（完成；完全的）；plenty（满 → 大量；富裕）；de（去掉）+ plen（满）+ ish（动词后缀）→ 去掉满 → deplenish（倒空）。

words.example_en: It is wise to obtain an independent valuation.
words.example_zh: 获得独立估价是明智的。
words.collocations: [搭] obtain employment 实现就业，找到工作

words.meaning_zh: v. 获得；增加  n. 增加；改进
words.example_en: Every time they reap gains from their investment, more people wish to join them.
words.example_zh: 每当他们从投资中得到收益，就有更多人希望加入他们。

words.meaning_zh: v. 供给，供应，提供  n. 供应量；[supplies] 补给品
words.example_en: Domestic consumers were supplied enough necessities by those companies.
words.example_zh: 那些公司给国内消费者提供了足够的生活必需品。
words.collocations: [搭] in short supply 短缺  supply sth. to 把某物供给  supply sb./sth. with 向某人／某物供应

words.meaning_zh: n. 给与（物）；提议  v. 提供；出（价）
words.example_en: They reject all our offers to help.
words.example_zh: 他们拒绝接受我们提出的一切援助。
words.word_formation: 相传北京的雅思、托福考生常去香山卧佛寺上香，因为“卧佛寺”和 offers 谐音。

words.example_en: You have rendered great service.
words.example_zh: 你们帮了很大的忙。

words.meaning_zh: 扩大，扩展；放大（照片或文件）
words.example_en: This photograph probably won’t enlarge well.
words.example_zh: 把这张照片放大后的效果可能不好。
words.collocations: [搭] enlarge the font 放大字体

words.example_en: With the birth of his third son, he found it necessary to do something to augment his income.
words.example_zh: 随着第三个儿子的出生，他感到有必要想办法增加收入。
words.notes: [记] augmentation n. 扩大，增加，加强，提高

words.example_en: Fame is a magnifying glass.
words.example_zh: 名誉是放大镜。
words.word_formation: 字根 magn/maj/max 都指“大（great）”，如：magnifier（放大镜）；major（主修；重要的）；majority（大多数）；maximum（最大限度）。而单词 magnet（磁铁）与“大”无关，来源于地理名词——小亚细亚的一个地区马格内西亚（Magnesia），magnet 的含义是“马格内西亚的石头”。

words.meaning_zh: 增强；扩大（声音）；充实（陈述等）
words.example_en: The student amplified his new findings with drawings and figures.
words.example_zh: 该学生用绘图和数字进一步阐释他新近的发现。
words.notes: [记] amplifier n. 扩音器，扬声器

words.example_en: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms.
words.example_zh: 画家可能会对形状进行夸大或扭曲。

words.example_en: We must prolong the runway of the airfield.
words.example_zh: 我们必须加长机场跑道。

words.example_en: The appeal court upheld the sentence.
words.example_zh: 上诉法院维持了原判决。
words.collocations: [搭] uphold the law 维护法律

words.meaning_zh: n. 后援，支持；（文件等的）备份  adj. 备用的
words.example_en: Make a backup of any work you do on the computer.
words.example_zh: 你在电脑上做的任何工作要进行备份。

words.example_en: His addiction to drugs propelled him towards a life of crime.
words.example_zh: 他吸毒成瘾，这驱使他走向犯罪。
words.notes: [记] propeller n. 螺旋桨

words.example_en: Our e-mail addresses are unlikely to be updated every day.
words.example_zh: 我们的电子邮件地址不可能天天更新。

words.meaning_zh: 举起；引起；抚养；提高；筹募
words.example_en: Please raise your hand if you’ve been told you’re too aggressive at work.
words.example_zh: 如果曾经有人说你工作太有野心，请举手吧。
words.collocations: [搭] raise a price 涨价  raise capital 筹集资本  raise sb.’s awareness of 提高某人在……方面的意识

words.meaning_zh: v. 泄漏  n. 漏洞，裂缝
words.example_en: A small leak will sink a great ship.
words.example_zh: 小洞沉大船。

words.example_en: The teacup is so full that the tea might spill over.
words.example_zh: 茶杯太满了，茶可能会溢出来。
words.collocations: [搭] spill over 溢出；蔓延，波及

words.example_en: Rain seeped through the roof.
words.example_zh: 雨水从房顶漏下来。

words.example_en: Blood oozed from his wound.
words.example_zh: 鲜血慢慢从他的伤口流出。

words.example_en: The village was evacuated because of the threat of a flood.
words.example_zh: 由于洪水的威胁，村里的人被疏散了。
words.word_formation: 字根 vac(u)/van/void 表示“空（empty）”，如：e（出）+ vacu（空）+ ate（动词后缀）→ 空出去 → evacuate（疏散，撤离）；vacuum（真空）；a（出）+ void（空）→ 空出来 → avoid（回避）。
words.notes: [记] evacuation n. 疏散，撤离

words.meaning_zh: v. 挖沟于；砍除  n. 沟，渠，壕沟
words.example_en: The firemen successfully trenched the roof, preventing the fire from spreading further down the block.
words.example_zh: 消防员成功地在屋顶上开出了隔离带，防止火势沿着街区进一步蔓延。

words.example_en: The air was saturated with the perfume of the flowers.
words.example_zh: 空气中充满了花的芬芳。
words.collocations: [搭] saturate oneself (in) 埋头在……中

words.meaning_zh: v. 原谅；同意免除  n. 理由；借口
words.example_en: There is no excuse for trespassing on private property.
words.example_zh: 无论如何都不能擅闯私宅。

words.example_en: I’ll never forgive you for what you have done wrong to my friend.
words.example_zh: 你伤害了我的朋友，我永远也不会原谅你。
words.word_formation: 前缀 for 表示否定含义，如：forgive（不再给予，就此作罢 → 原谅），forget（忘记），forgo（走开了 → 放弃），forbid（禁止）。

words.example_en: The speech contained some interesting ideas.
words.example_zh: 这个讲演包含一些有趣的想法。

words.meaning_zh: n. 尊重；问候  v. 看待
words.example_en: You can’t regard him as a friend but a business associate.
words.example_zh: 你不能把他视为朋友，视为业务伙伴就行。
words.collocations: [搭] in/with regard to 关于，至于
words.notes: [记] regarding prep. 关于，至于  regardless adv. 不管怎样，不顾

words.example_en: He flattered her on her cooking.
words.example_zh: 他奉承她，说她厨艺好。

words.meaning_zh: n.（对上帝或神的）崇拜，礼拜；爱慕  v. 做礼拜
words.example_en: She gazed at the famous singer with worship in her eyes.
words.example_zh: 她注视着这位歌星，眼里充满仰慕。

words.meaning_zh: n. 原因，理由；事业  v. 引起，导致
words.example_en: Police are investigating the likely cause of the explosion.
words.example_zh: 警方正在调查可能引起爆炸的原因。

words.example_en: You should take care of your niece for the sake of your sister.
words.example_zh: 为了你姐姐，你应该照顾好你的外甥女。
words.collocations: [搭] for the sake of 为了……起见，因为……的缘故

words.example_en: Their purpose is to build a fair society and a strong economy.
words.example_zh: 他们的目的是要建立一个公平的社会和一个强大的经济体。
words.collocations: [搭] on purpose 故意地  for the purpose of 为了……的目的
words.notes: [记] purposely adv. 故意地，蓄意地

words.meaning_zh: n. 宗旨；目标  adj. 客观的
words.example_en: My objective this summer is to learn to swim.
words.example_zh: 我今年夏天的目标是学习游泳。
words.notes: [记] subjective adj. 主观的，个人的

words.example_en: The young man’s behaviour aroused the suspicions of the police.
words.example_zh: 那个年轻人的行为引起了警方的怀疑。
words.collocations: [搭] arouse sb.’s interest/curiosity/enthusiasm/anger 激起某人的兴趣／好奇心／热情／怒气

words.meaning_zh: v. 引发，触发  n.（枪等的）扳机
words.example_en: He accidentally triggered his revolver.
words.example_zh: 他无意中扣发了他的左轮手枪的扳机。

words.example_en: They are seeking the most reasonable diet which will do good to their health.
words.example_zh: 他们在寻找有益于他们健康的最合理的饮食。
words.collocations: [搭] seek after 寻求，追求

words.example_en: Henry did his best to retrieve the situation.
words.example_zh: 亨利尽力挽回局势。

words.example_en: I won’t testify against my friend.
words.example_zh: 我不想作证指控我的朋友。
words.collocations: [搭] testify against 作不利于……的证明  testify to 证明，表明

words.example_en: He tried in every way to verify this theory.
words.example_zh: 他想了一切办法来证实这个理论。

words.example_en: Can you specify the reasons?
words.example_zh: 你能具体说明原因吗？
words.notes: [记] specific adj. 具体的

words.example_en: For all my effort to enlighten her, she was still all adrift.
words.example_zh: 我竭尽全力去启发她，她却仍十分茫然。
words.word_formation: en（= in，里面）+ light（光）+ en（动词后缀）→ 将一个人由黑暗带到有光线（光明）的地方，就是 enlighten（启迪，启发）。

words.example_en: She imparted the secret to her boyfriend.
words.example_zh: 她把秘密向她的男朋友透露了。

words.example_en: You deserve a reward for being so helpful.
words.example_zh: 你帮了这么大的忙，理应受到奖励。

words.meaning_zh: v.（使）落下；（使）降低；和……断绝联系  n. 滴
words.example_en: In the winter, the temperature often drops below freezing.
words.example_zh: 冬天的时候，温度常会降到冰点以下。
words.collocations: [搭] a drop in the bucket 沧海一粟，九牛一毛  drop sb. 和某人断绝来往

words.example_en: The captain of the sinking ship used flares to attract the attention of the coastguard.
words.example_zh: 轮船正在下沉，船长利用闪光信号吸引海岸警卫队注意。

words.meaning_zh: 垂直掉下；（价格、水平等）骤然下跌
words.example_en: The damaged aircraft plummeted down to earth.
words.example_zh: 受损的飞机垂直坠向地面。

words.example_en: The sound of the bell was muffled by the curtains.
words.example_zh: 由于被帘子蒙住，铃的声音变得低沉了。

words.example_en: He overshadowed all his competitors.
words.example_zh: 他使所有的竞争者都黯然失色。

words.example_en: She invited us to her party.
words.example_zh: 她邀请我们参加她的聚会。
words.notes: [记] invitation n. 邀请；请柬

words.example_en: We welcome constructive criticism.
words.example_zh: 我们欢迎有建设性的批评。
words.collocations: [搭] welcome to 欢迎来到／欢迎做  welcome aboard 欢迎搭乘（飞机、火车、轮船等）；欢迎加入

words.meaning_zh: 向……问好，迎接；对……作出反应
words.example_en: The audience greeted his speech with a great cheer.
words.example_zh: 听众对他的演讲报以一阵热烈的欢呼声。
words.notes: [记] greeting n. 问候，致意

words.meaning_zh: v.（向……）行礼；致敬  n. 行礼；致敬
words.example_en: They saluted each other by raising their hats.
words.example_zh: 他们举起帽子互相行礼。

words.example_en: They all passed the exam and celebrated with a party.
words.example_zh: 他们都通过了考试，举行了一个聚会来庆祝。
words.notes: [记] celebration n. 庆祝；庆典  celebrated adj. 著名的  celebrity n. 名人

words.example_en: We must congratulate you on your engagement.
words.example_zh: 我们一定要祝贺你们订婚。
words.notes: [记] congratulation n. [~s] 恭喜，祝贺

words.example_en: It is more blessed to give than to receive.
words.example_zh: 施恩比受惠更有福。
words.collocations: [搭] Bless you! 长命百岁！（在别人打喷嚏时说的话）

words.example_en: If only I could participate in your good fortune.
words.example_zh: 要是我能分享你的好运就好了。
words.collocations: [搭] participate in 参加，参与
words.notes: [记] participant n. 参与者

words.meaning_zh: int. 再会  n. 告别
words.example_en: The girl had come on the pretext of bidding him farewell.
words.example_zh: 女孩以向他辞行作借口来见他。
words.collocations: [搭] a farewell address 告别演说

words.example_en: His actions do not assort with his promises.
words.example_zh: 他的行动和他的诺言不一致。

words.example_en: These goods don’t correspond with my order.
words.example_zh: 这些货物与我的订单不符。
words.collocations: [搭] correspond with sb. 与某人通信

words.meaning_zh: v.（与……）一致；给予  n. 协议
words.example_en: The government and the rebels are in accord on one point.
words.example_zh: 政府和反叛者在一点上是一致的。
words.notes: [记] accordance n. 一致，和谐；授予  accordingly adv. 因此，所以；照着

words.meaning_zh: v. 把……归因于  n. 属性，特性
words.example_en: David attributed his company’s success to the unity of the staff and their persevering hard work.
words.example_zh: 戴维认为，他们公司能获得成功是因为全体员工很团结且坚持不懈地努力工作。
words.collocations: [搭] attribute sth. to 把某事归因于
words.notes: [记] attribution n. 归因；归属；属性

words.example_en: Recall the misery of the past and contrast it with the happiness of today.
words.example_zh: 想想过去的苦，比比今天的甜。

words.example_en: I can recollect hearing his speech.
words.example_zh: 我记得我听过他的演说。
words.word_formation: 字根 lect 指“选（to select）；搜集（to gather）”，如：collect（搜集到一起 → 收集），recollect（重新搜集到一起 → 记起，想起），select（把集合在一起的分离出来 [se = apart] → 挑选），neglect（没被选出，没被搜集 → 忽视；疏漏）。

words.example_en: These photos remind me of my childhood.
words.example_zh: 这些照片使我想起了我的童年。
words.collocations: [搭] remind sb. of 使某人想起  remind sb. to do sth. 提醒某人做某事

words.example_en: The student was asked to retell the story in his own words.
words.example_zh: 学生被要求用自己的话复述这个故事。

words.meaning_zh: v. 重复  adj. 再次光顾的
words.example_en: A large proportion of our bookings come from repeat business and personal recommendation.
words.example_zh: 我们的一大部分订单来自回头客和熟人介绍。
words.word_formation: 字根 peat/pet 指“寻求（to seek）”，如：appetite（寻求的情绪 → 食欲；强烈欲望），compete/competition（一起寻求一样东西 → 竞争），repetition（再次寻求 → 重复），impetus（内部寻求 → 动量；促进），petitioner（寻求的人 → 请愿人）。
words.notes: [记] repetition n. 重复，重做

words.example_en: It was, in retrospect, the happiest day of her life.
words.example_zh: 回想起来，那是她一生中最幸福的日子。
words.notes: [记] retrospective adj. 回顾的

words.example_en: His courage and determination impressed his rivals.
words.example_zh: 他的勇敢和坚定给他的对手留下了深刻印象。
words.notes: [记] impression n. 印象；印记  impressive adj. 给人印象深刻的

words.example_en: The hill is surmounted by a church.
words.example_zh: 山的最高处有一座教堂。
words.word_formation: 前缀 sur 是 super 的变体，都表示“在……上（over, above）”，如：sur（在……上）+ mount（登上）→ 超越 → surmount（克服；置于……顶端）；sur（在……上）+ name（名字）→ 名字之上 → surname（姓，姓氏）；sur（在……上）+ pass（过）→ surpass（胜过，超过）；sur（= over，在……上）+ vey（= see，看）→ 在上面看 → survey（民意调查）；sur（在……上）+ vive（活）→ 比……活得长 → survive（幸存）。

words.example_en: He was mortified by his inability to answer the question.
words.example_zh: 他因为自己答不出这个问题而感到羞愧。

words.example_en: The smell of cooking pervaded the entire house.
words.example_zh: 整个房子里充满了烹调食物的气味。
words.word_formation: 字根 vade 指“走（to go）”，如：per（全面的）+ vade（走）→ pervade（遍及，弥漫）；in（进来）+ vade（走）→ 走进来 → invade（侵略）；e（向外）+ vade（走）→ evade（逃避）。
words.notes: [记] pervasive adj. 遍布的；普遍的

words.example_en: We’ll get someone or other to replace him.
words.example_zh: 我们会找别人来代替他。
words.collocations: [搭] replace A with B 用 B 替换 A

words.meaning_zh: v. 替换  n. 代用品；代替者；替补（运动员）
words.example_en: We recommend this brand as a good substitute.
words.example_zh: 我们推荐这个品牌，它可以很好地替代原来的那个。
words.collocations: [搭] substitute A for B 用 A 代替 B
words.word_formation: 球场上的候补队员或板凳队员，就是 substitute。另一种调侃的说法是 bench warmer（暖板凳的人）。因为当某球员被候补队员替换下场时，该球员会坐在候补队员刚坐过的还有余温的凳子上。
words.notes: [记] substitution n. 替换；替代品

words.meaning_zh: 区分，辨别；使出众，使著名
words.example_en: Some people cannot distinguish between some colours.
words.example_zh: 有些人不能分辨某些颜色。
words.notes: [记] distinguished adj. 著名的，卓越的  distinction n. 差别；区分  distinct adj. 明显的；截然不同的

words.example_en: This company does not differentiate between men and women—they employ and pay both equally.
words.example_zh: 这家公司对男女职工一视同仁——他们平等地雇用两者而且同工同酬。

words.meaning_zh: v.（使）倾向于；（使）倾斜  n. 斜坡；倾斜
words.example_en: What he said inclines me to think that he will agree to our plan.
words.example_zh: 他的话使我觉得他会同意我们的计划。

words.meaning_zh: v.（使）倚靠；倾斜  adj. 瘦的；贫乏的
words.example_en: She leaned against his shoulder.
words.example_zh: 她靠在他的肩上。
words.collocations: [搭] lean on 依赖，依靠  lean toward 倾向于

words.example_en: The dog swatted the hedgehog sideways.
words.example_zh: 狗从侧面猛拍了刺猬一下。
